title: Senior Security Operations Engineer
description:
**Build something monumental for Healthcare!**
 At Tandem Health we’re reimagining healthcare by putting clinicians first. Our platform - designed by clinicians, for clinicians - is built on deep insight into real-world pain points, with intuitive medical notes and workflows that truly support patient care.
   

  

 We’re a fast-scaling health-tech company backed by top investors and expanding globally. We move fast, stay curious, and believe building something that matters starts with an extraordinary team. If you're passionate about impact and innovation, we'd love to meet you!
   

  

**About The Role**
 You will lead the engineering of our security operations programme in Stockholm. The role is hands-on and spans telemetry, detection engineering, incident response and the way we work with our managed detection and response (MDR) provider.
   

  

 The work is varied. You might trace an identity alert across cloud logs or guide a containment decision during an incident. On another day, you might test whether an AI-assisted investigation workflow is safe enough to use.
   

  

 You will have a real say in the tools we choose, the processes we build and the skills we add as the team grows. The decisions you make will shape how Tandem handles security incidents for years to come.
   

  

 This is a senior individual contributor role today. You do not need to want a management role to grow here. If people management interests you later, we can explore that path as the team grows.
   

  

 What you will do
   

  

* Own a risk-prioritised plan for bringing data sources into our security information and event management (SIEM) platform.
* Make telemetry dependable. Build checks that show when important data is missing, delayed or incomplete.
* Develop a repeatable detection lifecycle that covers creation, testing, tuning, ownership and retirement.
* Lead the technical response to security incidents. Establish scope, urgency and likely impact, then guide containment and remediation.
* Make containment decisions with the Head of Security and relevant system owners. Take direct action when an approved playbook and delegated authority allow it.
* Coordinate security incidents from detection to closure. Keep playbooks, decision records, escalation paths and after-action reviews useful and current.
* Run practical security incident training and exercises. Help colleagues understand their roles and respond with confidence under pressure.
* Give our medical device regulation compliance and legal teams the technical evidence they need to assess potential privacy incidents.
* Build an effective operating model with our MDR provider and other security partners. Make ownership and hand-offs clear.
* Measure what matters, including telemetry coverage, detection quality, response time, hand-off quality and completed follow-up actions.
* Find practical uses for AI in security operations. Put clear data boundaries, evaluation, human approval, audit and fallback controls around those workflows.
* Document the systems and decisions you build so future team members can contribute quickly.


 What success looks like
   

  

 In your first year, your work will allow us to scale out the clear and repeatable process of resolving security incidents from detection to closure. Important telemetry gaps and detection quality should be visible. MDR hand-offs should be seamless, and after-action reviews should lead to delivered improvements.
   

  

 You will also lay the groundwork for the next phase of security operations at Tandem. The next phase needs clearer ownership, more internal capability and systems that a growing team can build on.
   

  

 What you bring
   

  

* Coordinate security incidents across technical and non-technical teams.
* Judge when to gather more evidence, when to contain and when to escalate.
* Work with telemetry from identity, endpoint, cloud, network and application systems.
* Build and operate SIEM integrations, detections and telemetry health checks.
* Use code or automation to remove repetitive work and make response more reliable.
* Distinguish expected behavior, control failures and credible malicious activity.
* Write clear playbooks, investigation notes and after-action reviews.
* Explain technical risk to engineers, leaders and colleagues outside security.
* Bring structure to an incomplete process without waiting for perfect conditions.
* Work collaboratively and stay calm when the answer is not yet clear.


 We are looking for someone who makes sound decisions with incomplete information and explains their reasoning. You should always improve the system after the immediate problem is over.
   

  

 We care more about demonstrated capability than a particular degree, certification or toolset.
   

  

 Bonus points
   

  

* Experience working with a co-managed MDR or managed security service provider.
* Detection engineering experience, including validation and tuning.
* Experience with incident command, security exercises or internal training.
* Experience in healthcare, another regulated environment or a high-growth technology company.
* Experience managing detections, automation or integrations as version-controlled code.
* Experience using AI or machine learning in security operations, including ways to assess output quality and failure modes.


 On-call
   

  

 Our MDR provider monitors and triages alerts around the clock. You will join a shared after-hours rotation for escalations that need company context or a containment decision. On call rotations include additional compensation.
   

  

 Location
   

  

 We work best when we spend time together. You will work primarily from our headquarters in central Stockholm.
   

  

 How to apply
   

  

 We review applications continuously. Please apply with your CV in English.
   

  

 Because Tandem handles sensitive patient data, we conduct a background check before hiring.
   

  

**Benefits**
* Competitive salary and company stock options.
* Additional compensation for on-call rotations
* 30 days of paid holiday each year.
* 5,000 SEK wellness allowance, plus 6,000 SEK each year for other health-related initiatives.
* Parental leave top-up for new parents.
* Private medical insurance.
* Mental health support through Mindler.
* Pension programme.
* Regular social and team activities, including off-sites and seasonal events.


 We review our benefits regularly and may change them from time to time.
   

  

**Culture at Tandem**
 At Tandem, we move fast, think big, and take ownership. We're a high-performing, diverse team with a shared drive to change the future of healthcare - and we’re just getting started.
   

  

 Our culture is built on action, ambition, and learning. You'll be trusted to take the lead, challenge yourself, and make an impact from day one. We believe real growth happens when you're stretched, supported, and surrounded by smart, passionate teammates who want to win together.
   

  

 Even though we’re spread across countries, we come together often in Sweden for team meetings, social events, and offsites - blending global reach with real human connection.
   

  

 We hire for talent, potential, and attitude - valuing different backgrounds and fresh perspectives. Great ideas come from everywhere, and we’re building a team that reflects the world we want to change.
   

  

*Tandem handles sensitive patient data and will conduct a background check before hiring any candidate.*

title: Kubernetes Platform Quality & Security Engineer
description:
We are looking for an experienced
 **Kubernetes (K8s) Platform Quality & Security Engineer** 
 to assess and quality-assure the operating environment, a product currently deployed in a development Kubernetes cluster.
   

  

 The objective is to ensure that the environment is
 **robust, secure, scalable, resilient, and aligned with Kubernetes best practices** 
 before it is transitioned to a production cluster. The consultant will perform a structured assessment of the existing environment, identify risks and technical gaps, provide practical recommendations, and support the team in addressing key deficiencies.
   

  

 The resulting recommendations and operating principles are expected to serve as a
 **reference model for operating the company's products on Kubernetes** 
 .
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Kubernetes Configuration Review**
* Assess the existing Kubernetes cluster and application configuration.
* Review namespace structure, resource requests/limits, RBAC, and access control.
* Analyze network policies and traffic flows between services.
* Review secrets, certificates, and credential management.
* Assess persistent storage configuration for both databases and file-based workloads.
* Identify configuration deviations and opportunities for standardization.


**Operations, Reliability & Resilience**
* Review liveness, readiness, and startup probes.
* Assess autoscaling, resource allocation, and rolling update strategies.
* Review the backup and recovery strategy, including persistent storage and solutions such as Velero or equivalent technologies.
* Evaluate logging, monitoring, observability, and alerting.
* Assess operational processes for incident handling, recovery, and ongoing maintenance.
* Identify potential resilience and availability risks before production deployment.


**Kubernetes Security**
* Review container image management and vulnerability scanning practices.
* Assess Pod Security Standards and security policies.
* Review RBAC and least-privilege access across the environment.
* Assess node hardening, patch management, and security configuration.
* Identify security risks and recommend practical remediation measures.


**Architecture & Best-Practice Assessment**
* Review how services are structured within Kubernetes, including:
+ Deployments
+ Services
+ Ingress
+ Configuration and secrets
+ Persistent workloads

* Identify technical debt, temporary solutions, and quick fixes that may have accumulated over time.
* Compare the current setup against Kubernetes best practices and established platform standards.
* Where relevant, compare with other products, such as Helix, to identify opportunities for standardization, reuse, and improved operational consistency.


**Deliverables**
 The consultant is expected to provide:
   

  

* Current-state assessment covering configuration, security, operations, architecture, and resilience.
* Risk and gap analysis, with deviations prioritized according to severity and business/technical impact.
* Concrete and implementable recommendations for addressing identified deficiencies.
* Prioritized action plan, including recommended next steps and clear ownership/responsibility.
* Practical support to the team in addressing selected findings.
* Knowledge-transfer sessions and workshops to ensure internal teams can maintain and improve the quality level after completion.
* Final workshop/debriefing presenting findings, recommendations, priorities, and key lessons learned.


**Required Competencies**
 We are looking for a consultant with:
   

  

* Documented hands-on experience with Kubernetes in production environments.
* Strong knowledge of Kubernetes architecture, configuration, and operations.
* Good understanding of container security, including:
+ RBAC and access control
+ Network policies
+ Secrets and certificate management
+ Pod security
+ Container image security and vulnerability scanning

* Strong knowledge of Kubernetes operations, including:
+ Resource requests and limits
+ Autoscaling
+ Health checks and probes
+ Rolling updates
+ Logging and monitoring
+ Alerting
+ Backup and restore
+ Persistent storage

* Proven experience in reviewing, auditing, and improving existing production environments, rather than only designing greenfield solutions.
* Ability to identify technical debt, operational risks, security gaps, and deviations from best practices.
* Experience translating technical findings into clear, actionable recommendations.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to work effectively with both software developers and IT operations teams.
* Ability to conduct workshops and transfer knowledge to internal teams.
* Swedish or English, both spoken and written.

title: Information Architect  - Data & AI
description:
**Vill du vara med och forma hur hela Länsförsäkringar förstår, strukturerar och använder sin information?**
*På Länsförsäkringar är data och AI en strategisk prioritet som stärker vår affär, möjliggör innovation och skapar bättre kundupplevelser. Nu söker vi en informationsarkitekt som vill ta en nyckelroll i att bygga den gemensamma informationsstruktur som gör detta möjligt.*
*Som informationsarkitekt får du en central roll i att utveckla koncernens gemensamma informationsmodeller, begreppsstrukturer och arkitekturprinciper. Arbetet skapar förutsättningar för en enhetlig, styrbar och framtidssäker informationshantering: en grund för datadriven utveckling, regulatorisk efterlevnad och skalbara AI-förmågor.*
*Här får du stort mandat att påverka hur information definieras, struktureras och används i hela koncernen, från strategisk nivå till operativ tillämpning.*
**Om jobbet**
 Som informationsarkitekt inom Data & AI ansvarar du för att utveckla och förvalta koncernens gemensamma informationsmodeller, begreppsstrukturer och arkitekturprinciper. Du säkerställer att informationsarkitekturen är sammanhållen, konsekvent och framtidssäkrad samt möter verksamhetens, tekniska och regulatoriska krav. Rollen är en central del av LFAB’s arbete med data governance och utgör en viktig grundförutsättning för att kunna skala datadrivna och AI-baserade förmågor.
   

  

 I nära samarbete med informationsarkitekter på våra affärsenheter, Data Management Office och andra arkitektroller driver du gemensamma modelleringsinitiativ för att skapa gemensamma definitioner och enhetlig informationsförståelse.
   

  

 Du arbetar i gränslandet mellan verksamhet, data och teknik, med fokus på långsiktig struktur snarare än enskilda systemlösningar.
   

  

 Dina arbetsuppgifter inkluderar:
   

  

* Äga och vidareutveckla koncernens gemensamma informationsmodeller, begreppsstrukturer och arkitekturprinciper
* Etablera och säkerställa konsekvent semantik och spårbarhet mellan begrepp, modeller och system
* Leda koncernövergripande modelleringsinitiativ, workshops och arkitekturforum
* Utveckla och förvalta styrande principer och ramverk för informationsarkitektur och datastyrning
* Stötta affärsenheter i gemensamma arbetssätt och strukturer
* Förbereda beslutsunderlag till arkitekturstyrning
* Samarbeta med Data Management Office och närliggande specialistroller inom data governance, metadata och datakvalitet


 Vi söker dig som har:
   

  

* Relevant högskoleutbildning inom IT, systemvetenskap eller liknande
* Flerårig erfarenhet som informationsarkitekt, dataarkitekt eller liknande roll i större, komplexa organisationer
* Stark erfarenhet av informationsmodellering, begreppsarbete och enterprise data architecture
* God förståelse för data governance, datastyrning och arkitekturprinciper
* Erfarenhet av metadata, masterdata och datakvalitetsarbete
* Förmåga att kommunicera på svenska och engelska i både tal och skrift


 Meriterande:
   

  

* Erfarenhet från bank, försäkring eller annan reglerad bransch
* Erfarenhet av MDM och koncernövergripande modelleringsarbete
* Erfarenhet av förändringsledning i komplexa informations- och datamiljöer


 Som person är du strukturerad och samarbetsorienterad med förmåga att skapa tydlighet i komplexa informationsmiljöer. Du rör dig tryggt mellan verksamhet, data och teknik och har ett tydligt fokus på att etablera hållbara begrepp och modeller som håller över tid.
   

  

 Vidare trivs du i sammanhang där du får driva och facilitera gemensamt arbete, där avvägningar och principer behöver förankras.
   

  

**Om oss**
 Du blir en del av Data Management Office inom avdelningen Data & AI. Vi ansvarar för att utveckla de gemensamma plattformar, förmågor och arbetssätt som gör det möjligt för hela Länsförsäkringar att använda data och AI på ett säkert och effektivt sätt.
   

  

 Tillsammans med verksamheten, agila team och koncernfunktioner bygger vi den informationsstruktur som möjliggör datadrivet beslutsfattande, regulatorisk efterlevnad och framtidens AI-förmågor.
   

  

 Som informationsarkitekt får du en viktig roll i att forma denna grund och påverka hur information används i hela organisationen.
   

  

**Kontaktpersoner**
 Rekryterande chef: sonja.galkin@lansforsakringar.se
   

  

 Facklig representant Forena: jessica.loow@lansforsakringar.se

Vi driver den gemensamma digitala transformationen och levererar förstklassiga IT-lösningar, datadrivna insikter och innovativa digitala tjänster som skapar värde för hela verksamheten. Vårt uppdrag är att bygga en robust och framtidssäker IT-miljö – både på plats och i molnet – som möjliggör kundnära och effektiva affärer i hela gruppen.

Vi ansvarar för allt från IT-styrning, enterprisearkitektur och leverantörshantering till applikationsutveckling, cybersäkerhet och verksamhetsberedskap.

description:

Den används redan av flera stora aktörer och gör livet enklare för miljontals användare. Och det bästa, vi är bara i början på vår resa!
 



  





 Tekniskt då? Vi bygger modulärt, med en och samma kodbas som kan anpassas efter olika kunders behov. Det kräver smart arkitektur, kluriga lösningar och tätt samarbete. Vår stack består bland annat av Java och Vue
 



  





 Vi jobbar AI-drivet och ser generativ AI som en självklar del av den moderna utvecklarens verktygslåda. Redan idag använder vi AI-stöd genom hela utvecklingskedjan, från kravanalys och tekniska vägval till implementation, testning, code reviews och dokumentation.
 



  





 Vårt projekt växer och vi behöver nu stärka upp teamet med en till fullstackutvecklare!
 



  





**Rollen som Fullstackutvecklare** 




 Som fullstackutvecklare hos oss blir du en del av ett erfaret team där du arbetar i hela utvecklingskedjan, från krav och tekniska vägval till utveckling, test och leverans.
 



  





 Du arbetar både med backend i
 **Java och Spring Boot** 
 och frontend i
 **Vue** 
 . Våra lösningar används av flera kunder utifrån en gemensam kodbas, vilket gör att du behöver förstå helheten och hitta lösningar som fungerar både för kunden och produkten över tid.
 



  





 I rollen kommer du bland annat att:
 


* utveckla och vidareutveckla funktionalitet i frontend och backend
* arbeta med integrationer och tekniska flöden
* utreda krav och föreslå tekniska lösningar
* felsöka, testa och bidra i code reviews
* hantera releaser och leveranser till kund
* delta i kunddialog kring krav, lösningar och leveranser
* använda och vidareutveckla AI-stödda arbetssätt för analys, utveckling, testning och code review



  





**Din bakgrund** 




 Vi tror att du har några års erfarenhet av systemutveckling och är van att arbeta fullstack. Du behöver inte vara lika stark inom alla delar, men du gillar att förstå hur systemet hänger ihop och att ta ansvar hela vägen från problem till lösning. Du behöver inte vara expert på AI-driven utveckling idag, men vi ser gärna att du är nyfiken på området.
 



  





 Vi ser gärna att du har erfarenhet av:
 


* Systemutveckling, gärna i större eller mer komplexa system
* Java och Spring Boot
* Vue eller annat modernt frontendramverk
* SQL och relationella databaser
* Git och CI/CD
* automatiserade tester
* Kundkontakt och att driva kravdiskussioner
* AI-stöd i utvecklingsarbetet, till exempel Cursor, Kiro eller liknande verktyg



  





 Det är ett plus om du har erfarenhet av SaaS- eller white-label-lösningar, Lumera Core eller försäkring, pension och finans.
 



  





 Som person är du nyfiken, prestigelös och gillar att samarbeta. Du delar gärna med dig av din kunskap, är bekväm i kunddialog och vill fortsätta utvecklas tillsammans med teamet.
 



  





**Vad du får hos oss** 



* Ett team där gemenskap, omtanke och glädje inte bara är fina ord, det är så vi jobbar!
* Vi delar på 15 % av vinsten varje år. Går det bra för Meepo, går det bra för alla.
* Du får 50 000 kronor om året i utbildningsbudget, att använda till det du vill lära dig mer om.
* Vi ger 10 % av vinsten till välgörenhet – för att vi vill att vår techkraft ska göra skillnad, även utanför skärmen.
* Tjänstepension, friskvårdsbidrag på 5 000 kronor och dessutom ett gymkort, för att nämna några av alla våra förmåner.
* Vi sitter i fina lokaler i Mariahissen med magisk utsikt över Riddarfjärden och Stadshuset.



  





**Redo att bli en del av vårt team?** 




 Hör av dig! Oavsett om du är redo att söka eller bara vill veta lite mer. Vi berättar gärna mer om hur vi jobbar och hur det är att vara en del av teamet.

title: Backend Engineer
description:
**Your work days are brighter here.**
 We’re obsessed with making hard work pay off, for our people, our customers, and the world around us. As a Fortune 500 company and a leading AI platform for managing people, money, and agents, we’re shaping the future of work so teams can reach their potential and focus on what matters most. The minute you join, you’ll feel it. Not just in the products we build, but in how we show up for each other. Our culture is rooted in integrity, empathy, and shared enthusiasm. We’re in this together, tackling big challenges with bold ideas and genuine care. We look for curious minds and courageous collaborators who bring sun-drenched optimism and drive. Whether you're building smarter solutions, supporting customers, or creating a space where everyone belongs, you’ll do meaningful work with Workmates who’ve got your back. In return, we’ll give you the trust to take risks, the tools to grow, the skills to develop and the support of a company invested in you for the long haul. So, if you want to inspire a brighter work day for everyone, including yourself, you’ve found a match in Workday, and we hope to be a match for you too.
   

  

**About The Team**
 About Sana
   

  

 Sana is an AI lab building superintelligence for work. We believe organizations can accomplish their missions faster when teams can effortlessly access knowledge, automate repetitive work, and learn anything with the help of agentic AI. As part of Workday, we are committed to building AI that augments people - not replaces them.
   

  

 We bring this mission to life through two products. Sana Agents provide a seamless way to access all your company’s apps, knowledge, and data, enabling AI agents to do real work so teams can process and act on information at unprecedented scale. Sana Learn is an AI-powered learning hub that combines the simplicity of a modern learning platform with intelligent features like an AI tutor, automated content generation, and interactive apps, making knowledge not just accessible but actionable.
   

  

 We’re a talent-dense, product-obsessed team of engineers and designers from companies like Google, Spotify, Apple, and Databricks, united by deep technical excellence and rapid iteration. Our tools already help over a million people learn and work better across hundreds of leading enterprises - and we’re just getting started.
   

  

**About The Role**
**About the role**
 You'll build and evolve the core services that power agents and product features, with a focus on enterprise-scale workloads, performance optimization, and long-term architectural sustainability. You drive architecture and systems design to ensure our platform can support high volumes of data, entities, and demanding enterprise clients.
   

  

**About You**
**In this role, you will**
* Design and decompose services and APIs for scale and clarity
* Build eventing and queue systems for reliable, high-throughput data flows
* Lead schema evolution, migrations, query/index optimization and caching strategies
* Define and enforce consistency models and multi-region readiness
* Optimize for performance budgets and privacy/tenant isolation
* Work hands-on with TypeScript/Node, Postgres, and distributed systems primitives.


**What Success Looks Like**
* Core services are reliable, scalable, and easy to evolve
* Risks are identified and solved before issues become critical
* APIs are clear, well-documented, and power seamless product experiences
* Data boundaries are robust - privacy and tenant isolation are never compromised
* Performance budgets are met, even under heavy load
* You are a trusted partner for distributed systems design and implementation


**Our tech stack**
 We build on a simple modern stack optimized for both humans and AI.
   

  

* Backend: TypeScript, Kotlin, Node.js
* Frontend: TypeScript, React, Tailwind
* Databases: Postgres, Redis
* Cloud infra: GCP/Kubernetes/Terraform


**Workday Pay Transparency Statement (For EU Locations Only)**
 Listed below is the base salary range applicable to this position. Workday pay ranges (and the precise pay offered to the successful candidate) are based on a number of objective criteria such as relevant experience and skills, and educational qualifications, level of responsibility, demands of the role, work location and business need. As a part of the total compensation package, this role may be eligible for the Workday Bonus Plan or a role-specific commission/bonus, as well as annual refresh stock grants awarded by Workday Inc. For more information regarding Workday’s comprehensive benefits, please click here.
   

  

 Primary Location Base Pay Range: kr648,000 SEK - kr972,000 SEK Sweden
   

  

**Our Approach to Flexible Work**
 With Flex Work, we’re combining the best of both worlds: in-person time and remote. Our approach enables our teams to deepen connections, maintain a strong community, and do their best work. We know that flexibility can take shape in many ways, so rather than a number of required days in-office each week, we simply
 **spend at least half (50%) of our time each quarter in the office or in the field** 
 with our customers, prospects, and partners (depending on role). This means you'll have the freedom to create a flexible schedule that caters to your business, team, and personal needs, while being intentional to make the most of time spent together. Those in our remote "home office" roles also have the opportunity to come together in our offices for important moments that matter.
   

  

 Pursuant to applicable Fair Chance law, Workday will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.
   

  

 Workday is an Equal Opportunity Employer including individuals with disabilities and protected veterans.
   

  

 Workday is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals during our application process, in order to perform one or more essential functions of their job, as well as regarding the use of AI tools for employment decision-making to any degree. Please see below for more details including how to request an accommodation as a qualified veteran, due to a disability or for religious reasons, or as otherwise provided under applicable law.
   

  

 Workday prohibits taking adverse action against any candidate or employee for reporting a possible violation of this policy, requesting one or more work accommodations, exercising a privacy right, or cooperating in an investigation in accordance with applicable law. Any employee who retaliates against a candidate or employee for doing so may be subject to disciplinary action, up to and including termination of employment, to the fullest extent allowable under applicable law.
   

  

 If you require a reasonable accommodation, you may email accommodations@workday.com, as far in advance as possible.
   

  

**Are you being referred to one of our roles? If so, ask your connection at Workday about our Employee Referral process!**
 At Workday, we value our candidates’ privacy and data security. Workday will never ask candidates to apply to jobs through websites that are not Workday Careers.
   

  

 Please be aware of sites that may ask for you to input your data in connection with a job posting that appears to be from Workday but is not.
   

  

 In addition, Workday will never ask candidates to pay a recruiting fee, or pay for consulting or coaching services, in order to apply for a job at Workday.

title: AI-utvecklare
description:
**Jobba för originalet.** 




 Välkommen till Apoteket, nummer ett sedan 1971. Med visioner för framtiden och kvalitet i varje detalj, skapar vi förutsättningar för ett liv i hälsa. Hos oss utvecklas du i en kultur där din röst alltid blir hörd. Och allt vi får över ger vi tillbaka till samhället. Det är så vi gör skillnad på riktigt.
 



  





**Om Generative AI på Apoteket** 




 Det vi gör på Tech har en avgörande roll för att förverkliga Apotekets affärsstrategi. Vi vill vara en ledande aktör i vår bransch och samtidigt kunna möta de behov som uppstår i samband med de förändringar som sker inom Apoteket och i vår omvärld. Som utvecklare på Apoteket är du med på vårt uppdrag att bidra till en bättre hälsa för varje individ – och samhället som stort.
 



 Du blir en del av teamet Generativ AI, som idag består av fyra medarbetare. Teamet är en del av Apoteket Tech och ingår i en enhet med bred kompetens inom projektledning, business intelligence, maskininlärning, RPA och Microsoft 365.
 



  





**Din roll** 




 Som AI-utvecklare har du en central roll i att stärka Apotekets tekniska kapacitet inom generativ AI. Du ansvarar för att utveckla, vidareutveckla och förvalta AI-baserade lösningar i en komplex och reglerad miljö, med ett helhetsansvar enligt DevOps-principen – från design och implementation till drift och kontinuerlig förbättring.
 



 I rollen arbetar du med Azure-baserade lösningar, AI-tjänster, integrationer och pipelines, där du omsätter verksamhetsbehov och identifierar nya möjligheter där AI kan skapa värde, till robusta och hållbara tekniska lösningar. Du kombinerar hands-on utveckling med ett stort tekniskt ansvar, vilket innebär att du designar arkitektur, löser komplexa problem och bidrar till effektiva arbetssätt inom CI/CD, drift och säkerhet.
 



 Du samarbetar nära utvecklare, arkitekter, säkerhetsfunktioner och verksamheten, samt vid behov externa partners
 



  





**Vad du kommer göra hos oss:** 



* Utveckla och vidareutveckla AI-lösningar med fokus på generativ AI och agentbaserade lösningar
* Designa och implementera skalbara lösningar i Azure-miljö
* Arbeta enligt DevOps-principer med CI/CD, deployment och drift, samt använda moderna AI-stöd för att effektivisera utveckling och automatisera delar av leveransflödet.
* Bidra till arkitektur och tekniska vägval inom AI-området
* Förvalta och förbättra befintliga AI-tjänster, inklusive incidenthantering
* Utvärdera nya tekniker, modeller och arbetssätt inom AI och omsätta dem i praktiken
* Samarbeta nära verksamhet och andra team för att omsätta behov till tekniska lösningar
* Bidra till att bygga upp Apotekets interna kompetens inom generativ AI och stötta andra team i att utforska och använda tekniken i sitt arbete



  





**Vem söker vi?** 




 För den här rollen söker vi dig som drivs av att arbeta i teknikens framkant och som vill omsätta AI:s möjligheter till konkreta lösningar som skapar värde i verksamheten.
 



 Du har en stark teknisk grund och är van att ta ansvar för hela kedjan – från idé till drift. Samtidigt trivs du i en samarbetsorienterad miljö där du arbetar nära både teknik och verksamhet.
 



 Du är analytisk, lösningsorienterad och har förmågan att hantera komplexa problem. Du håller dig uppdaterad inom AI-området och har ett intresse av att kontinuerligt utveckla både dig själv och teamet.
 



  





**Vi ser att du har:** 



* Flera års erfarenhet av systemutveckling av komplexa system
* Erfarenhet av att designa och implementera lösningar självständigt
* Erfarenhet av att utveckla AI-baserade lösningar i praktiken
* God förståelse för LLM:er och hur AI-tjänster används i applikationer
* Erfarenhet av molnplattformar, gärna Azure
* Erfarenhet av CI/CD, DevOps och automatiserade deployments
* Stark helhetsförståelse – från behov till implementation och drift
* Erfarenhet av tekniker som Python, TypeScript, REST API:er och Docker
* Erfarenhet av att arbeta i team med ansvar för utveckling, drift och förvaltning
* Erfarenhet av att arbeta i organisationer med flera intressenter
* Du har mycket goda kunskaper i svenska, tal och skrift



  





**Vi erbjuder...** 



* Friskvårdsbidrag: 5000 kr per år.
* Personalrabatt: Förmånliga priser på många av våra produkter.
* Flexibla helgdagar: Möjlighet att byta arbetsfria helgdagar mot andra dagar på året.
* Förmånsportal (Benify): Erbjudanden inom bland annat kollektivtrafik, leasingbil, gym och hälsobehandlingar.
* Trygga försäkringar: Förstärkt föräldrapenning, tjänstepension (ITP) och kompletterande försäkringar.



**Om oss** 




 Apoteket grundades 1971 och ägs av svenska staten, vilket innebär att vi arbetar både ansvarsfullt och långsiktigt. Vårt viktiga samhällsuppdrag handlar om att förbättra människors hälsa, läkemedelsanvändning och bidra till ökad patientsäkerhet. Med omkring 400 apotek och 3000 medarbetare över hela landet har vi nära samarbete med hälso- och sjukvården – alltid med omtanke om både människor och miljö.
 



 Vårt mål är tydligt: Ett liv i hälsa, för alla.
 



**Praktisk information:** 




 Nyfiken? Det räcker gott.
 



 Hör av dig om rollen fångar ditt intresse! Vi berättar gärna mer om tjänsten och vår verksamhet – så du får en tydligare bild och kan avgöra om det känns helt rätt. Vänta bara inte för länge, urval och intervju sker löpande och tjänsten kan tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdatum.
 



 Skicka ditt CV tillsammans med svar på våra urvalsfrågor. Du behöver inte skriva ett personligt brev – frågorna är utformade för att hjälpa oss förstå mer om dina erfarenheter och kompetenser för matchning mot tjänst.
 



 Vi använder tester för objektivt urval som en del av vår rekryteringsprocess. Provanställning tillämpas.
 



 Välkommen till Apoteket!

title: Frontendutvecklare
description:
**Vill du utvecklas som frontendutvecklare i ett erfaret team där du får både stöd och eget ansvar?**
 Gjensidige är ett av Nordens ledande försäkringsbolag och ett av de största bolagen noterade på Oslo Börs. Vi är verksamma i Sverige, Norge och Danmark och har cirka 4 000 medarbetare. I Sverige är vi omkring 280 medarbetare som arbetar för att skapa trygga och innovativa lösningar för våra kunder.
   

  

 Vi befinner oss på en omfattande teknisk utvecklingsresa där vi moderniserar våra system, vidareutvecklar våra digitala tjänster och bygger lösningar som ska hålla över tid. Nu söker vi en frontendutvecklare som befinner sig i början av sin karriär och som vill utvecklas tillsammans med ett etablerat och erfaret team.
   

  

**Om rollen**
 Som frontendutvecklare blir du en del av ett tvärfunktionellt utvecklingsteam där du arbetar nära andra utvecklare, designers, arkitekter och verksamhetsexperter.
   

  

 Ditt huvudsakliga fokus blir att underhålla och vidareutveckla React-applikationer som används av både kunder och medarbetare. Arbetet omfattar såväl ny funktionalitet som förbättringar av befintliga lösningar, exempelvis inom användarupplevelse, tillgänglighet, prestanda, testning och teknisk kvalitet.
   

  

 I utvecklingen använder vi Gjensidige Builders, vårt gemensamma designsystem med återanvändbara komponenter och riktlinjer för att skapa enhetliga och tillgängliga digitala tjänster.
   

  

**Du kommer bland annat att:**
* underhålla och vidareutveckla webbapplikationer i React och TypeScript
* omsätta design och verksamhetsbehov till användarvänliga och tillgängliga lösningar
* arbeta med komponenter och riktlinjer från vårt etablerade designsystem
* felsöka, förbättra och modernisera befintlig kod
* skriva tydlig, underhållbar och testbar kod
* delta i kodgranskningar och tekniska diskussioner
* samarbeta med designers, backendutvecklare, arkitekter och verksamhetsrepresentanter
* delta i hela utvecklingsprocessen, från analys och implementation till produktionssättning och uppföljning
* successivt ta ett större ansvar för lösningar och leveranser


**Stöd, lärande och eget ansvar**
 Vi förväntar oss inte att du ska kunna allt från första dagen. Du får en ordentlig introduktion, löpande stöd från erfarna kollegor och möjlighet till mentorskap och teknisk vägledning.
   

  

 Samtidigt lägger vi stor vikt vid ditt eget driv. För oss innebär det att du aktivt tar ansvar för din utveckling, söker information, ställer frågor, ber om återkoppling och driver dina uppgifter framåt inom tydliga ramar.
   

  

 Du kommer inte att lämnas ensam med svåra problem, men vi förväntar oss att du själv tar initiativ till nästa steg och använder det stöd som finns omkring dig.
   

  

**Vi vill att du**
* har en relevant utbildning inom systemutveckling, datateknik, IT eller motsvarande
* är nyutexaminerad eller har något eller några års erfarenhet av frontendutveckling
* har arbetat med JavaScript eller TypeScript genom studier, egna projekt eller arbete
* har erfarenhet av React eller ett tydligt intresse för att fördjupa dig inom React
* har grundläggande kunskaper i HTML och CSS
* har intresse för användarupplevelse, tillgänglighet och kvalitet
* kan ta ansvar för dina uppgifter och kommunicera när du behöver hjälp
* uttrycker dig väl på svenska och engelska


 Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av något av följande:
   

  

* automatiserade tester för frontend
* Git och kodgranskning
* designsystem eller komponentbibliotek
* webbtillgänglighet och WCAG
* integrationer mot API
* CI/CD och GitHub Actions
* egna projekt, praktik eller arbetslivserfarenhet inom webbutveckling


**Vem är du?**
 Vi söker framför allt en person med rätt inställning och utvecklingspotential.
   

  

 Du är nyfiken, ansvarstagande och tycker om att förstå hur saker fungerar. När du stöter på ett problem försöker du själv komma vidare, samtidigt som du vet när det är dags att fråga om hjälp. Du tar gärna emot återkoppling och använder den för att förbättra både ditt arbete och din kompetens.
   

  

 Du trivs med att samarbeta, delar med dig av det du lär dig och bidrar till ett öppet arbetsklimat där teamet löser problem tillsammans.
   

  

**Därför ska du välja Gjensidige**
 Hos oss får du möjlighet att:
   

  

* utvecklas tillsammans med erfarna utvecklare och arkitekter
* få mentorskap, teknisk vägledning och kontinuerlig återkoppling
* arbeta med moderna frontendtekniker i en etablerad organisation
* bygga vidare på ett välutvecklat designsystem och gemensamma tekniska principer
* arbeta med lösningar som används i verkligheten och skapar värde för många människor
* successivt ta större tekniskt ansvar i takt med att du utvecklas
* bli en del av en kultur som präglas av samarbete, tillit och lärande


**Arbetsplats:** 
 Stockholm
   

  

 Vill du ta nästa steg i din utveckling och vara med och vidareutveckla Gjensidiges digitala tjänster? Skicka in din ansökan senast den 13 september. Har du frågor kan du gärna ta kontakt med rekryterande chef Jan Österhus, Jan.Osterhus@gjensidige.no
   

  

 Varmt välkommen med din ansökan!

title: Junior Product Developer to H&M
description:
**Job Description**

 Job Description
   

  





*Are you passionate about fashion, trends and the idea of creating an assortment that inspire and elevate the everyday wardrobe?*




*We are now looking for a curious and motivated Junior Product Developer to join our team at H&M. If you thrive in a fast paced and creative environment and want to grow your skills in product development, this is an opportunity to contribute to a global assortment that our customers love.*




*We are currently hiring for both temporary and permanent positions*




**WHAT YOU’LL DO**
  

 As a Junior Product Developer you will play an important role in the dynamic and multifaceted process of developing products for collections sold in all our markets around the world.
   

  





 Together with a close and collaborative accessories team, you will work on identifying and developing the right assortment based on upcoming trends, customer needs and commercial insights. Your main responsibility will be to support the Product Developer in creating a relevant and attractive offer for our customers, always guided by our strategy and targets.
   

  





 You will work closely with a Product Manager, Designers, Planners and other key functions throughout the development process. You will be an important link between teams, driving the process forward and ensuring smooth coordination from idea to final product.
   

  





 In this role, you will be part of the daily operational work, managing several parallel tasks. You will be involved in everything from sample handling to supporting the development of accessories that meet customer expectations and strengthen our commercial potential.
   

  





  

  





**WHO YOU ARE**
  

 We are looking for people with
   

  




* At least one year of experience in product development or buying in fashion
* Relevant education in fashion, buying or product development
* A commercial mindset with a strong drive to contribute to business growth
* A deep understanding of the womenswear customer and a sharp eye for fashion and trends
* A structured and organised way of working, with the ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously
* A collaborative and communicative approach, thriving in a cross functional environment with a humble and hands on attitude
* A curious mindset and eagerness to continuously learn and develop
* Strong commercial thinking, with the ability to spot opportunities for growth and profitability
* A passion for finding smarter ways of working and improving everyday tasks



  

  





**WHO WE ARE​**
  

 H&M Group is a global company of strong fashion brands and ventures. Our goal is to prove that there is no compromise between exceptional design, affordable prices, and sustainable solutions. We want to liberate fashion for the many, and our customers are at the heart of every decision we make.​
   

  





 We are made up of thousands of passionate and talented colleagues united by our shared culture and values. Together, we want to use our power, our scale, and our knowledge to push the fashion industry towards a more inclusive and sustainable future. ​
   

  





  

  





**JOIN US** 
  

  

 Additional information:
   

  

 We are currently hiring for both temporary and permanent positions. If you feel your experience, skills and ambitions are right for this role, please send your application including CV in English as soon as possible. Interviews will be held continuously. (For internal candidates, please initiate a dialogue with you manager before applying.)  If you are currently in a permanent employment with H&M you will keep your permanent employment even if you take on a temporary position for a limited time.
   

  





 Benefits:
   

  

 At H&M Group, we are proud to be a vibrant and welcoming company. We offer all our employees at H&M Group attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe. All our employees receive a staff discount card, usable on all our H&M Group brands in stores and online. Brands covered by the discount are H&M (Beauty and Move included), COS, Weekday, Monki, H&M HOME, & Other Stories, ARKET. In addition to our staff discount, all our employees are included in our H&M Incentive Program – HIP.
   

  





 Inclusion & Diversity:
   

  

 H&M is a part of H&M Group. At H&M Group, we’re determined to create and maintain inclusive, diverse and equitable workplaces throughout our organisation. Our teams should consist of a variety of people that share and combine their knowledge, experience and ideas. Having a diverse workforce leads to a positive impact on how we address challenges, on what we perceive possible and on how we choose to relate to our colleagues and customers all over the world. Hence all diversity dimensions are taken into consideration in our recruitment process.
   

  





 We strive to have a fair and equal process and therefore kindly ask you not to attach a cover letter in your application as they often contain information that easily can trigger unintentional biases.
   

  





  

  





**Take the next step in your career together with us. The journey starts here.**

title: Fullstack Engineer - Vitamin Well Group
description:
***Vitamin Well Group***

*develops premium functional drinks, snacks and protein products designed for modern, everyday life and on-the-go consumption. Our portfolio includes Barebells, NOCCO and Vitamin Well. With over 750 employees and revenue of more than SEK 10 billion, we are present in over 50 markets, with our headquarters in Stockholm and local teams and partners around the world. Our growth is driven by a focus on building strong brands, creating products with uncompromising taste and clear functionality, and consistently raising the bar across our categories.*
 We are building a small team to lead the technical foundation for the next phase of Vitamin Well Group's digital business. We work across e-commerce, internal tools and data, with AI integrated into how we build products, improve workflows and create better user experiences.
   

  

 Whether it’s making the shopping experience on our sites genuinely personal, building agentic analytics that make data more accessible and actionable across the business, or replacing manual internal workflows with agents that just get the job done, our focus is on building solutions that solve real problems and create long-term value.
   

  

 We combine engineering depth with a pragmatic, ship-focused approach, and we set the technical direction for how the digital business operates going forward.
   

  

**About the role**
 We are looking for a
 **Fullstack Engineer** 
 to build across the full stack: backend, frontend, data and e-commerce integrations.
   

  

 In this role, you will own problems end to end. You identify what needs to be built, choose the right tools for the job, and ship AI-driven products that teams and customers genuinely use and value.
   

  

 One week you might be wiring an LLM into a Shopify checkout flow to personalize recommendations; the next, building an internal agent that automates a manual workflow or improves how teams interact with data.
   

  

 Because both the team and the platform are new, you will have real influence over what we build, how we build it and what the technical foundation looks like for years ahead.
   

  

**Key responsibilities**
* Design and ship AI-powered features that improve the customer experience across our sites and e-commerce flows
* Integrate AI and agentic workflows into production systems, not prototypes
* Develop and integrate e-commerce functionality on Shopify, with AI woven into the experience
* Own solutions from scoping to deployment, including evals and monitoring for AI-driven functionality


**Who are you**
 You are a pragmatic problem solver who enjoys building and shipping products that create real impact. You have worked in scale-ups or smaller companies where the platform was new, the team was small, and you had to figure things out as you went.
   

  

 You understand where AI creates real value and how to apply it in practical ways across products, workflows and user experiences. You are AI native and use tools like Claude as a core part of how you build, solve problems and move quickly - not as a shortcut, but as a natural part of how you work.
   

  

 You combine technical range with a strong sense of ownership. You take initiative, move things forward independently and build solutions that are scalable, maintainable and genuinely useful for the people using them.
   

  

**What you will bring**
* 2-5+ years of experience with modern web development, including Python, REST APIs and frontend frameworks
* Hands-on experience with e-commerce platforms
* AI-first development practice, with expert level skills using tools like Claude as a core part of how you build
* A track record of shipping AI-driven products or functionality that customers or colleagues actively use day to day
* Strong understanding of data, including SQL, API integrations and data modelling in a modern data warehouse


**Welcome with your application at the latest September 10th 2026.**

*Please note that the recruitment process may take longer than usual due to the summer holiday period.*
**Life at Vitamin Well Group**
 At Vitamin Well Group, we believe that a great workplace fuels great products. With over 750 employees worldwide, our people play an important role in how we build brands, develop products and grow the business. Our values – innovation, courage, drive and responsibility – shape how we work together and how we do business.
   

  

 Across functions and markets, our teams are hands-on in building our brands, developing our products and making them available to consumers around the world. We embrace an office-first principle because we believe our best ideas emerge when people come together, share ideas, build relationships and take ownership.
   

  

 Promoting active lifestyles is part of our culture. Employees can take part in run clubs, group workouts, races and sporting events that suit different interests and fitness levels. As we continue to grow, we aim to make a positive impact by reducing our environmental footprint, promoting active and healthy lifestyles, and acting responsibly across our value chain.

title: Fullstack AI Developer (Python/React)
description:
**A Different Kind Of Job Description**
 At Filed, we believe in radical transparency. Everything is open: company finances, team salaries, stock options, anonymous team feedback. That extends to how we talk about this job, so what you'll read here looks a little different from other job ads. It starts with why this is a terrible job. Then it explains why it might be the best career move you'll ever make.
   

  

**Why this is a terrible job**
 This is an incredibly high-paced, high-tempo environment. We're making a generational bet to change all of our lives, and generational bets are not comfortable.
   

  

 You will build agents for subjective workflows. Tax law is objective, but what applies under it and how professionals interpret it is full of judgment. You can give two tax professionals the same task and get two different results where both are right. We're building agentic systems that have to reach their level of accuracy, not a level we decided is good enough. From an engineering standpoint, this is the hardest thing most of us have ever built. At times it will feel like hitting your head against the wall.
   

  

 Customers will sometimes get frustrated, because they expect deterministic results from probabilistic systems, and we're managing the expectations of some of the biggest firms in the world, including the Big Four.
   

  

 And the rhythm is real: we get to the office, we work, we go home and spend time with our families, and then many of us get back online to support our customers in US hours. It's tough. It's relentless.
   

  

**Why it might be the best career choice you'll ever make**
 It's addictive to be part of a business when you know you're winning. Filed is adding millions of dollars of revenue every quarter, customers are signing up in numbers, and in under two years we've become the market leader in a space with entrenched incumbents and a drastic need for new AI tools. When we come into head-to-heads with competitors, we win every time, because our product is superior. And we stay focused and diligent: we only work with tax firms that have the right expectations, which is why our typical customer is mid-market and enterprise.
   

  

 The industry looks boring from the outside, but the problem is unsolved, and the space has been riddled with products below the mark for decades. When you push through the wall, there's a spark of joy: a customer says "wow, this is phenomenal." That keeps happening.
   

  

 The opportunity here is not only to make a great deal of money. It's to have real impact on our mission: making this profession extraordinary. Nobody became a tax professional for the admin. They got into this work to be creative with tax law, to have fun, and to change the fabric of society. Filed enables them to do exactly that.
   

  

 We've raised $17.2 million to date, led by Northzone, and you can read the story in TechCrunch. Our focus now is to deliver the roadmap and continue to win.
   

  

**What You'll Build**
 As a Fullstack AI Developer, you'll build the agentic systems at the heart of Filed:
   

  

* Agentic workflows that mirror how tax professionals actually work, judgment call by judgment call
* Evaluation and verification systems that measure our accuracy against professional standards, not benchmarks we invented for ourselves
* The model integrations and tooling that turn probabilistic systems into something firms trust with high-stakes work


 You'll work at the frontier of applying AI to subjective domains, where two different answers can both be correct, and where shipping means earning the trust of professionals who scrutinize every output.
   

  

**What You'll Be Responsible For**
* Building and maintaining fullstack features across our AI tax prep, planning, and review products
* Owning the UX and backend logic for the workflows tax professionals use every day
* Shipping fast, watching metrics, and deciding what to improve next, without being told
* Making LLMs work for our customers to achieve higher accuracy and transparency
* Keeping the codebase clean, typed, and fast as we scale


**Your Hard Skillset**
* Comfortable in TypeScript, React, and Python: you've built complex, data-heavy UIs and backend services before
* Familiar with cloud infrastructure on Google Cloud and/or Azure
* Bonus if you've worked in fast-paced startups or regulated industries
* Even bigger bonus if you've taken a product from 0 to 1 and watched real users depend on it


**Your Soft Skillset**
* Comfortable being uncomfortable and making calls with incomplete data
* Empathetic and curious: building for the user, not just for clean code
* Highly collaborative across product, engineering, and tax
* Detail-oriented but pragmatic: you know when polish matters and when to ship
* You own your work and welcome the accountability that comes with it


**A championship team**
 We think of ourselves as a sports team. Incredibly high performance, incredibly high standards, and real success to show for it. Being a championship team means working with people who are deeply proud of the work they do and have great fun doing it together.
   

  

 We measure employee happiness constantly, and our eNPS is +60. We don't say that to brag. We say it because a team playing at this tempo only holds together if people genuinely love being on it. Every four months, the whole company comes together for an offsite.
   

  

**What Filed Stands For**
 Not posters. Not corporate language. Real operating standards.
   

  

* No problem is someone else's problem If you see it, it's yours. Bugs, customer confusion, missed expectations, internal friction. We don't pass problems sideways and we don't hide behind roles. You fix the typo even if you didn't write it, jump into a customer issue even if it's not your department, escalate early, and close loops fully. Ownership means you drive resolution, not that you suffer silently or burn out doing everything alone.
* Waiting is not a strategy Momentum is our advantage. We don't wait for perfect information or stall because something is unclear. You ship a V1 instead of debating V5, test instead of theorize, run small experiments instead of requesting big approvals, and propose solutions instead of just naming blockers. Speed is powerful. Sloppiness is not, and recklessness has no place in a high-trust industry.
* We run toward the fire When something breaks, we move. Tax is high-stakes and trust is fragile. We acknowledge issues immediately, communicate clearly and often, prioritize customer-impacting problems fast, and stay on it until it's fully resolved. Firefighting is a strength, not panic, and never an excuse for preventable mistakes.
* We win on customer experience AI will commoditize. Features will copy. Pricing will compress. Experience won't. We respond faster than customers expect, communicate proactively, think like a partner rather than a ticketing system, and anticipate needs before they're raised. Overdelivering means raising the standard of care, not overpromising, hero culture, or burning the team out.


**Who This Suits**
 This is a very fun environment, but it only suits people who meet the criteria we're looking for:
   

  

* People who want to win
* People who have a point to prove
* People who want to write their own job descriptions


**How We Pay**
 Nothing at Filed is behind closed doors. Everyone here sees everyone else's salary, because we believe transparency creates trust, and trust is the foundation of excellent teamwork. Compensation isn't a negotiation. Depending on your location, everyone receives the same three offers, and all of our offers are above market benchmarking.
   

  

 This role is assessed at Level 3 (Mid-Level). The salary and equity bandings are:
   

  

* Most Equity: 68,750 SEK per month + $150,000 of equity
* Great Equity: 75,000 SEK per month + $100,000 of equity
* Good Equity: 81,250 SEK per month + $50,000 of equity


 We run performance reviews every four months. Meet your goals and you can expect to double your equity by the end of your first year.
   

  

 One more thing, in the spirit of transparency: some people who apply for this role will be assessed at a different level. If the team determines your level of responsibility sits differently, we'll adjust the offer accordingly. If you know you're suited to a more senior role, don't shrink to fit. Apply to the Senior Fullstack AI Engineer role instead.
   

  

**Benefits**
* A minimum of 30 days of holiday per year, whether you're in Europe or the US
* In the US: fully covered medical expenses on platinum-level plans, with 100% coverage for your dependents as well
* In Europe: the full set of mandatory benefits, and more on top
* Company-wide offsites every four months


**The process**
* Quick intro call (30 minutes)
* Technical walkthrough and async task (60 minutes)
* Final round with our team (120 minutes)


 In just 3.5 hours, you'll be wanting early access, just like the rest of our team, to get into the stack and start building a generational company, even before your first day.
   

  

**About Filed**
**Filed is the AI tax preparer trusted by America's accounting firms.**
 Taxes might seem boring, but they are the $5 trillion backbone of the US economy. Globally, nearly $15 trillion in taxes is collected every year. Behind every dollar of it sits a professional making judgment calls, and the industry that does this work is breaking under a talent shortage no one has solved. We're fixing it. Today, hundreds of firms run Filed inside the systems they already use, and we're backed by Northzone, Neo, Analog, and Raine.
   

  

 There has never been a more exciting time to work on a problem this complex. Join us while "I was there when it all started" is still true.
