title: UX Designer - DesignOps
description:
We are on a mission to become the leading international force in residential property management. What we do matters to billions of people in their everyday lives.
   

  

 Residential real estate is the world’s largest asset class, and for most families, buying a home is the single biggest financial decision they will ever make. For too long, residential property management has fallen short of homeowners' and residents' expectations, and the industry is ready for change. Odevo was formed to make that change happen.
   

  

 In just six years, Odevo has grown more than 70-fold, establishing us as the leading international player. We are more than 14,000 people across the US, the UK, the Nordics, Germany, Spain, Portugal, Mexico, and Italy building Odevo. Together, we aspire to break new ground through innovation and cultivate a workplace where we help each other succeed, where ideas matter more than titles, and where kindness is a strength.
   

  

 By combining the power of people and technology, we set a new standard for how homes are managed. Our technology-enabled services simplify living for residents and create a better experience for property owners and boards.
   

  

 Our ambition is to continue our fast-growing journey through new customers, service expansion, and by partnering with great companies that share our mindset and ambition, both in existing and new markets.
   

  

 As we continue to grow, we stay true to who we are, challenge unnecessary bureaucracy, and keep decision-making close to our customers.
   

  

 If you share our mindset and ambition, we’d love you to join us and help accelerate our mission together.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We’re looking for a UX Designer with strong AI experience to help shape not only the products we design, but also how design is practiced, specified, scaled, and implemented across our global product organisation.
   

  

 This is a unique opportunity to join an industry still in an early stage of digital maturity, where you can have a significant impact. We see customer experience as a critical differentiator and an important part of our ambition to transform the global property management industry.
   

  

 You’ll join a global design team led by the Head of CX & UX in Stockholm, Sweden. This role combines hands-on UX and interaction design in our AI team with helping the wider design team scale quality, consistency, design systems, and AI-assisted product development workflows globally. You will collaborate with the global design team and support knowledge sharing across all our markets, including the UK, Europe, the US, and Mexico. As part of this role, you will shape both intuitive customer-facing experiences and complex internal workflows for property management employees.
   

  

 You will help mature how our design team works across markets, products, and disciplines. This includes improving design system structure, documentation, governance, and adoption; defining practical quality standards; and establishing clearer ways of working across Figma, design specifications, no-code tools, and AI-assisted development workflows.
   

  

 AI will be central to how we evolve our design practice going forward, balancing the efficiency of AI agents with the judgement, taste, and craft of experienced designers. Experience in both DesignOps and AI-assisted design and development will therefore be a strong advantage.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Work and lead the “ordinary” design process within product teams - translating user needs, business goals, and technical constraints into clear flows, prototypes, interaction design to test and learn iteratively.
* Define design practices for agent driven development workflows, and how design artefacts should be specified so they can be used effectively by designers, product managers, engineers, and agents. Eg specification formats, reusable prompts, design skills, MCPs, and validation methods.
* Define how design artefacts — such as user flows, service blueprints, prototypes, component specifications, interaction rules, and acceptance criteria — can better steer and validate AI-assisted implementation.
* Support more efficient research and validation practices, like how we evaluate product iterations and AI-generated outputs against user needs, design system standards, accessibility expectations, and product quality criteria. This includes, for example, defining/creating tools for research planning, recruitment processes, GDPR considerations, research templates, and maintaining a research repository.
* Lead the work with the Odevo design system(s) by improving component documentation, governance, accessibility standards, usage guidance, and alignment between design components/patterns and code.


**Who You Are**
 You are genuinely interested in understanding people’s needs, behaviours, and motivations, and you use that insight to shape services that deliver real value. You combine strong design craft with systems thinking and can move comfortably between user needs, business outcomes, service journeys, and detailed interaction design.
   

  

 You strive for quality, value collaboration over prestige, and enjoy contributing to a strong team culture. You are a strong communicator who can turn research insights and design rationale into shared understanding across teams and stakeholders.
   

  

 You enjoy making design work more legible, scalable, and repeatable. You care about the craft of design, but also about the systems, rituals, documentation, and standards that help teams deliver good design consistently. You are comfortable moving between hands-on product design and improving the underlying ways of working that support the wider design organisation.
   

  

 You are pragmatic about AI: curious and experimental, but also thoughtful about quality, trust, transparency, human oversight, and when AI should or should not be used.
   

  

**Experience**
* 5+ years of experience as a UX Designer, Product Designer, or similar role, working on complex digital products.
* Bachelor’s degree in design, HCI, behavioural science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Strong proficiency in Figma, prototyping, interaction design, UX research, service design, and design systems.
* Experience designing web and mobile products for complex, data-rich, workflow-heavy, or operational environments.
* Experience working in agile, cross-functional teams with product managers, engineers, designers, and stakeholders.
* Experience contributing to DesignOps and design systems, including documentation, governance, quality standards, tooling, ResearchOps, and alignment between design and code.
* Experience with AI-driven design or development workflows, including how structured specifications, component rules, interaction logic, and acceptance criteria can guide AI-assisted implementation.
* Experience designing AI-enabled product experiences, such as intelligent search, automation, recommendations, copilots, or decision-support tools.
* Property management or proptech experience is a plus.


**What We Offer**
* Professional growth - to work with the most talented developers in the industry.
* Modern technology - we invest in the latest technologies and tools and encourage our team members to share their ideas and take ownership of their work.
* Innovation - to work on exciting projects that push the boundaries of our industry and make a real impact.
* Commitment to quality - a dynamic and forward-thinking company that values profitable and long-term product development.


**Sounds like you?** 
 Apply today!
   

  

*If you have any questions about the role or recruitment process, feel free to contact Linnéa Berglund at* 
*linnea.berglund@odevo.com*

title: Senior Product Manager, Core Experience
description:
Banking hasn't changed much in decades. We're changing that. One product at a time.
   

  

 Lunar is a Nordic challenger bank building the future of financial life with AI at the core. Our engineers, designers, and product people work on problems that actually matter. Making money simpler, smarter, and more rewarding for millions of people across the Nordics.
   

  

 Fully licensed and founded in 2015, with offices in Copenhagen, Aarhus and Stockholm.
   

  

 We move fast, we build with purpose, and we're just getting started.
   

  

 As our new Senior Product Manager – Core Experience you'll join the Core Experience team based in Aarhus (Copenhagen and Stockholm also possible), reporting to Szymon, working to be the shared ground every other squad builds on, so Lunar feels like one thing, works every time, and asks almost nothing of the person using it.
   

  

**What will you do?**
* Own the information architecture. Decide how Lunar is organised and how people move through it, so the products we've built actually get discovered and adopted.
* Build the patterns, components and shared surfaces other squads build on, so a squad ships in days instead of weeks, and it still feels like Lunar when they're done.
* Set the quality bar and instrument it, so the org steers by evidence instead of debating taste in review meetings.
* Drive the craft — working with Design and Marketing to decide how Lunar looks, moves and sounds where customers actually meet it.
* Own how AI shows up in the app, setting the patterns that keep the experience coherent as more teams build with AI.
* Shape navigation and discovery across Consumer and Business, and get all of this done through other people, without formal authority over the squads you're changing — using evidence, a clear point of view, and by making the right thing the easy thing.


**What are we looking for in you?**
* Experience changing something structural in a consumer app people use daily — navigation, AI, onboarding, or another key journey.
* Experience moving a product's quality bar, whether within your own team or through influence across others.
* Taste and judgement — you can explain why something isn't good enough in a way people can act on.
* Technical enough that iOS, Android and web engineers want you in the architecture conversation.
* Nice to have: experience building for builders as well as customers (design systems, shared components, app platforms, developer tooling, or similar), experience putting AI-first products in front of real users, and experience in banking or another regulated business, ideally with Nordic context.


**Benefits and perks**
* 4 days in the office. We're a team that builds together, thinks together, and moves together. Showing up is part of how we work.
* State of the art equipment. The newest computer, monitor, mouse, and keyboard. We want you to do your best work without anything slowing you down.
* Pension, health insurance, and enhanced parental leave. From your financial future to your family moments. We've got you covered.


**Are you ready to join the journey? Apply now and let's find out more!**
 While you hold on tight for us to get back to you, curious to see what we're up to? Follow us on LinkedIn for business announcements and releases 📢, check out our Instagram for an inside scoop on what it's like to work here.
   

  

*Depending on the regulations in the country where you will be employed, we will ask to see or obtain information about your criminal record. Please note that our employment is conditional upon you not being registered in RKI (Ribers Kredit Information).*
 We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds. If you need any adjustments during the recruitment process, please let us know.

title: Brand Designer
description:
SCRL is one of Sweden's most successful tech companies you've probably never heard of.
   

  

 We build creative tools used by 7 million monthly active creators around the world. By combining design, technology and a deep understanding of how people create content, we're shaping the future of social media design.
   

  

 We've done it without raising venture capital or chasing headlines. Instead, we've focused on creating products people genuinely love and building a company with ambitious, thoughtful people who care deeply about their craft.
   

  

**The role**
 As a Brand Designer, you’ll help build SCRL’s visual identity and turn it into a distinctive, recognizable brand across every touchpoint.
   

  

 You’ll work across brand, website, campaigns, social, marketing, app launches and other creative initiatives. You’ll collaborate closely with the design leadership and other teams across SCRL to make sure everything we put into the world feels connected and intentional.
   

  

 This is a hands-on role. We’re looking for someone who can think big and conceptually, but who also enjoys opening Figma and making the work themselves. Someone who cares about the idea, but cares just as much about how it’s executed.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Evolve and strengthen SCRL’s visual identity and design language
* Develop creative concepts and campaigns that make SCRL stand out
* Design assets for web, social, app stores, launches and marketing
* Create visual systems, templates and guidelines that help the wider team work consistently
* Explore new visual directions and bring fresh ideas to the brand
* Help define and raise the creative quality bar across SCRL
* Contribute to the broader creative vision and visual culture of the team


**What We’re Looking For**
* 6+ years of experience in brand, visual or digital design
* A strong portfolio with distinctive, thoughtful and highly crafted work
* Excellent understanding of typography, composition, color and art direction
* Strong conceptual thinking and the ability to turn an idea into compelling visual work
* Experience designing for digital and social-first environments
* Strong attention to detail and a high bar for craft
* Comfortable moving between strategy, concepts and hands-on production
* Comfortable working in a fast-moving, collaborative environment
* Experience with Framer is a plus (website)
* Experience with motion is a plus


**The kind of person you are**
 You’re curious, visually driven and always looking for ways to make things better.
   

  

 You have strong taste and a clear point of view, but you’re not precious about your ideas. You can explain why something works, take feedback and quickly make it better.
   

  

 You care about the details, but you also know when to move fast. You’re comfortable figuring things out as you go and don’t need everything to be perfectly defined before you start.
   

  

**Most importantly, you want to build a brand, not just produce assets.**
**Why SCRL**
 This is a Stockholm-based role and we work together from our office near Slussen. We're builders at heart and believe great companies are created when talented people spend time together, challenge each other and move quickly towards ambitious goals.
   

  

 If you thrive in high-trust environments, enjoy a high bar for quality and want to help shape the next chapter of a profitable, product-led company, we'd love to hear from you.
   

  

 We’re a growing team based in central Stockholm, working closely across disciplines to build products people love. We care deeply about craft, collaboration and creating a place where everyone can learn and grow.

title: Directeur principal de l'engagement / Senior Engagement Director
description:
**Description & Requirements**
 Electronic Arts creates next-level entertainment experiences that inspire players and fans around the world. Here, everyone is part of the story. Part of a community that connects across the globe. A place where creativity thrives, new perspectives are invited, and ideas matter. A team where everyone makes play happen.
   

  

 (Pour visualiser la description de poste en français, veuillez sélectionner le français dans le menu déroulant au haut de la page sous "Select Language".)
   

  

 Holistic Visionary, Designer and Executor for World Class Meta Experiences.
   

  

 Battlefield is a storied franchise renowned for uncompromising combat gameplay and all-out warfare, for over two decades. 100 million players and 5 billion hours played later, Battlefield Studios is defining the future of the first-person shooter with the biggest launch in franchise history with Battlefield 6, and a new era beginning with a new free-to-play universe with Battlefield REDSEC.
   

  

 United under the banner of Battlefield Studios, 4 world-class teams across Criterion, DICE, Motive, and Ripple Effect have come together to focus on the future of the franchise, a connected Battlefield universe filled with immersive experiences built on our unique DNA.
   

  

 We are looking for a Senior Engagement Director to join us in our mission to create the most entertaining gaming franchise in the world—and to continually raise the bar for both Battlefield and the industry.
   

  

 In this highly visible leadership role, you will lead the vision and creation of a wildly entertaining and compelling meta experience for players - from fun and challenging progression systems that inspire players, to elegant economy designs that bring fun in rewards, to social systems that enable players to meet and connect with one another and UX and UI interfaces and designs that enable players to have the best experiences inside our iconic franchise.
   

  

 This role is ideal for candidates with strong creative skills to push boundaries and create new ones and are able to come up with designs that delight players. In addition, this leader enjoys working across teams and functions to both mine for the best ideas and to leverage talents for world-class implementation.
   

  

 What You’ll Do
   

  

* Create Wildly Entertaining Vision by defining and guiding the long-term direction for Progression, Economy, Social, and Engagement systems. Ensuring alignment with the overall game vision, product strategy and player experience goals.
* Mobilize world class teams to create the designs by evolving processes and structures within the design team and across disciplines—including technology and product management—to support shared, large-scale goals.
* Guide the world-class execution from high-level vision through implementation, iteration, and live operation
* Foster perpetual learning, improvement environment where diverse perspectives are valued and innovation thrives
* Master collaboration to inspire and unite teams across studios, time zones, operating within a multi-product environment - driving shared vision and exceptional player experiences.
* Communicate vision and intent, and design thinking - articulating goals, trade-offs, constraints, and risks to partners across design, product, engineering, UX, and leadership.
* Mentor, coach, and elevate talent around you - fostering growth, strengthening craft excellence, and building a resilient, high-performing design organization.


 What We’re Looking For
   

  

* 5+ years of experience leading game teams and defining player-focused meta systems and design direction in a live service environment.
* Experience and passion for meta design systems. Ways to keep players entertained across progression, social, and live services.
* Deep empathy and understanding of player needs and motivations.
* Demonstrated success in the gaming industry
* Strong understanding of mass-market player appeal, with the ability to innovate within established genres and expectations
* A player-first mindset balanced with strong product and business awareness


**Required Qualifications**
* At least one shipped title in a design creative leadership role working in Progression, Economy, and/or Social systems
* Love and passion for meta and design
* Excellent communicator and collaborator
* Thrives in leading cross-functional teams
* Demonstrated success in designing highly engaging games

title: Scrum Master
description:
**Jobbeskrivning**
 Sopra Steria söker en engagerad Scrum Master som vill vara med och stärka vårt växande team i Stockholm. Du har erfarenhet av att driva agila arbetssätt och brinner för digital transformation. I denna roll spelar du en central del i att hjälpa våra kunder att utvecklas och nå sina mål.
   

  

 Som Scrum Master coachar du våra agila team och säkerställer struktur, tempo och kontinuerlig förbättring. Med ditt inspirerande ledarskap skapar du förutsättningar för samarbete och tydlig kommunikation mellan produktägare, utvecklare och verksamhet. Du trivs i en dynamisk miljö där du får kombinera struktur, problemlösning och relationsskapande.
   

  

**Om dig**
 Som Scrum Master hos Sopra Steria blir du en nyckelperson i våra kunders agila leveranser. Du arbetar både som coach och facilitator och säkerställer att teamen följer agila principer och har rätt förutsättningar för att nå sina mål. Genom att främja samarbete, driva kontinuerlig förbättring och undanröja hinder hjälper du teamet att hålla fokus och skapa värde.
   

  

 Du får en central roll i våra kunders digitala transformation, där du vägleder utvecklingsteam, produktägare och andra intressenter mot ett mer agilt arbetssätt. Med ditt strukturerade och inspirerande ledarskap skapar du en miljö där teamen kan prestera, utvecklas och trivas.
   

  

**Vi ser gärna att du har:**
* Minst tre års erfarenhet av rollen som Scrum Master
* Erfarenhet av att leda och coacha utvecklingsteam
* Relevant högskole- eller universitetsutbildning
* Mycket goda kunskaper i både svenska och engelska
* Meriterande: erfarenhet som konsult
* Meriterande: teknisk bakgrund


**Varför välja Sopra Steria?**
* En plats där din kompetens verkligen gör skillnad – Vi bygger smarta och hållbara lösningar som förbättrar samhälle och verksamheter med användarupplevelsen i centrum.
* Stark företagskultur med Power of Sharing – Vi tror på kraften i kunskapsdelning, transparens och samarbete. Hos oss når vi längre tillsammans.
* Toppbetyg som arbetsplats – Great Place to Work har rankat oss år efter år som en av Sveriges bästa arbetsplatser och vi har mottagit utmärkelsen Karriärföretag flera år i rad.
* Del av en europeisk ledare inom digital transformation – Med över 50 000 experter i många länder kan vi både påverka stora projekt och ge dig möjligheter att växa globalt.
* Värderingar som genomsyrar allt vi gör – Vi sätter kundens behov i fokus, prioriterar respekt, professionalitet, nyfikenhet och en kollektiv förmåga att agera positivt och skapa hållbara resultat tillsammans.


**Ansökan**
 Nu vill vi gärna höra lite om dig! Ansök enkelt genom att antingen ladda upp ditt CV eller länka direkt till ditt LinkedIn-konto via annonsen. Om det fortfarande finns något du funderar över är du välkommen att kontakta rekryterande chef Marie Berg, marie.berg@soprasteria.com eller Talent Acquisition Partner Johan Westman, johan.westman@soprasteria.com
   

  

 Vi ser fram emot att få höra ifrån dig!
   

  

 På Sopra Steria ställer vi höga krav på både kompetens och säkerhetsmedvetenhet hos våra medarbetare. Innan en eventuell anställning kommer du därför att genomgå en bakgrundskontroll, och vid intervju behöver du kunna uppvisa giltig legitimation.

title: Game Product Owner (Slot Producer)
description:
Wanna be truly creative and work with a diverse gaming product from seed to actual released product? Maybe sick of releasing just one game every third or fifth year? Come join us as a game producer and be insanely creative and even be able to release your games before you are sick of them!
   

  

 We want to stand out and are not afraid to make games that changes the online slots industry. Are you the person that can drive our products to the next level? Then we are very interested in getting in contact with you. We want you to fulfil one of our two wishes; that you either come from the gaming industry, or even better, are working specifically with slot games and have great knowledge in casino products. You need to have a general passion for games!
   

  

**Job Description**
* Innovative thinker and daredevil that wants to create new and exciting game concepts.
* Making sure that the games teams run smoothly and can deliver badass slots.
* Guide and give feedback on game productions, not just your own.
* Create an excellent player experience and continuously improving our slot games production.
* Ready to work with all aspects of the product – development, math, compliance, marketing and sales.
* Research, play and study slot games and watch market trends and competitors.


 Who you are
   

  

* Passionate to create fun and exciting games.
* A person that can help our amazing team of developers create the best game in the casino market!
* You love to drive and create the game concepts and our way forward, to build a solid games portfolio together with our team.
* Can perfectly switch between working with developers one day and sales and customers the next.
* Excellent organizational and communication skills (a classic!)
* Not afraid to make tough decisions and kill your darlings.


 Beneficial skills
   

  

* Game production experience within iGaming or Gaming industry.
* Gaming and slots nerd.
* Proven project- and/or people management skills.
* Understanding of mathematical fundamentals of slots.


 Who we are
   

  

 We are the best and fastest growing slot provider in the world with the operator and product in focus, and the mobile future on our minds. Nolimit is a team of experienced professionals from the gambling industry in Stockholm, Sweden, Malta, Romania and Gurugram, India. Our company has derived from hands on work at some of the most successful gambling software providers and operators over the last 15 years. Our mission is to offer a fast, reliable and flexible team that cooperates with the best operators in the world, taking gambling to the next level.
   

  

 We have a clean code high performance modern mini/micro service portable system platform for mobile and desktop that is 100 % under our own control. We have no dependencies on other systems, which allows us to deliver special features and smooth, customizable marketing campaigns that are tailored to the operator's specific needs. We think it's time for a new angle to the gambling software industry – one where the product is in focus and we fully engage their promotion, marketing and country manager system/activities with our games. Nolimit work with customers on a global scale and the largest gambling operators in the world have our games everywhere.
   

  

 Nolimit City, Stockholm based development team. We provide you with your choice of OS and IDE.
   

  

 Send your application to hr-sweden@nolimitcity.com
   

  

 http://www.nolimitcity.com

title: Customer Success Manager (Junior)
description:
**Do you want to join the technological revolution?** 
*Tendium is looking for an* 
*ambitious individual in a customer-facing role, ready for the next step in their career!*
**About Tendium**
 Tendium is the global pioneer in AI-driven public tender management, transforming how companies discover, analyse, and win government contracts. Our platform turns complex processes into something simple and transparent, empowering businesses to compete fairly for billions in public sector opportunities. We’ve been building our AI-native platform since 2018, leveraging a vast data moat, agentic AI, and tens of thousands of hours of R&D. Today, we serve large numbers of customers across Europe and are rapidly scaling.
   

  

***If you want to know more about our culture and what you can expect when working at Tendium you can read more about it***
*here.*
 The Job
   

  

 As a Customer Success Manager, you will play a crucial role in ensuring our customers achieve success using our platform. You'll work closely with existing customers in the SME segment to secure renewals and identify opportunities for upselling and cross-selling. This position offers a blend of relationship building and technical support, making sure our customers get the most out of our product.
   

  

 You’ll be part of our sales team, collaborating with marketing, sales, and product teams. We are looking for someone who is comfortable with both hands-on customer support and proactively identifying growth opportunities.
   

  

**As a Customer Success Manager at Tendium, your main focus will be to:**
* Onboard, build and maintain strong relationships with customers to understand their goals, challenges, and pain points.
* Develop and execute a customer success plan to help customers achieve their desired outcomes and business goals.
* Provide ongoing support and guidance to customers using our platform.
* Monitor and analyse customer usage and provide recommendations to improve the adoption and usage of our platform.
* Engage with customers to ensure that they renew their subscriptions for our platform.
* Identify upsell and cross-sell opportunities and work with the sales team to close deals.
* Be the voice of the customer and provide feedback to our product and engineering teams to improve our platform.
* Collaborate with the marketing team to create customer case studies, testimonials, and other materials that showcase the success of our customers.
* Resolve customer issues and ensure customer satisfaction.
* Measure and report on customer success metrics, such as retention rate, customer satisfaction score (CSAT), and net promoter score (NPS).


 Who We Are Looking For
   

  

 We are looking for someone with experience in a customer success or customer-facing role within the tech or SaaS sector. To excel in this role, we believe you are entrepreneurial, proactive, and skilled at taking initiative and managing your own projects. As a key point of contact for our customers, strong communication and relationship-building abilities are essential.
   

  

 Since you will be working at a leading SaaS company, it's crucial that you can quickly adapt to and stay ahead of the ongoing technical evolution of our product.
   

  

**You Have**
* Experience in a customer facing role within the SaaS/tech sector.
* Excellent communication and relationship-building skills.
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple customer accounts simultaneously.
* Familiarity with AI technologies and an ability to adapt to new technologies.
* Strong organisational skills with a keen attention to detail.
* Proficient in Swedish and in English
* Experience can come from either a business, sales, customer-facing, operational, or procurement-related background.


**Bonus (but Not Mandatory) If You Have**
* Bachelor's degree in business, marketing, or a related field.
* Experience with Customer Relationship Management (CRM) tools such as HubSpot or Salesforce.
* Experience in a fast-paced start-up environment.
* Experience and/or knowledge of public procurement processes.
* Fluency in Norwegian or any additional European language is a plus.


 Application
   

  

 We look forward to your application. We recruit on an ongoing basis, so apply as soon as possible. Successful candidates will initially be invited to an initial interview where you will have the opportunity to meet the team.
   

  

 Please find additional information on our recruitment process
 *here.*
 To make this process even more efficient, feel free to sign in to your Connect profile and add your references at any stage.
   

  

 If you’re ready to make an impact and grow with us, we want to hear from you.
   

  

 \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_
   

  

**Equality and inclusion statement**
 At Tendium, we value and celebrate diversity. We’re building a workplace where everyone feels that they belong, where your voice is heard, and your experiences are respected. Different perspectives fuel our creativity and drive innovation, and we’re always looking for people who can bring something new to the team. Whoever you are, wherever you're from, we’d love to hear from you.
   

  

 Let’s shape the future together.
   

  

 At Tendium we’re using data to transform public procurement, giving our clients better access to public tenders and helping governments to curb waste and enhance transparency.
   

  

 For more information contact career@tendium.com

title: Social Media Manager
description:
**Established in 1986 in the Swedish mountains, our love for skiing in untouched terrain and embarking on adventures in the wild run deep. Our purpose is simple: to bring this freeride spirit to the world. With our products, we aim to make adventures possible 365 days a year.** 




  





**We are driven by passion, togetherhood, responsibility and winning spirit. We know that an inspiring spread of unique abilities and personalities contribute to our dynamic culture and our success. Now, we are looking for a new talent to join our team.** 




  





 As
 **Social Media Manager** 
 you own Peak Performance’s Global Social Media Strategy across Instagram, TikTok, YouTube and LinkedIn, translating our long-term strategic plan into a content calendar aligned with brand objectives and campaigns across all channels and regions.
 



  





 Working closely with Brand Marketing, PR, E-commerce, athletes and creative teams, you lead on strategy, budgeting, campaign amplification and reporting, and guide expansion markets on social media approach. You work closely with our Social Content Creator, creating content plans to ensure output is high-quality and aligned with our brand values and growth objectives.
 



  





 You build strong relationships with partners, collaborators and stakeholders, and use performance insights and KPI analysis to continuously sharpen our strategy and keep Peak Performance relevant, distinctive and impactful across all social channels.
 



  





 The position is based at our headquarters in Stockholm and reports to the Head of Global Communications.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 



* Own and evolve Peak Performance’s Global Social Media Strategy across Instagram, TikTok, YouTube and LinkedIn, translating brand and business goals into a content calendar aligned with campaigns across all channels and regions.
* Own the Global Social Media Calendar and support brand campaign amplification, including shot lists, shoot creative advisory, BTS/on-site capture planning, asset selection and posting.
* Proactive and reactive community management, fostering meaningful engagement with our audience by actively managing online communities, responding to enquiries, and building relationships with followers and brand advocates.
* Define target audiences and ensure content is strategically split and tailored accordingly.
* Provide channel insight, creative ideas and functional point of view during seasonal creative and go-to-market processes, working closely with the creative and art team.
* Collaborate with creative, PR, and brand marketing teams to develop platform-specific content that resonates with audiences and enhances brand storytelling.
* Act as a key partner to local teams, and partner brands, providing guidance on global strategy implementation and adapting content for regional relevance
* Own the digital transformations of all channels, updating strategies where needed to maximize channel updates.
* Lead seasonal, campaign and yearly reporting, using KPI insight to inform future planning and strategy.
* Provide direction and guidance to the Social Content Creator, reviewing and approving content plans to ensure high-quality output aligned with our long-term social media strategy.



  





**Who we think you are:** 



* A strategic and hands-on social media leader who combines strong storytelling instincts with a track record of translating brand strategy into channel performance, leading by example and actively contributing to day-to-day content and channel execution
* Digitally curious, with a great understanding of social media trends and platform updates.
* Comfortable owning a budget and making confident calls on where to invest for impact.
* A natural collaborator, equally at ease briefing creative teams, aligning stakeholders, or working closely with content specialists.
* Analytical and able to turn KPI data and platform insights into clear recommendations for future planning.



  





**Job Requirements:** 



* Proven experience leading social media strategy and channel management, ideally within fashion, sports or lifestyle brands, with 5+ years of experience in a brand or agency environment.
* Proven expertise in content creation, community management, social media publishing and analytics.
* Confident owning and tracking a social media budget, including cost approvals and spend reporting.
* Comfortable using performance data and platform insights to inform reporting and future strategy.
* Strong technical skills with social media management tools (e.g., Sprout Social, Hootsuite) and analytics platforms (e.g., Google Analytics, native platform insights).
* Good understanding of content production processes (photo/video) and able to advise creative teams on social-first formats. Light touch editing required.
* Fluent in English, written and spoken. Additional languages are a plus.



  





**What we offer:** 




 We offer you an inspiring work environment where our values of Passion, Togetherhood, Responsibility and Winning Spirit are at the core of everything we do, promoting creativity, teamwork, accountability, and progress. You get the opportunity to work with a great team that shares your passion for sports and outdoor life. We are on a growth journey, finding our line and building our future success. That provides interesting challenges and possibilities in all roles for the person who is curious and likes to get things done. We’re small enough for you to play a key role regardless of your position, but big enough to have a global presence. At Peak Performance, you get the best of both worlds.
 



  





 To live our brand, we also offer
 


* Workout classes and yoga classes in our Training Box at HQ
* Sports Hour – 1 hour training on Fridays (activity of your own choice)
* Mountain house & Apartment in Åre. Available for rent and team activities.
* Health care allowance – 3000 SEK per year
* Pension advisory via Linder & Partners
* Skandia Health Insurance



  





 If our values inspire you and you share our passion for outdoor sports and products that combines style and performance, we want you to join our winning team. Apply now and unlock your freeride spirit!

title: Frontendutvecklare
description:
Startdatum: 2026-10-01
   

  

 Slutdatum: 2027-09-30 med option på förlängning
   

  

 Omfattning: 100%
   

  

 Plats: 3-4 på plats i Stockholm
   

  

**Uppdragsbeskrivning**
 Vi söker en erfaren frontendutvecklare till ett utvecklingsteam som arbetar med moderna och verksamhetskritiska webblösningar. Uppdraget passar dig som har en stark teknisk grund inom frontend och är van att utveckla i miljöer där flera system, team och gemensamma tekniska komponenter behöver fungera tillsammans.
   

  

 Rollen har ett tydligt fokus på React, TypeScript och Next.js. Du kommer att arbeta genom hela utvecklingsprocessen, från tekniska vägval och implementation till kvalitetssäkring och automatiserad testning. Tillgänglighet och långsiktigt hållbar kod är viktiga delar av arbetet.
   

  

**Exempel på arbetsuppgifter:**
* Utveckla och vidareutveckla moderna webbgränssnitt med React, TypeScript och Next.js.
* Bygga automatiserade tester och säkerställa hög kvalitet i frontendlösningen.
* Samarbeta inom ett tvärfunktionellt featureteam och koordinera tekniska beroenden med andra utvecklingsteam.
* Arbeta med gemensamma komponenter, autentiseringslösningar och delade datakällor.
* Säkerställa att utvecklade gränssnitt följer etablerade riktlinjer för webbtillgänglighet.
* Bidra till tekniska vägval, kodkvalitet och en hållbar frontendarkitektur.


**Skall-krav**
* Relevant högskoleutbildning inom exempelvis datateknik, IT, medieteknik eller motsvarande datorrelaterat område.
* Minst 5 års professionell erfarenhet av webbutveckling med moderna SPA-tekniker såsom React, Angular, Vue eller Svelte, varav minst 3 år med React och TypeScript.
* Minst 2 års praktisk erfarenhet av Next.js.
* Minst 3 års erfarenhet av automatiserad frontendtestning med exempelvis Jest, Jasmine, React Testing Library eller Cypress.
* Minst 3 års erfarenhet från featureteam och komplexa tekniska miljöer med beroenden till exempelvis autentisering, gemensamma komponentbibliotek, datakällor eller andra team.
* Minst 3 års praktisk erfarenhet av att utveckla enligt WCAG och etablerade principer för digital tillgänglighet.


**Meriterande**
* Erfarenhet av nära samarbete med UX, designsystem och principer inom Atomic Design.
* Erfarenhet av strukturerad code review samt av att fatta tekniska beslut kring frontendarkitektur, verktyg och arbetssätt.
* Erfarenhet av utveckling i monorepo-baserade kodbaser.
* Erfarenhet av CI/CD och automatiserade leveransflöden.

title: Scrum Master till Axfood IT, Stockholm
description:
Välkommen till Axfood IT, en av matbranschens största IT-avdelningar med nästan 400 medarbetare. Det är vi som ser till att Axfood, och alla våra kedjor, kan ligga i framkant vad gäller digital utveckling. Vi jobbar med att utveckla och förbättra allt ifrån e-handel till logistiklösningar och AI.
   

  

 Hos Axfood IT blir du del av ett sammanhang som utmanar och levererar lösningar som gör skillnad, både för våra kollegor och våra kunder. Här finns det alltid möjlighet att lära sig om ny teknik och växa, både som individ och tillsammans med kollegorna.
   

  

**Ditt nya team**
 Välkommen till IT Core som är ett av Axfood IT:s mest tekniknära team, med ansvar för plattformar, nätverk, operativ säkerhet och IAM. Du kommer att tillhöra IAM-teamet som arbetar med daglig hantering och vidareutveckling av områden som privilegierad åtkomst (PAM), certifikat (PKI), SAP-behörigheter och integrationer mot Microsofts Entra ID. Teamet arbetar med att kontinuerligt förbättra och utveckla vår IAM plattform.
   

  

 Just nu genomför teamet en strategisk transformation mot en sammanhållen IAM-plattform i linje med Axfood IT:s målbild. Du blir en del av ett tekniskt team med ett tydligt förändringsuppdrag. Arbetet innebär nära samarbete inom teamet och med andra produkt- och plattformsteam, där gemensam planering, tydliga prioriteringar och fungerande arbetssätt är avgörande för att lyckas.
   

  

**Ett ax-plock – Kollegornas favoriter på jobbet**
* Teknik som är central för hela Axfood – IAM berör stora delar av IT-landskapet och verksamheten.
* Stor möjlighet att påverka – vi befinner oss mitt i en förflyttning där både plattform och arbetssätt utvecklas.
* Hög specialistkompetens – du arbetar tillsammans med erfarna specialister inom flera delar av IAM.
* Variation och många kontaktytor – från säkerhet och infrastruktur till utveckling och verksamhetsnära lösningar.


**Om rollen**
 Som Scrum Master får du en central roll i IAM-teamets transformation. Ditt uppdrag är att skapa goda förutsättningar för teamet att arbeta effektivt, samarbeta väl och kontinuerligt förbättra sina arbetssätt.
   

  

 Du leder inte genom att fördela uppgifter, utan genom att coacha teamet, facilitera rätt dialoger och hjälpa gruppen att komma vidare när hinder uppstår. Du arbetar nära teamets produkt- eller plattformsägare och samordnar beroenden med andra team.
   

  

**Dina arbetsuppgifter kommer att inkludera:**
* Coacha teamet i agila arbetssätt och kontinuerlig förbättring
* Facilitera planering, uppföljning, retrospektiv, workshops och andra forum som stärker teamets leveransförmåga
* Identifiera och undanröja hinder som påverkar teamets framdrift
* Arbeta nära produkt- och plattformsansvariga för att skapa tydlighet kring mål, prioriteringar, kapacitet och leverans
* Skapa förutsättningar för engagemang, kreativitet och kvalitet i leveranserna
* Samordna arbetssätt och beroenden med andra produkt- och plattformsteam
* Synliggöra teamets kapacitet och behov av kompetens eller resurser
* Hjälpa teamet att hantera beroenden och komplexitet i en miljö med flera parallella initiativ
* Driva kontinuerlig förbättring utifrån teamets faktiska behov och leveransförmåga


**Din nya chef har ordet**
*Vi söker inte någon som bara håller ihop våra agila forum. Jag vill att vår Scrum Master utmanar oss, hjälper oss att prioritera och skapar förutsättningar för teamet att ta ett större gemensamt ansvar för våra leveranser. IAM står inför en stor förflyttning och du kommer att få en viktig roll i hur vi lyckas med den.* 
 - Jeanette Thorell Roldin, Tech Platform Area Manager
   

  

**Stämmer detta in på dig?**
 För att trivas i rollen tror vi att du har erfarenhet av att arbeta som Scrum Master eller i ett liknande coachande uppdrag i en agil IT-miljö. Du skapar förtroende genom att vara lyhörd och tydlig, samtidigt som du vågar utmana arbetssätt och hjälpa teamet framåt. Eftersom uppdraget innehåller flera kontaktytor tror vi också att du trivs med att samordna frågor och bygga goda samarbeten över teamgränser.
   

  

**Vi tror att det är viktigt att du har:**
* Erfarenhet av agila arbetssätt
* Erfarenhet av att facilitera workshops och utveckla teamets processer
* Förmåga att coacha team och individer utan formellt personalansvar
* Förmåga att identifiera hinder och driva frågor framåt
* God kommunikativ förmåga på både svenska och engelska
* Lätt för att samarbeta med både tekniska specialister och andra intressenter


 Kunskap om DevSecOps och certifiering inom Scrum Master eller SAFe är meriterande, men inte ett krav.
   

  

**Ansökningsprocessen**
 Vi vill att det ska vara enkelt att söka jobb hos oss. Om du inte har ett CV redo räcker det med att du länkar en väl ifylld LinkedIn-profil. I din ansökan får du svara på de frågor vi behöver svar på i den här delen av processen, och personligt brev är därför inte obligatoriskt.
   

  

 Vi hanterar ansökningar löpande och tjänsten kan därför tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag. Vår rekryteringsprocess innehåller tester, intervjuer, bakgrundskontroll och ID-kontroll. Observera att vi inte under denna rekryteringsprocess kommer be dig logga in med ditt Bank-id eller scanna någon QR-kod, men vi kommer be dig styrka din identitet i processens slutskede.
   

  

 Vid frågor om rekrytering på Axfood, kontakta Medarbetarsupporten eller läs mer: Så går det till när du söker jobb inom Axfood. Om du har frågor om tjänsten, kontakta elisabeth.wehlin@axfood.se. Av GDPR-skäl behandlar vi inga ansökningar eller annan personlig information via mail.
   

  

 Läs mer och se filmer om Axfood som arbetsgivare här: Din karriärväg hos Axfood | Utveckling och möjligheter | Axfood

title: Hospitality Agent
description:
**About the job** 


 Would you like to join an exciting growth journey and be part of a team shaping the future of short-term rentals?
 





 Guestit is looking for a
 
**Hospitality Agent** 

 to join our Stockholm team. This is a varied and hands-on role combining
 
**guest service, property operations and problem-solving** 

 , with one clear goal: ensuring that every guest has a smooth and memorable stay.
 





 You will support our guests throughout their stay, primarily through digital communication, while also helping ensure that our rental properties are maintained, prepared and operating according to the standards we promise.
 





 No two days are exactly the same. One moment you may be helping a guest solve an issue through Airbnb, and the next coordinating a supplier, inspecting a property or handling an urgent operational task on-site.
   





**About Guestit** 


 Guestit is the leading short-term rental company in the Nordics, with operations in Stockholm, Gothenburg and Åre. In Stockholm, we manage more than 400 properties and are growing by over 50% annually.
 





 Our ambition is to expand into new Nordic markets while continuously improving the quality, efficiency and guest experience across everything we do.
   





**Your role** 


 As a Service Agent, you will work across both
 
**guest communication and portfolio operations** 

 .
 





 You will communicate directly with our guests, primarily through digital channels such as Airbnb, chat and email, helping them with questions and resolving issues quickly and professionally.
 





 At the same time, you will work hands-on with our properties to ensure they are ready for guests and maintained to a high standard. Many operational issues are identified through guest conversations, which means you will often take ownership of a problem from the first guest message all the way through to resolution.
 




  






 The role follows a scheduled shift pattern, including evenings and weekends on a rotating basis.
   





**Key responsibilities** 


 Your responsibilities will include, but are not limited to:
 



* Communicating with guests through digital platforms, chat and email, responding to questions and resolving issues efficiently and professionally.
* Managing guest expectations and proactively contributing to high guest satisfaction throughout the stay.
* Identifying operational or maintenance issues based on guest feedback and ensuring they are resolved.
* Inspecting rental properties, resolving issues and identifying opportunities for improvement.
* Handling practical tasks and minor repairs in properties, such as adjusting blinds and curtains, assembling furniture or resolving other everyday maintenance issues.
* Coordinating with internal teams and external suppliers, such as cleaners, locksmiths and plumbers, and following up to ensure issues are resolved.
* Personally handling urgent operational tasks when necessary, such as express cleaning, deliveries or preparing a property for additional guests.
* Taking ownership of guest-related problems from identification through to resolution.
* Reviewing, developing and documenting processes to improve our guest experience, property standards and operational efficiency.
* Collaborating closely with colleagues to ensure smooth daily operations across our Stockholm portfolio.


**Your profile** 


 You are service-minded, hands-on and enjoy solving problems. You take responsibility and are comfortable making decisions independently while knowing when to involve colleagues or external partners.
 





 You understand that excellent hospitality is not only about friendly communication – it is also about taking action and making sure problems are actually solved.
 





 You enjoy a role where your days can vary and where you combine customer interaction with practical operational work. You are comfortable moving between digital guest communication and being physically present at our properties when needed.
 





 Experience from hospitality, short-term rentals, property operations, customer service or a similar environment will give you a strong foundation for succeeding in the role.
   





**Qualifications** 


 We believe you will be a great fit if you have:
 



* At least 1–2 years of relevant experience in hospitality, customer service, property operations, maintenance or a similar field.
* Experience working directly with guests or customers and a strong understanding of what creates excellent customer satisfaction.
* **Strong problem-solving skills and a high sense of responsibility.**
* A practical mindset and willingness to handle hands-on tasks when needed.
* Good IT skills and confidence using digital tools in your daily work.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
* **Professional fluency in English; Swedish is highly valued and additional languages are considered an advantage.**
* Ability to work both independently and as part of a team.
* **A valid category B driving licence.**




 Nice-to-haves:
 



* Experience with property maintenance, repairs or installations is an advantage.
* Basic knowledge of areas such as electrical work, construction, plumbing, HVAC or carpentry is considered a plus.



  




**What we offer** 
* We offer full-time or part-time employment with a six-month probationary period, followed by permanent employment.
* Hourly pay 130kr-160kr
* A role based in the Stockholm region.
* Start date as soon as possible.

title: Customer Success Manager
description:

 Evam builds mission-critical technology for the people who keep society safe. Our software is used by police, ambulance, fire & rescue, and other public safety organisations to manage complex, time-critical operations. Every day, Evam supports first responders handling hundreds of thousands of life-threatening incidents. We currently serve customers across the Nordics and the United Kingdom and have achieved 200%+ annual growth for the past three years.
 



  





  





**About the Role** 




  





 To support our continued expansion, we are now looking for a Customer Success Manager. title: Learning & Development Specialist
description:
Vill du vara med och utveckla PostNord Sveriges arbete med lärande, kompetensutveckling och ledarskap?
   

  

 Vi söker dig som brinner för ledarutveckling, kontinuerligt lärande och långsiktig kompetensutveckling. Som Learning & Development Specialist arbetar du med hela kedjan, från att identifiera behov och utveckla koncept till att bygga utbildningar och andra utvecklingsinsatser, samt själv facilitera och genomföra dem.
   

  

 Våra ledare och medarbetare finns på många olika platser runt om i landet och en stor del av våra utvecklingsinsatser genomförs därför digitalt. Det ställer krav på att du kan skapa lärande som engagerar, involverar och ger effekt även när deltagarna inte befinner sig i samma rum.
   

  

**Om rollen**
 Du får en central roll i utvecklingen av PostNord Sveriges arbete med lärande och utveckling. I nära samarbete med verksamheten fångar du upp behov och omsätter dem till relevanta koncept, arbetssätt och utvecklingsinsatser som skapar effekt och bidrar till verksamhetens utveckling.
   

  

 I rollen arbetar du nära Group HR och övriga bolag och bidrar med PostNord Sveriges behov och perspektiv i det koncerngemensamma arbetet med ledarutveckling. Du omsätter gemensamma ramverk och initiativ till lösningar som fungerar i den svenska verksamheten.
   

  

**Du Kommer Bland Annat Att**
* Utveckla moderna och verksamhetsnära koncept inom lärande, kompetens- och ledarutveckling
* Bygga utbildningar, workshops, moduler och andra utvecklingsinsatser utifrån identifierade behov
* Facilitera och genomföra utbildningar och utvecklingsinsatser för olika målgrupper
* Hitta smarta och engagerande sätt att skapa lärande digitalt i en geografiskt spridd organisation
* Bidra till struktur och samordning inom lärande och utveckling
* Säkerställa att våra insatser stödjer verksamhetens strategi, kultur, förändringsagenda och framtida kompetensbehov
* Stötta verksamhet, chefer och HR med specialistkompetens inom lärande, kompetensutveckling och ledarutveckling.
* Initiera och driva utvecklingsinitiativ tillsammans med olika delar av organisationen
* Följa upp effekten av våra insatser och använda data och återkoppling för fortsatt utveckling
* Omvärldsbevaka och identifiera nya sätt att arbeta med lärande och utveckling


 ,
   

  

**Vem du är**
* Strategisk och genomförandestark, med förmåga att omsätta verksamhetens behov till konkreta och effektiva utvecklingslösningar
* Kommunikativ och engagerande, med mycket god förmåga att facilitera, skapa delaktighet och bygga samsyn
* Strukturerad och tydlig, med förmåga att skapa riktning och framdrift i komplexa sammanhang med många intressenter och beroenden
* Du är unik, och vi lägger stor vikt vid dina personliga egenskaper


**Vad du tar med dig**
* Relevant akademisk utbildning
* Flerårig erfarenhet av kvalificerat arbete med ledarutveckling på både strategisk och operativ nivå, samt erfarenhet av lärande och kompetensutveckling.
* Erfarenhet av att självständigt utveckla och implementera utvecklingskoncept och program i en större organisation
* Erfarenhet av att driva kompetensutvecklingsinitiativ tillsammans med chefer, HR och andra intressenter
* God kunskap om ledarutveckling, förändringsledning, grupputveckling samt metoder för lärande och kompetensutveckling
* Relevant certifiering inom exempelvis ledarutveckling, facilitering, coaching eller lärande är meriterande


**Varför vi finns**
 PostNord är ett av Sveriges äldsta och största företag och vi har ett viktigt samhällsuppdrag, att säkerställa postservice till företag och privatpersoner i hela Sverige. Vi är i en ständig transformation och arbetar konsekvent med att utveckla både vårt erbjudande och våra medarbetare. Som den ledande leverantören av kommunikationslösningar till, från och inom Sverige förenklar vi vardagen för människor. Hos oss arbetar människor med olika bakgrund och erfarenheter och du blir en del av en arbetsplats som aktivt arbetar med mångfald.
   

  

**Välkommen med din ansökan**
 Urval och intervjuer sker löpande. Har du frågor om tjänsten? Mejla till Susanna Aronson, Senior Talent Acquisition Partner på susanna.aronson@postnord.com
   

  

 Vi ser fram emot att höra ifrån dig!

title: Atlassian Consultant (Nordic)
description:
As an Atlassian Consultant, you’ll lead projects, advise clients and help teams across the Nordics work better with Jira, Confluence and Jira Service Management.
   





**Who will I be** 
**working with?** 


 Seibert Solutions Denmark is an Atlassian Solution Partner based in Copenhagen and part of the Seibert Group family. With around 400 employees and headquarters in Wiesbaden, Germany, Seibert Solutions is a leading Atlassian Platinum Partner.
 





 We help organizations across the Nordics make better use of tools like Jira, Confluence and Jira Service Management – from implementations and cloud migrations to platform governance and AI-supported workflows.
 





 We are a small team with short decision-making paths and lots of direct contact with our clients. You’ll work closely with both customers and colleagues and have plenty of room to shape your projects and the way you work.
 





 As an Atlassian Consultant (Nordic), you’ll take ownership of your projects from the first workshop through to go-live and beyond. You’ll work closely with clients in Denmark, Sweden and Norway and help them improve the way they collaborate and manage their work – in Danish, Swedish or Norwegian.
 





 This is a remote-first position. You can be based in Sweden, Norway or the Copenhagen area. If you live close to Copenhagen, you’re also welcome to use our office whenever you like. Some travel to customers across the Nordics will be part of the role.
   





**Which tasks** 
**may I expect?** 


 You’ll do more than configure Atlassian tools. You’ll understand what our clients are trying to achieve and help them find solutions that work for their organization.
 



* **Run projects independently:** 

 You’ll implement Jira, Confluence and Jira Service Management, handle migrations (for example, on-premise to Cloud, Server to Data Center or site merges) and take responsibility for complex projects with different stakeholders.
* **Advise clients on their setup:** 

 You’ll design solutions based on best practices, advise on deployments, licensing and infrastructure, and make sure requirements are clearly documented.
* **Lead workshops and training:** 

 You’ll prepare and facilitate workshops, bring different requirements together and help client teams get comfortable using the tools.
* **Keep an eye on the commercial side:** 

 You’ll keep projects on track in terms of budget, scope and timelines, coordinate billing and communicate openly with clients when priorities or requirements change.
* **Recognize opportunities:** 

 As you work with clients, you’ll notice where additional solutions or services could be useful and share these opportunities with our sales team.


**Which skills and strengths** 
**will I contribute** 
**to the team?** 
* **Languages:** 

 You have native-level Danish, Swedish or Norwegian and are comfortable working directly with clients in the Nordics. Professional English is required for working with our international team.
* **Atlassian expertise:** 

 You have solid hands-on experience with Jira and Confluence, ideally also Jira Service Management, and understand different deployment options such as Cloud, Data Center and Server.
* **Project experience:** 

 You have independently delivered complex projects, from kickoff through to go-live, including implementations and migrations.
* **Workshop and moderation skills:** 

 You can bring different stakeholder perspectives together, work through conflicting requirements and help a group reach a decision.
* **Communication skills:** 

 You can explain technical topics in a clear and accessible way, listen to what clients need and stay calm when things get difficult.
* **Commercial awareness:** 

 You understand the importance of scope, budget and timelines and take responsibility for keeping projects on track.
* **Certifications:** 

 Atlassian certifications are a plus. If you don’t have them yet, we expect you to be willing to work towards them during your first months.
* **Experience:** 

 Typically, you have a completed Bachelor's degree and at least 2 years of relevant professional experience.


**Practical** 
* **Location:** 

 Remote-first in Sweden, Norway or the Copenhagen area. Our office in Copenhagen is available if you’re nearby.
* **Start:** 

 As soon as we find the right person.
* **Application:** 

 Send us a short CV and a few lines about something you’ve built or implemented in Jira or Confluence that you’re proud of.


**What does Seibert** 
**offer** 
**me?** 
* **Work–life balance:** 

 Flexible working hours, clear overtime regulations and the option to work from home.
* **Equipment & support:** 

 We provide everything you need to get started, including a MacBook, iPhone and home-office equipment, as well as support from an experienced international team.
* **Professional development:** 

 Together, we’ll look at what will help you grow in your role, including opportunities to work towards Atlassian certifications.
* **Trust & responsibility:** 

 We give you the freedom to take ownership of your work, contribute your ideas and shape things together with your team.



  





 Salary: 52.000 to 61.000 EUR

title: Technical Support Specialist
description:
Evam builds mission-critical technology for the people who keep society safe. Our software is used by police, ambulance, fire & rescue, and other public safety organisations to manage complex, time-critical operations. Every day, Evam supports first responders handling hundreds of thousands of life-threatening incidents.
 



  





 We currently serve customers across the Nordics and the United Kingdom and have achieved 200%+ annual growth for the past three years. To support our continued expansion, we are now looking for a Support Technician to help our customers get the most out of Evam’s solutions.
 



 This is a role for someone who enjoys solving problems, helping customers, and working with technology that makes a real difference in society.
 



  





**The Role** 




 As a Support Technician at Evam, you will be part of the team responsible for supporting our customers and ensuring that our products run smoothly in mission-critical environments.
 



 You will work closely with customers, internal technical teams, implementation specialists, and product teams to investigate issues, answer questions, troubleshoot technical problems, and make sure our customers receive fast and professional support.
 



  





 Your focus is clear: help customers, solve problems, and contribute to a reliable and high-quality customer experience.
 



  





**What you will do** 



* Provide first-line and second-line support to Evam’s customers
* Receive, analyse, prioritise, and follow up on support tickets
* Troubleshoot issues related to Evam’s software, devices, integrations, connectivity, configuration, and user environments
* Communicate clearly and professionally with customers throughout the support process
* Reproduce and document issues for internal technical teams
* Support customers with configuration questions and product guidance



  





**Who you are** 




 You are service-minded, curious, and enjoy solving technical problems. You like helping people and can stay calm and structured when issues need to be investigated and resolved.
 



  





 You are comfortable communicating with customers and can explain technical matters in a simple and professional way. You enjoy working in a team, but you are also able to take responsibility and drive tasks forward independently.
 



  





**We believe you have** 



* A strong interest in technology, software, hardware, devices, networks, or integrations
* Some experience from technical support, IT support, customer service, SaaS support, or a similar role
* Good troubleshooting skills and a structured way of working
* Strong customer communication skills
* The ability to explain technical issues in a clear and simple way
* A service-minded attitude and a genuine interest in helping customers
* Good written and spoken communication skills in Swedish and English
* The willingness to learn and develop in a fast-growing technology company



  





**Why Evam** 




 At Evam, you will work on technology that directly impacts public safety and emergency response. You will join a fast-growing company, work with highly skilled colleagues, and help ensure that first responders have the digital tools they need when it matters the most.
 



 This is an opportunity to grow your technical skills, work close to customers, and become part of a company building the next generation of public safety technology.

title: Project Management Specialist, Languages Team
description:
**About Agoda**
 At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.
   

  

 Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.
   

  

 No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.
   

  

**The Opportunity:**
 As a
 **Project Management Specialist** 
 on Agoda’s Languages Team, you will help ensure that Agoda’s products, campaigns, and customer experience feel relevant and seamless for users around the world.
   

  

 You will manage complex localization projects across more than 40 languages, balancing competing priorities, tight release schedules, stakeholder expectations, quality requirements, and operational constraints. Working at the intersection of language, technology, and product development, you will play a key role in bringing Agoda’s global content to market efficiently and consistently.
   

  

 This role is ideal for someone who enjoys solving complex problems, coordinating across functions and cultures, and improving the way work gets done.
   

  

**In this Role, you’ll get to:**
* Own localization projects from end to end, including planning, requirements gathering, estimation, scheduling, execution, quality control, delivery, and post-project follow-up.
* Coordinate complex, time-sensitive workstreams across multiple languages and content types, ensuring that localized content is ready for product releases, marketing launches, and business-critical deadlines.
* Partner with a wide range of stakeholders, including Product Owners, engineers, marketing and legal teams, customer support teams, business leaders, and language experts, to clarify requirements and deliver high-quality results.
* Manage external language vendors and partners, including assignments, timelines, capacity, performance, delivery tracking, issue resolution, and budget monitoring.
* Use AI-powered translation and project management tools to identify opportunities for automation, reduce manual work, improve scalability, and continuously increase team efficiency.
* Anticipate risks and remove bottlenecks by proactively identifying dependencies, resolving issues, escalating concerns, and developing practical contingency plans.
* Maintain accurate project plans, documentation, reports, and workflows, ensuring that stakeholders have clear visibility into progress, risks, decisions, and next steps.
* Protect quality while working at speed, applying localization best practices and coordinating reviews to ensure that content is accurate, consistent, culturally appropriate, and fit for purpose.
* Improve processes and ways of working by analyzing recurring challenges, gathering stakeholder feedback, and helping implement scalable solutions across the Languages Team.
* Support stakeholders through periods of high pressure, creating structure and clarity when priorities shift and deadlines are demanding.


**What you’ll Need to Succeed:**
* At least two years of project management or coordination experience, ideally in localization, translation, content operations, technology, or another fast-paced environment.
* Familiarity with CAT tools, translation management systems, localization workflows, or related technologies.
* Strong organizational and prioritization skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects, deadlines, and stakeholders simultaneously.
* A proactive, solution-oriented approach and the confidence to identify risks, challenge inefficient processes, and drive issues through to resolution.
* Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
* Strong attention to detail and a commitment to delivering accurate, high-quality work.
* The ability to collaborate effectively with people from different functions, cultures, and levels of seniority.
* An interest in AI, automation, technology, and continuous improvement.
* Additional language skills are an advantage but are not required.

* Competitive compensation and relocation support.
* Opportunities for career growth across teams, functions, and global locations.
* A dynamic and multicultural working environment.
* Continuous learning and development through corporate programs and on-the-job experience.

title: Backend Engineer
description:
**Your work days are brighter here.**

  

We’re obsessed with making hard work pay off, for our people, our customers, and the world around us. As a Fortune 500 company and a leading AI platform for managing people, money, and agents, we’re shaping the future of work so teams can reach their potential and focus on what matters most. The minute you join, you’ll feel it. Not just in the products we build, but in how we show up for each other. Our culture is rooted in integrity, empathy, and shared enthusiasm. We’re in this together, tackling big challenges with bold ideas and genuine care. We look for curious minds and courageous collaborators who bring sun-drenched optimism and drive. Whether you're building smarter solutions, supporting customers, or creating a space where everyone belongs, you’ll do meaningful work with Workmates who’ve got your back. In return, we’ll give you the trust to take risks, the tools to grow, the skills to develop and the support of a company invested in you for the long haul. So, if you want to inspire a brighter work day for everyone, including yourself, you’ve found a match in Workday, and we hope to be a match for you too.  



  

**About the Team**

  

About Sana
  

  

Sana is an AI lab building superintelligence for work. We believe organizations can accomplish their missions faster when teams can effortlessly access knowledge, automate repetitive work, and learn anything with the help of agentic AI. As part of Workday, we are committed to building AI that augments people - not replaces them.  

  

  

  

  

We bring this mission to life through two products. Sana Agents provide a seamless way to access all your company’s apps, knowledge, and data, enabling AI agents to do real work so teams can process and act on information at unprecedented scale. Sana Learn is an AI-powered learning hub that combines the simplicity of a modern learning platform with intelligent features like an AI tutor, automated content generation, and interactive apps, making knowledge not just accessible but actionable.  

  

  

  

  

We’re a talent-dense, product-obsessed team of engineers and designers from companies like Google, Spotify, Apple, and Databricks, united by deep technical excellence and rapid iteration. Our tools already help over a million people learn and work better across hundreds of leading enterprises - and we’re just getting started.  

  

**About the Role**

  

**About the role**
==================

You'll build and evolve the core services that power agents and product features, with a focus on enterprise-scale workloads, performance optimization, and long-term architectural sustainability. You drive architecture and systems design to ensure our platform can support high volumes of data, entities, and demanding enterprise clients.  



  

**About You**

  

**In this role, you will**
==========================

* Design and decompose services and APIs for scale and clarity
* Build eventing and queue systems for reliable, high-throughput data flows
* Lead schema evolution, migrations, query/index optimization and caching strategies
* Define and enforce consistency models and multi-region readiness
* Optimize for performance budgets and privacy/tenant isolation
* Work hands-on with TypeScript/Node, Postgres, and distributed systems primitives.

**What success looks like**
===========================

* Core services are reliable, scalable, and easy to evolve
* Risks are identified and solved before issues become critical
* APIs are clear, well-documented, and power seamless product experiences
* Data boundaries are robust - privacy and tenant isolation are never compromised
* Performance budgets are met, even under heavy load
* You are a trusted partner for distributed systems design and implementation

**Our tech stack**
==================

We build on a simple modern stack optimized for both humans and AI.


* **Backend:** TypeScript, Kotlin, Node.js
* **Frontend:** TypeScript, React, Tailwind
* **Databases:** Postgres, Redis
* **Cloud infra:** GCP/Kubernetes/Terraform

As a part of the total compensation package, this role may be eligible for the Workday Bonus Plan or a role-specific commission/bonus, as well as annual refresh stock grants awarded by Workday Inc. For more information regarding Workday’s comprehensive benefits, please click here .  



Primary Location Base Pay Range: kr648,000 SEK - kr972,000 SEK Sweden  

**Our Approach to Flexible Work**  



With Flex Work, we’re combining the best of both worlds: in-person time and remote. Our approach enables our teams to deepen connections, maintain a strong community, and do their best work. We know that flexibility can take shape in many ways, so rather than a number of required days in-office each week, we simply **spend at least half (50%) of our time each quarter in the office or in the field** with our customers, prospects, and partners (depending on role). This means you'll have the freedom to create a flexible schedule that caters to your business, team, and personal needs, while being intentional to make the most of time spent together. Those in our remote "home office" roles also have the opportunity to come together in our offices for important moments that matter.

description:

Utveckla lösningar som stödjer flöden mellan konstruktion, utveckling, tillverkning, försäljning och eftermarknad.

Vidareutveckla befintliga applikationer och bidra till modernisering av plattformar.
  
Översätta verksamhetsbehov till hållbara tekniska lösningar.
  
Delta i arkitekturdiskussioner och förbättra prestanda, tillförlitlighet och förvaltningsbarhet.

Gedigen erfarenhet av backendutveckling och integrationslösningar.
  
**Erfarenhet av API:** er och mikrotjänstarkitektur.
  
Förmåga att ta ägarskap och samarbeta nära utvecklare, arkitekter, produktägare och verksamhet.
  
Vana att analysera komplexa behov och omsätta dem i konkreta tekniska lösningar.
