title: Data Engineer
description:
Motiveras du av att arbeta med moderna teknologier och lösa problem för kunder inom olika branscher kan DU vara vår nästa Data Engineer!
 



  





 Våra närmare
 **100 dataexperter** 
 i Sverige jobbar med datalösningar inom nästan alla teknologier. Ett vanligt projekt varierar i längd från en månad till några år, och situationen kan justeras baserat på dina önskemål.
 



  





**Hur är det att jobba på Solita?** 




 Oavsett kund, projekt eller bransch har du hos oss alltid tillgång till ett stort nätverk av fantastiskt kunniga, passionerade datakollegor, som bara är ett slackmeddelande bort. Därtill kan du ständigt lära dig nytt genom våra autonoma competence communities, infosessions och möjligheten att ta olika certifikationer etc.
 



  





 Vill du utvecklas och ligga i framkant inom datalösningar, så har vi rätt mycket att komma med! Solitas företagskultur handlar om autonomi, att stötta och växa tillsammans med våra kollegor samt att leva våra värdeord – passion, courage, easy-going och caring. Utöver detta har vi även
 **partnerskap** 
 med en mängd tech-företag såsom
 **, dbt, Snowflake, Databricks** 
 för att nämna några.
 



  





**Träffa en Solitan** 




 Möt
 **Clara Lundström,** 
 en Data Engineer här på Solita. Hon arbetar i ett projekt för ett globalt företag inom facility service, det största i Norden. Clara, tillsammans med ett team av Solita-entusiaster, belyser datalandskapet och använder data från olika källor för att skapa visualiseringar. Erfaren med molnverktyg arbetar hon med data, automation och transformation.
 



  





*“Att arbeta som konsult på Solita är varierat samtidigt som du har tillgång till ett stort nätverk av experter inom många olika områden. Det ger utmärkta möjligheter att utvecklas i din roll, vare sig det handlar om att bredda dina kunskaper eller specialisera dig. Anledningen till att jag trivs så bra på Solita är den vänliga, stödjande och opretentiösa atmosfären.”* 




  





**Vem är du?** 




 Som
 **Data Engineer på Solita** 
 är du med och bygger datadrivna lösningar som gör skillnad för våra kunder. Du arbetar med pipelines, plattformar och datalager, samtidigt som du kommunicerar med kunder och kollegor för att skapa hållbara och användbara lösningar.
 



  





**Dina ansvarsområden:** 



* Utveckla, testa och underhålla datapipelines
* Lösa tekniska utmaningar och bidra med expertis
* Förstå kundernas behov och omsätta dem i användbara datatillgångar
* Samarbeta med analytiker och utvecklare för att skapa affärskritiska lösningar
* Bidra till att skapa återanvändbara dataset och modeller
* Planera och driva ditt arbete självständigt



  





**Vi ser att du har erfarenhet av:** 



* Data pipelines, datamodellering och datalager
* SQL och/eller Python i molnmiljöer
* Har jobbat med verktyg som Snowflake, dbt, Databricks, MS Fabric, Data Factory och BigQuery
* Flytande svenska och engelska



  





 Vill du veta mer om hur det är att jobba som Data Engineer kan du läsa vår kollega Lisa Khylbergs People Story här!
 **https://www.solita.fi/blogs/people-of-solita-lisa-kyhlberg-senior-data-engineer/** 




  





**Vår kundmålgrupp** 




 Vi riktar oss mot företag och organisationer inom alla branscher som vill utnyttja kraften i data för att förbättra sina affärsprocesser och fatta bättre beslut. Våra kunder finns inom bland annat inom produktutveckling, hälsa, industri, försäkring, kommunikation, bank och elförsörjning. Vi arbetar med både stora och små företag som har behov av avancerade datalösningar och analys.
 



  





**Vad vi erbjuder** 




 Vår företagskultur är väldigt viktig för oss. Vi värdesätter en kultur som betonar en låg hierarki, hög entusiasm, värdeorienterat arbete och kollegor som är lättsamma och passionerade och alltid finns där för att hjälpa till. Det betyder att du är avgörande i att leda din utveckling och ditt arbete med ett brett kollegialt nätverk som du alltid kan vända dig till – i både vått och torrt!
 **Här** 
 kan du läsa mer om vår kultur, och
 **här** 
 kan du bläddra bland våra tech-bloggar.
 


* **Meningsfulla projekt:** 
 Arbeta i en agil miljö där du kan påverka teknikval och arbetssätt för att skapa de bästa lösningarna
* **Flexibilitet och autonomi** 
 för att utforma ditt arbete med flextider– läs mer från vår
 **blogg.**
* **Ständig utveckling:** 
 Vi erbjuder kontinuerlig kompetensutveckling för att säkerställa att våra medarbetare ligger längst fram i teknikutvecklingen.
* **Innovativ kultur:** 
 Arbeta tillsammans med några av de främsta experterna inom data, analys och utveckling



  





 Utöver detta får du även ta del av
 **förmåner** 
 så som
 **;** 
 fast lön oberoende av beläggningsgrad med möjlighet till löneväxling till ditt pensionssparande,
 **sjukvårdsförsäkring** 
 via Skandia,
 **friskvårdsbidrag** 
 på 5000 kr, after works, hobby aktiviteter och

title: SharePoint-specialist
description:

 Som
 **SharePoint-specialist** 
 på B3 Cloud ansvarar du för utveckling, förvaltning och optimering av plattformar inom Microsoft 365 med särskilt fokus på SharePoint. Rollen innebär ett nära samarbete med våra kunder för att skapa effektiva, säkra och användarvänliga lösningar.

* Förvalta och optimera digitala samarbetsplattformar inom Microsoft 365
* Utveckla skräddarsydda lösningar inom SharePoint och Microsoft 365
* Designa och implementera informationsarkitektur och strukturer för dokument och innehållshantering

* Vägleda och stötta våra kunder i användning av Microsoft 365-tjänster
* Delta i arkitektur- och teknikval för långsiktigt hållbara lösningar

* Har 6 års erfarenhet av utveckling och optimering av Microsoft 365-miljön
* Innehar goda kunskaper i Microsoft 365, med särskilt fokus på SharePoint
* Har erfarenhet av design av informationsarkitektur och dokumenthantering i större miljöer

* En givande företagskultur med konferensresor, AW:s och wellness-aktiviteter

title: Senior Java utvecklare - Event Driven Architecture
description:
Vill du vara med och bygga framtidens digitala integrationsplattform?
 



 Hos oss på Folksam pågår en omfattande digital transformation där eventdriven arkitektur är en central del av vår framtida teknikstrategi. För att möjliggöra detta investerar vi i moderna plattformar och gemensamma tekniska förmågor som används av utvecklingsteam i hela organisationen. Nu söker vi en Senior Java Engineer som vill vara med och forma Folksams framtida integrations- och eventlandskap.
 



  





 Det här är en unik möjlighet för dig som vill kombinera modern systemutveckling med plattformsutveckling, arkitektur och tekniskt ledarskap. Du kommer att arbeta i ett team som driver införandet av Event Driven Architecture för hela Folksam och som utvecklar de plattformar och tjänster som gör det enklare för våra utvecklingsteam att bygga moderna, skalbara lösningar.
 



 Hos oss arbetar du i trivsamma lokaler vid Skanstull på Södermalm och blir en del av en samlad IT‑enhet med över 700 engagerade kollegor. Tillsammans driver vi en digitaliseringsresa där kundnära lösningar står i centrum och där målet är att göra verklig skillnad för våra miljontals kunder.
 



  





 Vi erbjuder dig möjligheten att arbeta med teknik som är både verksamhetskritisk och långsiktig. Hos oss får du trygghet, balans och långsiktighet. Vi erbjuder konkurrenskraftiga förmåner såsom tjänstepension, omfattande försäkringsskydd, semester och friskvårdsbidrag. Läs mer om våra förmåner här.
 



  





**Det här gör du som Senior Java Engineer på Folksam** 




 Som Senior Java Engineer kommer du att:
 


* Designa och utveckla plattformstjänster och gemensamma tekniska komponenter.
* Vara med och etablera Folksams målarkitektur för Event Driven Architecture.
* Utveckla lösningar baserade på Java och moderna integrationsmönster.
* Arbeta med distribuerade system och asynkron kommunikation i stor skala.
* Bidra till utvecklingen av Folksams eventplattform.
* Arbeta med Kubernetes/OpenShift och moderna plattformsteknologier.
* Driva tekniska initiativ och bidra till arkitektur- och designbeslut.
* Stödja utvecklingsteam i införandet av moderna integrations- och kommunikationsmönster.
* Bidra till utvecklarupplevelsen genom att skapa enkla, robusta och återanvändbara plattformstjänster.
* Arbeta med observability, automatisering och operativ excellens.
* Samarbeta med arkitekter och andra teknikteam kring strategiska tekniska initiativ.



  





 Du kommer att ingå i Team C3 inom avdelningen Plattform & DX. Teamet ansvarar för gemensamma tekniska plattformar och utvecklarupplevelsen för Folksams utvecklingsteam. Vi bygger och förvaltar tekniska förmågor som används av hundratals utvecklare och spelar en central roll i Folksams modernisering.
 



  





 En viktig del av vårt uppdrag är att etablera och vidareutveckla en modern eventdriven arkitektur som möjliggör skalbara integrationer, snabbare utveckling och ökad affärsförmåga. Vi arbetar nära utvecklingsteam, arkitekter och andra plattformsteam för att skapa långsiktigt hållbara lösningar som gör skillnad i hela organisationen
 



  





 Så här beskriver John kulturen och arbetssättet i teamet:
 




*"Alla är otroligt kompetenta och hjälpsamma, och stämningen är familjär. Kulturen är öppen och stöttande. Jag uppskattar att det inte är någon ”micro management”. Vi har tydliga mål och en övergripande plan, och samtidigt frihet att lösa uppgifterna på bästa sätt. Behöver man hjälp, finns det alltid någon att fråga. Vi kommer snabbt framåt och stressnivån är låg."* 




  





 Blir du nyfiken på att veta mer hur John upplever att jobba på Folksam, läs mer här.
 



  





**Är du den vi söker?** 




 Vi söker dig som är en erfaren utvecklare med stark teknisk kompetens och ett genuint intresse för moderna systemarkitekturer. Du tycker om att lösa komplexa tekniska utmaningar och drivs av att bygga lösningar som används av många andra team.
 



  





 Vi ser att du dessutom har:
 


* Minst 7 års erfarenhet av systemutveckling.
* Stark kompetens inom Java och moderna utvecklingsramverk.
* Erfarenhet av mikrotjänstarkitektur och distribuerade system.
* God förståelse för integrationsmönster och systemintegration.
* Erfarenhet av Kubernetes, OpenShift eller liknande plattformar.
* Erfarenhet av CI/CD och automatiserade leveransflöden.
* Erfarenhet av molnbaserade eller plattformsnära lösningar.
* Förmåga att kommunicera tekniska lösningar till både utvecklare och arkitekter.



  





 För att lyckas i rollen är du nyfiken, analytisk och lösningsorienterad. Du trivs lika bra med att skriva kod som att diskutera arkitektur och långsiktiga tekniska vägval. Du har ett starkt driv och tar gärna initiativ när du ser möjligheter till förbättring. Samtidigt uppskattar du samarbete och kunskapsdelning och tycker om att hjälpa andra team att lyckas.
 



  





**Här kan du göra skillnad** 




 Välkommen till Folksam – här driver du viktiga frågor framåt. Från de avgörande detaljerna till de stora perspektiven, med fokus på att förenkla våra kunders vardag. Det gör att du bidrar till något större, oavsett roll. Här finns det många roliga, utvecklande jobb och du har goda chanser till en spännande karriär.
 



  





 Vi tror på ett hållbart arbetsliv och jobbar aktivt med inkludering och mångfald. Våra moderna kontor bjuder in till samarbete och lärande, här får vi saker att hända! Du har flexibiliteten att kunna varva arbete på kontoret med att jobba hemifrån, utifrån verksamhetens behov.
 



 Läs mer och se filmer om livet hos oss på folksam.se/jobb-och-karriar.
 



  





**Så söker du jobbet** 




 Välkommen med din ansökan redan idag, men senast 27 september 2026. Vi kommer att genomföra löpande urval till intervju under ansökningstiden.
 



  





 För mer information eller frågor om tjänsten, vänligen kontakta avdelningschef Harald Lönnbro, 073-332 61 46.
 



  





 Fackliga representanter: Forena Morgan Svensson 073-423 59 12, Akademikerföreningen Per Hansson 070-831 60 67 och Handels Mikael A Carlsson 070-831 51 32.
 



  





*Kundägda Folksamgruppen erbjuder sedan 1908 försäkringar och sparande som ger trygghet i livets alla skeden. Vi gör det enklare för våra fyra miljoner kunder att känna sig trygga i en hållbar värld genom rätt försäkringar, rätt sparande och rätt hjälp när något händer.*

title: Software Development Engineer - Frontend Infrastructure
description:
**Your work days are brighter here.**

  

We’re obsessed with making hard work pay off, for our people, our customers, and the world around us. As a Fortune 500 company and a leading AI platform for managing people, money, and agents, we’re shaping the future of work so teams can reach their potential and focus on what matters most. The minute you join, you’ll feel it. Not just in the products we build, but in how we show up for each other. Our culture is rooted in integrity, empathy, and shared enthusiasm. We’re in this together, tackling big challenges with bold ideas and genuine care. We look for curious minds and courageous collaborators who bring sun-drenched optimism and drive. Whether you're building smarter solutions, supporting customers, or creating a space where everyone belongs, you’ll do meaningful work with Workmates who’ve got your back. In return, we’ll give you the trust to take risks, the tools to grow, the skills to develop and the support of a company invested in you for the long haul. So, if you want to inspire a brighter work day for everyone, including yourself, you’ve found a match in Workday, and we hope to be a match for you too.  



  

**About the Team**

  

Sana is an AI lab building superintelligence for work. We believe organizations can accomplish their missions faster when teams can effortlessly access knowledge, automate repetitive work, and learn anything with the help of agentic AI. As part of Workday, we are committed to building AI that augments people - not replaces them.
  

  

We bring this mission to life through two products. Sana Agents provide a seamless way to access all your company’s apps, knowledge, and data, enabling AI agents to do real work so teams can process and act on information at unprecedented scale. Sana Learn is an AI-powered learning hub that combines the simplicity of a modern learning platform with intelligent features like an AI tutor, automated content generation, and interactive apps, making knowledge not just accessible but actionable.
  

  

We’re a talent-dense, product-obsessed team of engineers and designers from companies like Google, Spotify, Apple, and Databricks, united by deep technical excellence and rapid iteration. Our tools already help over a million people learn and work better across hundreds of leading enterprises - and we’re just getting started.  

  

**About the Role**

  

You’ll own the core web stack at Sana - from our TypeScript/React frontend to the Node services, tooling, and monorepo infrastructure that power it. This is a role for engineers who love unblocking others: you’ll design and maintain the build systems, frameworks, and developer workflows that let teams ship fast, safely, and with confidence. You’ll work on everything from core web architecture and performance to CI, testing, and local development, ensuring our web platform is modern, secure, and a joy to build on.


In this role, you will:


* Own and evolve Sana’s TypeScript/React/Node foundations, including frameworks, services, and conventions
* Maintain and improve our monorepo tooling: build tools, dependency management, scripts, and shared services
* Design and refine local development, testing, and build workflows so they’re fast, reliable, and easy to use
* Optimize web performance, reliability, and security across our frontend and Node services
* Shape and implement our testing strategy (unit, integration, end-to-end, visual) and related tooling
* Maintain and improve CI/CD pipelines, including caching, checks, and deployment workflows
* Define and champion best practices for web development, debugging, and observability across teams
* Collaborate closely with product engineers to identify friction points and remove them through better tooling and architecture

  

**About You**

  

**Basic Qualifications:**

* 5+ years of experience in a similar role
* Previous experience with web architecture, performance, and developer experience - raising the bar for how we build, ship, and maintain software at Sana.

We build on a simple modern stack optimized for both humans and AI: (no need to have experience in all):


* Backend: TypeScript, Kotlin, Node.js
* Frontend: TypeScript, React, Tailwind
* Databases: Postgres, Redis
* Cloud infra: GCP/Kubernetes/Terraform

**Other Qualifications:**

* You are a developer who can move quickly and confidently

  

**Workday Pay Transparency Statement (For EU Locations Only)**

  

Listed below is the base salary range applicable to this position. Workday pay ranges (and the precise pay offered to the successful candidate) are based on a number of objective criteria such as relevant experience and skills, and educational qualifications, level of responsibility, demands of the role, work location and business need. As a part of the total compensation package, this role may be eligible for the Workday Bonus Plan or a role-specific commission/bonus, as well as annual refresh stock grants awarded by Workday Inc. For more information regarding Workday’s comprehensive benefits, please click here .  



Primary Location Base Pay Range: kr591,000 SEK - kr887,000 SEK Sweden  

**Our Approach to Flexible Work**  



With Flex Work, we’re combining the best of both worlds: in-person time and remote. Our approach enables our teams to deepen connections, maintain a strong community, and do their best work. We know that flexibility can take shape in many ways, so rather than a number of required days in-office each week, we simply **spend at least half (50%) of our time each quarter in the office or in the field** with our customers, prospects, and partners (depending on role). This means you'll have the freedom to create a flexible schedule that caters to your business, team, and personal needs, while being intentional to make the most of time spent together. Those in our remote "home office" roles also have the opportunity to come together in our offices for important moments that matter.  



  

Pursuant to applicable Fair Chance law, Workday will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.  



  

Workday is an Equal Opportunity Employer including individuals with disabilities and protected veterans.  



  

Workday is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals during our application process, in order to perform one or more essential functions of their job, as well as regarding the use of AI tools for employment decision-making to any degree. Please see below for more details including how to request an accommodation as a qualified veteran, due to a disability or for religious reasons, or as otherwise provided under applicable law.  



  

Workday prohibits taking adverse action against any candidate or employee for reporting a possible violation of this policy, requesting one or more work accommodations, exercising a privacy right, or cooperating in an investigation in accordance with applicable law. Any employee who retaliates against a candidate or employee for doing so may be subject to disciplinary action, up to and including termination of employment, to the fullest extent allowable under applicable law.  



  

If you require a reasonable accommodation, you may email accommodations@workday.com , as far in advance as possible.  



  

  

**Are you being referred to one of our roles? If so, ask your connection at Workday about our Employee Referral process!**

  

At Workday, we value our candidates’ privacy and data security. Workday will never ask candidates to apply to jobs through websites that are not Workday Careers.  



Please be aware of sites that may ask for you to input your data in connection with a job posting that appears to be from Workday but is not.  



In addition, Workday will never ask candidates to pay a recruiting fee, or pay for consulting or coaching services, in order to apply for a job at Workday.

title: Growth Marketing Specialist
description:
Do you enjoy turning ideas into campaigns that generate real business results?
  
At Smartsign, we're creating our first Growth Marketing Specialist role—a unique opportunity to build our growth marketing capability from the ground up and have a real impact on how we attract new customers.
  
As our first Growth Marketing Specialist, you won't just join a function—you'll help build it.
  
About the role
  
As Growth Marketing Specialist, your job is to help more potential customers discover Smartsign, understand the value we offer and take the next step with us.
  
You will own the day-to-day execution of our digital marketing activities — from website content and LinkedIn posts to landing pages, campaigns, newsletters and lead conversion. You will help us create awareness, generate inbound demand and convert interest into qualified sales opportunities.
  
You will work closely with Sales, Product Marketing, Customer Experience and local markets to make sure our marketing activities support measurable business results.
  
  

**You will play a key role in helping us:**  

Reach the right audiences with the right message.
  
  

Increase engagement across our digital channels.
  
  

Improve conversion from interest to opportunity.
  
  

Support Sales with high-quality inbound leads.
  
  

Make better marketing decisions through data and insights.
  
  

Sometimes you will also support local market activities in Sweden, Norway, Denmark, Finland and Australia — especially when it helps Sales create new opportunities or follow up existing interest.
  
What you will do
  
Create and publish content across our digital channels.
  
  

Plan and execute campaigns that generate awareness and inbound demand.
  
  

Optimize website conversion, customer journeys and lead generation.
  
  

Collaborate with Sales to maximize the value of inbound opportunities.
  
  

Analyze results and continuously improve marketing performance
  
  

Build landing pages, forms and email flows.
  
  

Manage and improve our website and LinkedIn presence.
  
  

Plan webinars, events and targeted campaigns.
  
  

Track traffic, conversions, lead quality and marketing-sourced pipeline.
  
  

Test messages, formats and channels to understand what generates results.
  
  

Support campaigns and sales activities across Sweden, Norway, Denmark, Finland and Australia
  
  

Who we are looking for
  
You enjoy creating content, working with digital channels and using data to improve results. You are practical, curious and commercially minded.
  
You are structured and hands-on. You like to take ownership, get things done and improve marketing step by step. You work well with Sales and use data to see what works and what can be better.
  
  

**We believe you have:**  

2–4 years of experience from Growth Marketing, Digital Marketing, Content Marketing, B2B Marketing or a similar role
  
  

Experience creating and publishing digital content
  
  

Experience with websites, landing pages, campaigns and marketing tools
  
  

Understanding of B2B lead generation, inbound marketing and lead conversion
  
  

A good understanding of how marketing can support traffic, leads, conversion and sales pipeline
  
  

A structured, hands-on and analytical approach
  
  

Strong writing and communication skills in English and Swedish
  
  

Interest in B2B SaaS, digital products and commercial growth
  
  

Curiosity about AI tools and experience using them for research, writing, ideation, content production and campaign improvement
  
  

Experience from a SaaS or other B2B software company is an advantage.
  
It is also a plus if you have worked with tools such as HubSpot, WordPress, Webflow, Google Analytics, Google Search Console, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, Google Ads, Canva, ChatGPT, Copilot, Claude or similar. You don't need experience from every area above but most successful candidates will recognize themselves in several of them.
  
About Smartsign
  
Smartsign is a Swedish SaaS company with customers around the world. Our platform helps organizations communicate through digital screens in offices, stores, healthcare, manufacturing and public environments. Every day, thousands of organizations rely on Smartsign to deliver the right information to the right audience in a simple, secure and scalable way.
  
We support a wide range of commercial screens, players and customer environments, including both cloud and on-premise needs.
  
Location and practical information
  
This is a full-time, permanent position.
  
The role is based in Stockholm, with a flexible working setup that combines office and remote work. An alternative Smartsign location may also be considered for the right candidate.
  
You will report to the CEO or appointed marketing lead and work closely with Product Marketing, Sales, Customer Experience and local markets.
  
Start date by agreement.
  
Interested?
  
We'd love to hear from you. We're reviewing applications on a rolling basis. For questions about the recruitment process, reach out to julia.karner@smartsign.se.

title: Incident & Operations Engineer I
description:
Sinch is pioneering the way the world communicates. More than 150,000 businesses — including Google, Uber, Paypal, Visa, Tinder, and many others — rely on Sinch’s Customer Communications Cloud to power engaging customer experiences through mobile messaging, voice, and email.
  
Whether you need to verify users or craft omnichannel campaigns, Sinch makes it easy. Our AI-infused Super Network, APIs, and applications ensure you can connect with your customers reliably and securely, at every step of their journey.
  
At Sinch we “Dream Big”, “Win Together”, “Keep it simple”, and “Make it Happen”. These values are our foundation!
  
DESCRIPTION
  
We are looking for an Incident & Operations Engineer I to join our Technical Operations Center team in Kalmar. In this role, you will focus on incident management, ensuring smooth operations with internal systems, and providing critical support in resolving technical issues. Additionally, you will play a key role in supporting our operator and provider partners to maintain high-quality service delivery.
  
We tackle every challenge together as a team, sharing the workload no matter how complex it gets! With our 24/7 operations, we are dedicated to resolving incidents swiftly and keeping business disruptions to an absolute minimum. To help us maintain this high standard of service, your day-to-day responsibilities will include:
  
Collaborate with internal teams to ensure smooth resolution of issues.
  
Conduct in-depth troubleshooting at both the software and network layers to identify and resolve technical problems.
  
Act as Incident Manager for our core services, ensuring timely resolutions and minimizing system downtime.
  
Monitor internal alerts and ensure incidents are managed and escalated as needed.
  
Document and track alerts and incidents for future improvements.
  
Use insights from resolved incidents to drive ongoing system improvements and optimization. to ensure smooth resolution of issues.
  
  

REQUIREMENTS
  
Sinch is a tech company through and through where great ideas are listened to and often implemented - we want you to feel part of the bigger picture!
  
This role is full of challenges and offers plenty of opportunities to grow. To thrive here, you’ll need a curious mindset and a passion for learning. A “can-do” attitude will help you turn obstacles into opportunities and keep you moving forward.
  
**Education:** A Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related technical field (or equivalent professional experience).
  
**Communication:** Excellent written and verbal English communication skills, with the ability to explain technical issues clearly to both internal teams and external partners.
  
**Problem-Solving:** Strong analytical skills and a methodical approach to troubleshooting software or system alerts.
  
**Composure:** The ability to stay calm and focused in a high-pressure environment, especially when managing multiple tasks or urgent incidents.
  
**Flexibility:** Ability to work in a 24/7 shift rotation, including nights and weekends.
  
**Location:** Able to work onsite at our office in Kalmar, Sweden.
  
  

In addition to the above, it is a strong advantage if you have:
  
Hands-on experience with incident management and platform monitoring.
  
Understanding of the TCP/IP protocol suite.
  
Experience collaborating effectively with internal teams and stakeholders, demonstrating accountability and the ability to take ownership of issues.
  
Knowledge with UNIX and Linux systems.
  
Background in telecoms and wireless communication.
  
Understanding of mobile communications standards like GSM and 4G.
  
Basic SQL skills.
  
  

Our corporate language is English, please submit your application in English
  
OUR HIRING PROCESS
  
We are committed to ensuring a recruitment process that is fair, objective, consistent, and inclusive. Our approach includes structured, competency-based interviews designed to evaluate your skills, experience, and qualifications relevant to the role. At times, we may include a data-driven assessment to enhance our hiring success and identify candidates likely to excel.
  
We believe in a two-way process and encourage you to ask questions throughout the journey. If this role isn't what you're looking for, please explore the other opportunities listed on our career page: https://www.sinch.com/careers/.
  
No matter who you are, we hope you find an exciting path forward - hopefully with us!

title: Senior Security Engineer - Cyber Defense & Automotive
description:
Vill du vara med och utveckla nästa generations cybersäkerhetslösningar för några av Sveriges ledande aktörer inom automotive och industri?  

CGI i Göteborg söker en erfaren Senior Security Engineer med stark bakgrund inom Security Operations, Detection Engineering och automatisering. Du kommer att arbeta i teknikintensiva och verksamhetskritiska miljöer där moderna säkerhetsplattformar, cloud, data och automation är centrala delar av cyberförsvaret.  

I rollen arbetar du i gränslandet mellan Cyber Security, Security Engineering och SOC/SecOps. Du får möjlighet att utveckla lösningar som stärker kundernas förmåga att upptäcka, analysera och hantera avancerade cyberhot.

**Dina framtida arbetsuppgifter**


Som Senior Security Engineer kommer du bland annat att:  

* Utveckla och förbättra detection logic och monitoring use cases med exempelvis KQL, SPL, SQL och Python.
* Arbeta enligt Detection-as-Code och hantera säkerhetslogik genom Git och CI/CD.
* Utveckla automatiserade playbooks och integrationer för snabbare incidenthantering.
* Konfigurera och optimera säkerhetsplattformar inom exempelvis SIEM, XDR/EDR, cloud security, firewalls, DLP och Identity.
* Analysera hotbild, attackmönster och säkerhetsluckor och omsätta dessa till nya detection- och response capabilities.
* Arbeta med säkerhetsdata från SIEM, data lakes, cloud storage och andra distribuerade datakällor.
* Automatisera säkerhetsprocesser med Python, PowerShell och API-integrationer.
* Bidra till arkitektur och tekniska roadmaps för moderna Cyber Defense-lösningar.
* Samarbeta med SOC-team, säkerhetsarkitekter, utvecklare och andra tekniska specialister.
**Kvalifikationer för att bli framgångsrik denna roll**


Vi söker dig som har:  

* Flera års erfarenhet inom Cyber Security, SOC, SecOps eller Security Engineering.
* Erfarenhet av Detection Engineering och utveckling av säkerhetsrelaterade use cases.
* Goda kunskaper i KQL, SPL eller SQL.
* Erfarenhet av Python och/eller PowerShell.

title: AI CAPABILITY LEAD
description:
**AI CAPABILITY LEAD**

  

Our story goes back more than 150 years, to the chilly southern coast of Scandinavia. From our early success in Sweden and Denmark, we’ve grown into the world’s leading specialist producer of plant-based oils, employing more than 4,000 people all across the globe.  

  

We work with our customers to make the products you love even better. The oils we produce go into making your chocolate extra-creamy or putting the crunch into your croissant. And it’s not just food — we work across industries to make products that are higher quality, healthier and better for the planet.  

  

Everything we do is about Making Better Happen™.

 **AAK Malmö**


This position is based in Malmö, Sweden

  

**About the role**


Artificial Intelligence is rapidly changing how businesses operate, innovate, and create value. At AAK, we see AI as an important enabler of future growth and are investing in the internal capabilities needed to support our long-term ambitions.  

  

As AI Capability Lead, you will shape and scale how AI is adopted across AAK. You will build the capabilities, governance, and ways of working needed to make AI a natural part of how the company works, innovates, and creates value. The role translates AI opportunities into scalable solutions and measurable business value, while strengthening internal ownership and execution capability.  

  

This is a global role within AAK’s Enterprise Technology & Architecture function, reporting to the Head of Enterprise Technology & Architecture. You will initially lead a team of approximately five people and work across the organization with business leaders, production sites, enterprise architects, developers, data specialists, security specialists, and IT colleagues globally.

 **Responsibilities**


As AI Capability Lead, your main tasks and responsibilities will be:  

* Build and scale AAK’s internal AI capabilities across the organization, including team structure, governance frameworks, ways of working, and reusable AI patterns.
* Identify, evaluate, and prioritize AI use cases together with business and IT stakeholders, translating needs and opportunities into feasible, high-value initiatives.
* Drive AI pilots and initiatives from idea through implementation and value realization, moving from experimentation to scalable, production-ready solutions with measurable business impact.
* Define AI architecture principles, standards, reusable patterns, responsible AI principles, and technical guardrails in close collaboration with Enterprise Architecture, Security, Data, Integration, and Infrastructure teams.
* Evaluate AI platforms, models, tools, and emerging technologies, recommending suitable approaches and promoting reusable capabilities rather than isolated point solutions.
* Establish AI governance and responsible AI frameworks to support ethical, secure, and compliant AI adoption across AAK.
* Coach, inspire, and enable colleagues across the organization while helping to shape AAK’s long-term AI direction and capability build-up.

  

**About you**
To be successful in the role you need:  

* Hands-on experience with Generative AI and Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), AI agents, and agentic workflows.
* Experience with Azure AI and/or Azure OpenAI, the Microsoft Copilot ecosystem, cloud platforms, preferably Azure, and API-based integrations.
* Experience or strong understanding of enterprise architecture, information security, governance, software engineering, or solution architecture as it applies to AI implementation.
* Proven ability to identify, qualify, prioritize, and deliver AI use cases from idea to scalable implementation, with a clear focus on measurable business value.
* An architecture, governance, responsible AI, and security mindset, with the ability to define standards, guardrails, and reusable patterns at enterprise level.
* Strong stakeholder communication skills and the ability to engage credibly with both executives and engineers.
* A genuine capability-building mindset and a talent for coaching and inspiring colleagues.
* Fluency in English. Experience in manufacturing or industrial environments is an advantage.


As a person, you are curious and continuously learning, pragmatic rather than driven by hype, collaborative and generous with your knowledge. You are comfortable challenging existing ways of working and remain focused on delivering business value.  

  

**In return AAK offer*** Join a pioneering company in specialty oils and fats, driving innovation and sustainability.
* In AAK you can work across 25+ countries, gaining international exposure and collaborating with a diverse team.
* AAK invests in your development with training, mentorship, and clear career paths.
* You will contribute to a greener world with AAK's sustainability-focused approach.
* Join a diverse and inclusive workplace that values every individual's perspective and talents.

  

  

**About AAK**  

  

Everything AAK does is about Making Better Happen™. We specialize in plant-based oils that are the value-adding ingredients in many of the products people love to consume. We make these products better tasting, healthier, and more sustainable. At the heart of AAK’s offer is Customer Co-Development, combining our desire to understand what better means for each customer, with the unique flexibility of our production assets, and a deep knowledge of many products and industries, including Chocolate & Confectionery, Bakery, Dairy, Plant-based Foods, Special Nutrition, Foodservice and Personal Care. Our 4,000 employees support our close collaboration with customers through 25 regional sales offices, 15 dedicated Customer Innovation Centers, and with the support of more than 20 production facilities. Listed on Nasdaq Stockholm and with our headquarters in Malmö, Sweden, AAK has been Making Better Happen™ for more than 150 years.

 **AAK prohibits discrimination on the basis of race, color, sex, sexual orientation, age, national origin, physical or mental disability, religion, veteran status, and any other class of individuals protected from discrimination under state or federal law in any aspect of the access to, admission, or treatment of students in its programs and activities, or in employment and application for employment.**

title: NetOps Engineer
description:
#### **TL;DR**

* Whether you're looking for a permanent role in Stockholm or prefer to work freelance, we want to talk to you.
* Own the day-to-day of a large, business-critical Fortigate environment spanning on-prem and Azure.
* Work daily alongside experienced network and cloud engineers, as part of a dedicated Ops team.
* Real tickets, real infrastructure, real impact.

#### **What you'll do**


As a NetOps Engineer, you'll join our Ops team in Stockholm and abroad, and work closely with one of our largest enterprise clients. Your main focus will be operating, improving and troubleshooting their Fortigate environment, while navigating a complex network setup spanning on-prem components and Azure cloud.


Your work will range from daily tickets and change requests to deeper troubleshooting, log analysis, policy refinement, and larger initiatives such as network segmentation or cloud networking improvements. The environment is large, fast-moving, and business-critical, giving you plenty of opportunities to learn, collaborate, and solve real problems with experienced engineers.


You'll primarily work from our Stockholm office, with flexibility to work from home at times, and occasional on-site days at the client's office when the work calls for it. This role also includes a rotating on-call schedule (one week at a time, with additional compensation).


We're open to bringing you on board as a permanent hire in Stockholm or as a freelancer, depending on what works best for you.

#### **What you'll grow into**


You'll deepen your skills in Fortigate, FortiManager, cloud networking and enterprise-scale ops. But your growth won't stop at this client. As Redeploy continues to build out its networking capabilities, you'll be able to work on additional NetOps projects, influence our network practice and collaborate across delivery teams.


If you're curious about cloud, you'll find clear paths into CloudOps, automation, IaC and hybrid cloud operations. Whether you want to specialise further in networking or expand into broader cloud-focused ops, we'll help you shape a direction that aligns with your strengths and ambitions.

#### **Who we're looking for**


You have solid hands-on experience with Fortigate firewalls and enjoy tackling complex network challenges. You take ownership, stay organised under pressure, and collaborate well with others who value clean, reliable and well-engineered solutions. You communicate clearly, think proactively, and feel confident working independently when needed.


Fluency in English is required, and Swedish is a strong advantage.

#### **What experiences you bring**

* Hands-on expertise with Fortigate firewalls (rule creation, security profiles, IPSec VPNs, log analysis, troubleshooting).
* Experience working with FortiManager (sync status, pushing changes, working safely in the platform).
* Strong networking fundamentals at a CCNA-equivalent level: VLANs, trunk/access ports, port-channels, routing (BGP/OSPF), switch configuration.
* Understanding of cloud networking on a major cloud platform (Azure, AWS or GCP).
* Ability to self-manage and deliver reliably in a demanding ops environment.
* Fluency in English, spoken and written.
 **Experience with any of the following is a bonus:** Broader Fortinet products, Check Point, Aruba SD-WAN, zScaler, Infoblox or Algosec, Terraform or Ansible, CI/CD tooling, Advanced Azure or AWS networking knowledge

#### **About Redeploy**


Redeploy is where cloud, data, and AI come together in production. We help Nordic enterprises design, build, and operate modern tech platforms and AI solutions that are secure, scalable, and production-ready. Engineers at heart, we work hands-on across Azure, AWS, and Databricks from strategy to operations.

Du blir en del av ett engagerat team som tillsammans arbetar för att skapa bästa möjliga upplevelse för våra kunder, medarbetare och samarbetspartners.

**Om rollen**


Som kommunikatör ansvarar du för att utveckla, skapa och anpassa innehåll som stärker vårt varumärke. Du erbjuder relevant specialiststöd inom kommunikation och marknadsföring utifrån affärsområdenas behov. Rollen är operativ och passar dig som förstår hur det dagliga kommunikationsarbetet bidrar till verksamhetens långsiktiga mål.  

  

**Dina huvudsakliga ansvarsområden**

* Driva och utveckla vår interna och externa kommunikation genom att skapa och anpassa innehåll för olika kanaler utifrån verksamhetens behov.
* Planera, producera, publicera och hantera innehåll för intranät, extern webbplats och sociala medier.
* Designa material för tryckt och digital kommunikation.
* Ta fram annonsmaterial för digitala och tryckta kanaler, inklusive budskap, visuellt innehåll och manus för rörlig kommunikation.
* Stötta och utveckla målgruppsanpassade säljinsatser genom kommunikation och marknadsföring.
* Arbeta med och följa upp externa leverantörer inom kommunikation och marknadsföring.
* Bistå kommunikationschefen i arbetet med struktur, utveckling och riktade aktiviteter.

##### **Vem söker vi?**


Vi söker dig med stort hjärta och en vilja att göra skillnad. Vi ser gärna att du tycker om att samarbeta med människor och har stark känsla för service.

* Relevant utbildning inom kommunikation, marknadsföring eller motsvarande arbetslivserfarenhet.
* Minst fem års erfarenhet av relevanta roller och ansvarsområden.
* Mycket goda språkkunskaper, både muntliga och skriftliga.
* Förståelse för vård- och omsorgsbranschen genom erfarenhet, engagemang eller intresse.
* Erfarenhet av att producera grafiskt material och text samt goda kunskaper i verktyg som Canva, CMS och Adobe Creative Cloud.
* Erfarenhet av SEO samt innehållsarbete anpassat för AI-baserade sökfunktioner är meriterande.

  

Som person är du effektiv, strukturerad och pålitlig. Du är bra på att förstå andras behov och kan anpassa budskap till målgrupp, kanal och situation. Vi ser att du trivs i en operativ roll där du får bidra till en organisation som är stolt över sina värderingar, tjänster och kundleveranser.

Regionalt cancercentrum Syd (RCC Syd) är ett av sex regionala cancercentrum i Sverige med uppdrag att förverkliga målen i den nationella cancerstrategin. RCC Syd är en kunskaps- och utvecklingsorganisation som ska bidra till en mer personcentrerad, jämlik, säker och effektiv cancervård. Vi ansvarar bland annat för att stödja utveckling och implementering av standardiserade vårdförlopp, vårdprogram, nationellt regimbibliotek samt Min vårdplan cancer. RCC Syd stödjer utvecklingen av flera nationella kvalitetsregister och hanterar canceranmälningar i Södra sjukvårdsregionen.



RCC Syds organisatoriska hemvist är Region Skånes avdelning för Hälso- och sjukvårdsstyrning men uppdraget innefattar Region Skåne, Region Halland, Region Kronoberg och Region Blekinge. RCC Syd är en multiprofessionell verksamhet med 28 medarbetare, bland annat medicinska sekreterare, läkare, sjuksköterskor, fysioterapeut, farmaceut, systemvetare, kommunikatörer och statistiker.



**Arbetsuppgifter**
-------------------


Vi söker en kommunikatör som vill vara med och bidra till att skapa förutsättningar för en jämlik och kunskapsbaserad cancervård.


Rollen som kommunikatör på RCC Syd är både strategisk och operativ. Du förväntas planera, samordna och följa upp arbetet inom dina ansvarsområden. Du samarbetar med kommunikatör och övriga medarbetare på RCC Syd, kommunikatörer på landets fem andra RCC, tjänstemän, patient- och närståendeföreträdare samt sakkunniga inom olika områden.


Som kommunikatör hos RCC Syd arbetar du med både intern och extern kommunikation. Arbetsuppgifterna kan innebära att:
  

* skriva, redigera och målgruppsanpassa texter för webb, sociala medier och andra kanaler
* planera, producera och publicera innehåll i digitala kanaler
* producera enklare film och rörligt innehåll för exempelvis webb och sociala medier
* hantera trycksaker, presentationer och annat kommunikationsmaterial
* samordna kommunikationsinsatser och kampanjer
* ge kommunikativt stöd till olika projekt och arbetsgrupper
* utveckla RCC Syds digitala kommunikation i olika kanaler

RCCs verksamhet står under ständig utveckling. Arbetet kan därför förändras över tid och du förväntas bidra till att utveckla våra interna arbetsprocesser.


RCC Syd arbetar för hela Södra sjukvårdsregionen och samverkar med Sveriges fem andra RCC, varför en del resor kan bli aktuella.


**Kvalifikationer**
-------------------


Vi söker dig som har en högskole- eller universitetsutbildning inom kommunikation, medie- och kommunikationsvetenskap, journalistik eller annan utbildning som arbetsgivaren bedömer likvärdig. Du har minst 3 års erfarenhet av att arbeta med kommunikation, exempelvis som kommunikatör, webbredaktör, informatör, journalist eller motsvarande.


Du har erfarenhet av att
  

* planera, genomföra och följa upp målgruppsanpassade kommunikationsinsatser.
* producera innehåll för olika målgrupper och kanaler.
* arbeta med webbpublicering och digital kommunikation.
* arbeta med grafisk produktion, exempelvis trycksaker, presentationer och enklare original.
* skriva och redigera texter för olika kanaler och målgrupper.
* arbeta med kommunikation inom offentlig sektor, hälso- och sjukvård eller annan komplex organisation.

Du har även
  

* Mycket god förmåga att uttrycka dig på svenska i tal och skrift.
* God förståelse för kommunikation i digitala kanaler och sociala medier.
* Kunskap om webbpublicering och grundförståelse för tillgänglig och användarvänlig webb.
* Förmåga att anpassa budskap, tonalitet och innehåll efter målgrupp och kanal.
* God digital kompetens och vana att arbeta i olika kommunikationsverktyg och system.

Meriterande för tjänsten är att du har erfarenhet av:
  

* filmproduktion för webb och sociala medier.
* bildredigering.
* Adobe Creative Cloud, Canva eller motsvarande.
* CMS/webbpubliceringsverktyg.

Du är strukturerad, lösningsfokuserad och trivs med varierande arbetsuppgifter. Arbetet förutsätter flexibilitet, kvalitetsmedvetenhet samt förmåga att samordna och följa upp genomfört arbete. Rollen kräver mycket god samarbetsförmåga, kommunikativ styrka och förmåga att arbeta självständigt med både administration, planering och utveckling tillsammans med olika aktörer. Du behöver kunna redogöra för syftet med en kommunikationsinsats, vilket värde den ska bidra med samt göra medvetna val utifrån målgrupp och kanal.


I din ansökan vill vi att du beskriver din kompetens, erfarenhet, personliga egenskaper och vad du kan bidra med i den här tjänsten. Stor vikt läggs vid god samarbetsförmåga och personlig lämplighet.


Löneintervall: 45 000 kronor 49 000 kronor

title: Data Analyst
description:
* Application Deadline: Oct. 11, 2026
* Solna
**Job Description**
-------------------


**Coop Sverige – Together we make food-Sweden sustainable**

At Coop, data plays an increasingly important role in how we understand our customers, improve our operations and make better decisions. With over 4 million members and data across stores, logistics and digital channels, we have both the scale and the opportunity to create real impact. To add to this, our data platform runs on an architecture suitable for providing agentic analytics!


Within our AI & Business Intelligence organization, we have built a modern analytics platform that we are proud of – and we are now looking for a **Senior Data Analyst** to help us turn even more of that data into action.


***Om tjänsten:***
  

You will join our Analytics team within AI & Business Intelligence, working closely with Data Engineers, Data Scientists and stakeholders across Coop.


As a Data Analyst, you sit at the intersection of technology and business. The role is not only about answering questions with data, but understanding the problem behind the question, challenging assumptions and determining what we should actually do with the insight.


You will have considerable freedom in how you approach problems. We believe in building reusable, scalable solutions in code rather than repeatedly solving the same problem manually.


**What you will do**

* Translate business challenges into analytical questions, solutions and recommendations aid all of Coop in decision making
* Work with large datasets across customer behaviour, sales, assortment, logistics and digital channels and develop scalable and reusable solutions with any too you see fitting the purpose.
* Build analytical agents, dashboards, ad hoc analyses or any other data product that democratizes our data.
* Challenge existing questions and ways of working – moving from “can you analyse this?” towards “this is what we should do.”

***Who are you?***


We believe you enjoy operating at the intersection of data, technology and business. You are curious enough to dig into the details, but can also step back and understand the bigger picture.


You don't see an analysis as finished when the numbers are correct – you want to understand what they mean and what action they should lead to. You are comfortable taking ownership even when the path forward is not completely defined.


**We believe that you**

* Have experience turning business needs into analytical questions and solutions.
* Are comfortable programming in SQL and Python, with experience of PySpark or similar technologies and have experience working with version control, such as Git.
* Have strong business understanding and can connect analytical findings to concrete actions and can communicate this effectively with any audience.
* Understand fundamental statistical methods and when different analytical approaches are appropriate.

**It’s meritorious if you**

* Have experience from a modern cloud-based data platform or Lakehouse environment.
* Have worked with providing agentic analysis, analytics engineering, BI tools or code-first analytical workflows.
* Have worked in a scale-up, technology company, consultancy or another environment where broad ownership is expected.
* Have experience from retail, e-commerce or another data-intensive consumer business.

***About us***

The grocery trade is a stable, long-term industry, and Coop’s offering is essential to the transition toward a greener, more sustainable future. You’ll join a culture defined by humility, initiative and strong values, where we take joint responsibility and genuinely want to help each other succeed. Our office in Solna Business Park offers a modern work environment with great transport links, a fantastic staff restaurant, and the option of hybrid work in agreement with your manager. At Coop, we work for our 4.2 million members, making us by far the largest cooperation in Sweden.


If you have questions about the position, you are welcome to contact Hiring Manager Victor Kesten (victor.kesten@coop.se) or the recruiter Andreas Nilsson (andreas.nilsson2@coop.se)


*Welcome with your application!*

title: Incident & Operations Engineer I
description:
Sinch is pioneering the way the world communicates. More than 150,000 businesses — including Google, Uber, Paypal, Visa, Tinder, and many others — rely on Sinch’s Customer Communications Cloud to power engaging customer experiences through mobile messaging, voice, and email.


Whether you need to verify users or craft omnichannel campaigns, Sinch makes it easy. Our AI-infused Super Network, APIs, and applications ensure you can connect with your customers reliably and securely, at every step of their journey.


At Sinch we “Dream Big”, “Win Together”, “Keep it simple”, and “Make it Happen”. These values are our foundation!


**DESCRIPTION**

We are looking for an Incident & Operations Engineer I to join our Technical Operations Center team in Kalmar. In this role, you will focus on incident management, ensuring smooth operations with internal systems, and providing critical support in resolving technical issues. Additionally, you will play a key role in supporting our operator and provider partners to maintain high-quality service delivery.


We tackle every challenge together as a team, sharing the workload no matter how complex it gets! With our 24/7 operations, we are dedicated to resolving incidents swiftly and keeping business disruptions to an absolute minimum. To help us maintain this high standard of service, your day-to-day responsibilities will include:


* Collaborate with internal teams to ensure smooth resolution of issues.
* Conduct in-depth troubleshooting at both the software and network layers to identify and resolve technical problems.
* Act as Incident Manager for our core services, ensuring timely resolutions and minimizing system downtime.
* Monitor internal alerts and ensure incidents are managed and escalated as needed.
* Document and track alerts and incidents for future improvements.
Use insights from resolved incidents to drive ongoing system improvements and optimization. to ensure smooth resolution of issues.  
* 

  

**REQUIREMENTS**

Sinch is a tech company through and through where great ideas are listened to and often implemented - we want you to feel part of the bigger picture!


This role is full of challenges and offers plenty of opportunities to grow. To thrive here, you’ll need a curious mindset and a passion for learning. A “can-do” attitude will help you turn obstacles into opportunities and keep you moving forward.


* **Education** : A Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related technical field (or equivalent professional experience).
* **Communication** : Excellent written and verbal English communication skills, with the ability to explain technical issues clearly to both internal teams and external partners.
* **Problem-Solving** : Strong analytical skills and a methodical approach to troubleshooting software or system alerts.
* **Composure** : The ability to stay calm and focused in a high-pressure environment, especially when managing multiple tasks or urgent incidents.
* **Flexibility** : Ability to work in a 24/7 shift rotation, including nights and weekends.
* **Location** : Able to work onsite at our office in Kalmar, Sweden.

In addition to the above, it is a strong advantage if you have:


* Hands-on experience with incident management and platform monitoring.
* Understanding of the TCP/IP protocol suite.
* Experience collaborating effectively with internal teams and stakeholders, demonstrating accountability and the ability to take ownership of issues.
* Knowledge with UNIX and Linux systems.
* Background in telecoms and wireless communication.
* Understanding of mobile communications standards like GSM and 4G.
* Basic SQL skills.

Our corporate language is English, please submit your application in **English**

**OUR HIRING PROCESS**

We are committed to ensuring a recruitment process that is fair, objective, consistent, and inclusive. Our approach includes structured, competency-based interviews designed to evaluate your skills, experience, and qualifications relevant to the role. At times, we may include a data-driven assessment to enhance our hiring success and identify candidates likely to excel.


We believe in a two-way process and encourage you to ask questions throughout the journey. If this role isn't what you're looking for, please explore the other opportunities listed on our career page: https://www.sinch.com/careers/.


No matter who you are, we hope you find an exciting path forward - hopefully with us!


**Salary**

The monthly salary for this position is between 30 000 SEK to 35 000 SEK. Factors which may affect pay within this range may include skills, education, experience, and other qualifications.

title: Cloud Architect inom Google Cloud
description:
Vill du arbeta med några av marknadens mest moderna molnlösningar och hjälpa företag att accelerera sin digitala transformation genom Google Cloud?
  
Vi söker nu en erfaren Cloud Architect som vill ta en nyckelroll i ett snabbväxande konsultbolag med stark specialistkompetens inom Google Cloud. Här får du möjlighet att arbeta nära kunder, leda tekniska initiativ och påverka både arkitektur, strategi och implementation i komplexa molnmiljöer.
  
Rollen passar dig som drivs av teknik, trivs i en konsultativ roll och vill arbeta i framkant inom moln, AI och digitalisering.
  
OM BOLAGET
  
Bolaget är en ledande specialist inom Google Cloud och hjälper företag att accelerera sin digitala transformation genom moderna molnplattformar, produktivitetslösningar och AI-drivna tjänster.
  
Verksamheten präglas av innovation, teknisk spetskompetens och ett starkt fokus på att skapa affärsvärde för kunderna. Teamet består av erfarna specialister som arbetar nära kunder genom hela resan – från strategi och rådgivning till implementation, utbildning och långsiktig utveckling.
  
Bolaget befinner sig i en expansiv fas och erbjuder en internationell arbetsmiljö där samarbete, kunskapsdelning och kontinuerlig utveckling står i centrum.
  
OM ROLLEN
  
Som Cloud Architect ansvarar du för att leda och utveckla kunders molnresor med fokus på Google Cloud Platform. Rollen kombinerar tekniskt ledarskap, rådgivning och kundnära arbete där du får vara delaktig genom hela leveransprocessen.
  
Du arbetar nära kunder, utvecklingsteam och interna specialister för att designa framtidssäkra lösningar och säkerställa att kundernas molnmiljöer är skalbara, säkra och optimerade.
  
  

**Arbetsuppgifterna innefattar bland annat:**  

Leda kundprojekt inom Google Cloud Platform från planering till implementation
  
Genomföra workshops, utbildningar och tekniska rådgivningsinsatser
  
Designa och utveckla skalbara molnarkitekturer utifrån kundernas verksamhetsbehov
  
Ge tekniskt stöd och lösa komplexa tekniska utmaningar hos kunder
  
Arbeta nära kundernas utvecklingsteam för att implementera best practice inom molnteknik
  
Delta i både pre-sales och post-sales samt stötta säljorganisationen med teknisk expertis
  
Bidra till kundernas AI-strategi och vägleda dem i användningen av moderna AI-tjänster inom Google Cloud
  
Säkerställa hög kvalitet inom molnsäkerhet, governance och kostnadsoptimering
  
  

Rollen erbjuder stor frihet under ansvar och passar dig som vill kombinera djup teknisk kompetens med ett konsultativt arbetssätt.
  
VI SÖKER DIG SOMHar minst fem års erfarenhet som Cloud Architect eller i en liknande kundnära teknisk roll
  
Har gedigen erfarenhet av Google Cloud Platform och moderna molnarkitekturer
  
Har praktisk erfarenhet av att designa och implementera skalbara molnlösningar
  
Har erfarenhet av att leda kundprojekt, workshops och tekniska utbildningar
  
Har arbetat konsultativt och trivs i en rådgivande roll gentemot kunder
  
Har god förståelse för molnsäkerhet, compliance och kostnadsoptimering
  
Kommunicerar obehindrat på svenska och engelska
  
EXTRA MERITERANDE OM DUHar specialistkompetens inom exempelvis data, infrastruktur eller AI på Google Cloud
  
Har Google Cloud-certifieringar eller motsvarande certifieringar från andra molnplattformar
  
Har tidigare arbetat hos en Google Cloud-partner eller liknande specialistkonsultbolag
  
Har erfarenhet av multicloud- eller hybridmolnsmiljöer
  
ÖVRIG INFORMATION
  
**Omfattning:** Heltid
  
**Start:** Enligt överenskommelse
  
**Lön:** Konkurrenskraftig med attraktiva förmåner
  
**Arbetstider:** Kontorstider
  
**Plats:** Stockholm med möjlighet till hybridarbete
  
REKRYTERINGSPROCESS & KONTAKT
  
Detta är en direktrekrytering, vilket innebär att kandidaten som får tjänsten blir anställd direkt hos vår kund. Rekryteringsprocessen hanteras av Nordicrule och vår kund önskar att alla frågor rörande tjänsten mejlas in till Nordicrule.
  
**Fahim Gani:** fahim.gani@nordicrule.se
  
PS. För att säkerställa en trygg och säker hantering av dina personuppgifter tar vi inte emot ansökningar via e-post. Skicka därför in din ansökan genom att klicka på ”Ansök nu”.
  
Vi ser fram emot din ansökan, lycka till!

title: Account Manager
description:
**We’re looking for an Account Manager to join us at Telia.**

I'm Jesper Landin, Head of Sales Account Management South, and I'm looking for an Account Manager to join my team. Together, we help medium-sized businesses across Sweden unlock growth by building trusted partnerships and connecting them with solutions that create long-term business value.  



**What you'll do**

As an Account Manager, you will take ownership of a portfolio of approximately 80 existing business customers within the medium-sized enterprise segment. Your mission is to strengthen customer relationships, drive revenue growth, and ensure that Telia remains a trusted strategic partner for every customer in your portfolio.  



You will:


* Build and develop long-term relationships with existing business customers across Southern Sweden.
* Drive revenue growth through upselling, cross-selling, contract renewals, and identifying new business opportunities.
* Take full commercial ownership of your customer portfolio, balancing customer retention with business expansion.
* Develop account plans, customer analyses, and business cases to identify growth potential.
* Lead customer meetings and discussions with decision-makers, creating trust and long-term partnership opportunities.
* Represent Telia's full B2B portfolio, including connectivity, cloud services, collaboration solutions, security, and digital workplace offerings.
* Collaborate with specialists, solution experts, and internal stakeholders to deliver the best customer outcomes.
* Manage opportunities, customer activities, and agreements within Salesforce and related tools.
* Ensure high customer satisfaction and contribute to customer loyalty and retention initiatives.
* Achieve and exceed commercial targets and KPIs.

**What will help you thrive in this role**

You are a relationship builder who enjoys working closely with customers and creating business value. You combine commercial drive with a genuine interest in understanding customer challenges and helping them succeed. At the same time, you're structured, analytical, and comfortable navigating a dynamic environment with multiple parallel opportunities and stakeholders.  



We believe you'll be successful if you have:


* Experience in account management, B2B sales, customer success, or another customer-facing commercial role.
* Proven ability to build trusted relationships and engage with decision-makers.
* Strong commercial acumen with experience identifying, developing, and closing business opportunities.
* Experience managing customer portfolios and balancing retention with growth.
* Confidence presenting solutions, leading customer discussions, and building credibility with stakeholders.
* Experience working with CRM systems such as Salesforce or similar platforms.
* A structured and analytical approach to managing pipelines, opportunities, and customer plans.
* Interest in technology, digital solutions, telecommunications, IT services, SaaS, cloud, or related areas.
* Excellent stakeholder management and collaboration skills.
* Ability to work independently while leveraging expertise from colleagues and specialists when needed.
* Fluency in Swedish and good English communication skills.
* A valid driver's license and willingness to travel ocasionally within your customer region.

**Bonus points if you have**

* Experience from telecommunications, IT services, cloud solutions, SaaS, or technology sales.
* Experience selling a broad and diverse product portfolio.
* Experience engaging with multiple stakeholders across medium-sized business customers.

**Location**

This position is based in **Gothenburg or Malmö, Sweden** . We work in a hybrid setup, combining office and remote work, with regular office presence expected.  



**Join us to shape smarter living for people, businesses, and the planet**
--------------------------------------------------------------------------

At Telia, we're a team of 15,000 colleagues across the Nordics and Baltics, passionate about technology and connectivity. As a Leading Telecommunications Operator and Climate Leader, we drive change through impactful projects while building a more sustainable and inclusive world.


Here, you'll have the opportunity to grow your skills, work with some of Sweden's most exciting businesses, and make a real impact on how organizations connect, collaborate, and grow. description:
*To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.*

Job Category


Sales
Job Details


**About Salesforce**

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.


Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.


**We’re Salesforce** , the Customer Company, inspiring the future of business with AI+ Data +CRM. Leading with our core values, we help companies across every industry blaze new trails and connect with customers in a whole new way. And, we empower you to be a Trailblazer, too — driving your performance and career growth, charting new paths, and improving the state of the world. If you believe in business as the greatest platform for change and in companies doing well and doing good – you’ve come to the right place.
  

Our Enterprise Business team focuses on working with our most strategic customers and organizations of 10,000+ employees. You will have the opportunity to work in a fast-paced team with various customers and receive personalized training and career opportunities.
  

  

**About the role:**  

This is a unique opportunity to join a highly successful team of seasoned Enterprise Account Executives working with the company's Top Accounts. Salesforce is looking for very hardworking, high EQ and passionate individuals who can effectively articulate how & why our solutions can help transform Customers’ business and exceed their goals.
  

Salesforce aspires to deliver business transformation enabled by technology to its customers and therefore requires individuals able to develop deep insight into the business dynamics of large sophisticated enterprises and help shape customers' change agenda.
  

  

**Your Day-to-Day:*** Our Enterprise Account Executives engage with existing customers and new leads to sell the entire Salesforce Customer 360 platform. They build positive, trusted relationships with both key team members and c-suite decision makers within their patch, and become naturals at helping customers realize value from their Salesforce investments.
* You will use your skills to develop opportunities, through both warm leads and whitespace prospecting.
* Develop key customer stakeholder relationships and drive customer satisfaction at assigned accounts
* Develop and drive the overall long-term strategy for the account, aligned to customer business objectives
* Coordinate internal Salesforce resources to meet customer business needs
* Perform account planning at assigned accounts, coordinating with Prime and Cloud sales resources to ensure strategic alignment
* Share Salesforce value proposition for existing and/or new customers
* Drive growth within an existing assigned account
* Preferred Qualifications:
* 10+ years of full-cycle sales experience in the Swedish market
* Ability to strategize with a large extended team

**What we look for in you:*** Effective communicator & quick learner: Ability to articulate how & why our solutions can help transform Customers’ business and exceed their goals.
* Successfully run complex SaaS sales deals: Ability to develop sophisticated deal structures and commercial proposals for large deals.
* Strong analytical & problem-solving skills are essential
* Strong influencing capabilities; must be a self-starter, high-energy
* Strong appetite to work in a strategic selling environment.
* Fluent in English and Swedish + Right to work in Sweden

**Working at Salesforce**  

Working at Salesforce isn’t all about selling. It’s also about learning, and we heavily invest in you with a month-long immersion and onboarding, including a week-long product boot camp, mentorship program, weekly coaching and development programs.  

  

Unleash Your Potential


When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and *be your best* , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can *do your best* . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.


Accommodations


If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form .


Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates’ resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options.


Posting Statement


Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education.

title: Postdoctoral Fellow in Marine Cloud Brightening
description:
**The Department of Meteorology** at Stockholm University (MISU) conducts research and education spanning the atmosphere, ocean and physical climate sciences. We offer educational programmes at the Bachelors, Masters and PhD levels. Our research addresses fundamental questions concerning the dynamics, physics, chemistry and biogeochemistry of the atmosphere and ocean relevant for weather and climate. We study questions originating from the deep ocean to the upper atmosphere and from the tropics to the poles. In this effort, we use and develop theory, statistical methods, and numerical models in close interplay with observations. We also develop and lead observational research using satellite and surface-based measurements, including icebreaker expeditions to the Arctic.  

  

MISU is embedded in a larger research environment including the Bolin Centre for Climate Research, the Baltic Sea Centre, and the Swedish e-Science Research Centre. The department is highly international, with over half our employees coming from outside Sweden. For more information about us, please visit the Department of Meteorology's website.

**Project description**
-----------------------


Marine Cloud Brightening (MCB) is a method for deliberate climate intervention, to temporarily dampen the ongoing global warming. It aims to make clouds more reflective and thereby more cooling, by adding sea salt aerosols. Although it is known that more aerosol particles lead to more smaller droplets, and greater reflection, aerosol-cloud interactions are associated with large uncertainties.


To realistically evaluate MCB and its potentials and risks, there is a need for better basic knowledge about aerosol influence on cloud properties, and how this in turn affects radiation, temperature and circulation. At the same time, it is necessary to consider ethical and societal perspectives of MCB as a form of climate intervention, e.g. in how to assess benefits and risks, when they are both uncertain and unevenly distributed among nations and generations.


This project is interdisciplinary, addressing physical, ethical and socio-political aspects of MCB, to support a general assessment of its feasibility.

**Main responsibilities**
-------------------------


You will work primarily with global climate modelling, and analysis of satellite data, to evaluate to what degree natural experiments and model simulations can provide knowledge on deliberate climate intervention, and to survey risks and benefits of potential implementation strategies against different climate change scenarios. The natural science questions, design of simulations, and analysis of results will be guided by questions of ethics and policy. The work will be done in collaboration with researchers in philosophy and political science, who are also part of the team. Within the framework of the project you will be expected to take independent initiative regarding analysis and inquiries and you will be part of a research group where you will also get a chance to contribute to advising of a PhD student.

**Qualification requirements**
------------------------------


In order to qualify for a Postdoctoral position, applicants are required to hold a Swedish doctoral degree or an equivalent relevant degree from another country. The degree must have been completed no later than when the employment decision is made.

**Assessment criteria**
-----------------------


It is considered an advantage if the doctoral degree or an equivalent degree was completed no more than three years prior to the application deadline. Under special circumstances, an older degree may also be an advantage. Special circumstances refer to sick leave, parental leave, elected positions in trade unions, service in the total defense, or other similar circumstances, as well as clinical attachment or service/assignments relevant to the subject area.


The doctoral degree must be in meteorology, atmospheric sciences, oceanography or a related field. In the appointment process, special attention will be given to research skills within the area of the employment. In addition, analytical ability, creativity, initiative, independence and collaboration skills will be considered. An excellent command of written and spoken English is also required.

**About the employment**
------------------------


The position involves full-time employment for a minimum of two years and a maximum of three years, with the possibility of extension under special circumstances. Start date 2027-01-01 or as per agreement.


Stockholm University strives to be a workplace free from discrimination and with equal opportunities for all.

**Contact**
-----------


Further information about the position can be obtained from Professor Frida Bender, frida.bender@misu.su.se.


For information about the recruitment process and terms of employment, please contact Head of Administration Sara Engström, sara.engstrom@misu.su.se.

**Application**
---------------


Apply for the position at Stockholm University's recruitment system. Attach a personal letter and CV as well as the attachments requested in the application form. It is the responsibility of the applicant to ensure that the application is complete in accordance with the instructions in the job advertisement, and that it is submitted before the deadline.  

  

*We ask that you please refrain from submitting a completely AI-generated application.*
