title: Enterprisearkitekt
description:
**Jobbeskrivning**
 Vill du vara med och skapa lösningar som verkligen gör skillnad för samhället? Som Enterprisearkitekt på Sopra Steria får du möjlighet att arbeta i spännande och varierande projekt som driver teknisk innovation och skapar verklig nytta. Här samarbetar du nära både kollegor och kunder inom arkitektur och utveckling för att ligga i framkant av digital transformation.
   

  

 I din roll planerar, designar och hanterar du kundernas IT-infrastruktur och affärsprocesser med fokus på att tydligt stödja verksamhetens övergripande mål och strategi. Du skapar en helhetsbild av organisationens IT-stöd och säkerställer att alla delar samverkar sömlöst. Det innebär att du utvecklar framtidssäkra IT-arkitekturer, från strategi och målarkitektur till lösningsdesign, som gör kundernas verksamheter effektivare, mer hållbara och framgångsrika.
   

  

**Vem är du?**
 Du är en erfaren IT-arkitekt som brinner för att koppla samman teknik och affärsstrategi. Du har en förmåga att se helheten och omsätta komplexa behov till smarta, skalbara lösningar som verkligen fungerar i praktiken.
   

  

 Du har relevant utbildning inom IT och flera års erfarenhet av att utveckla och implementera arkitektur som löser verkliga affärsutmaningar.
   

  

* Du är van att lyssna in och analysera krav från olika intressenter och översätta dem till tydliga, effektiva verksamhetsmodeller och IT-lösningar.
* Du har en bred tekniks förståelse och har god insikt i mjukvaruutveckling, databaser, nätverk, molntjänster, dataanalys och processkartläggning.
* Du är en lagspelare som samarbetar smidigt med system- och domänarkitekter för att skapa en sammanhållen IT-miljö som stödjer hela organisationen.
* Du har god kommunikativ förmåga och förklarar tekniska koncept på ett lättillgängligt sätt, oavsett om du pratar med IT-experter eller verksamhetsansvariga.
* Svenska och engelska behärskar du flytande i både tal och skrift.
* Meriterande med relevanta certifieringar


**Varför välja Sopra Steria?**
* En plats där din kompetens verkligen gör skillnad – Vi bygger smarta och hållbara lösningar som förbättrar samhälle och verksamheter med användarupplevelsen i centrum.
* Stark företagskultur med Power of Sharing – Vi tror på kraften i kunskapsdelning, transparens och samarbete. Hos oss når vi längre tillsammans.
* Toppbetyg som arbetsplats – Great Place to Work har rankat oss år efter år som en av Sveriges bästa arbetsplatser och vi har mottagit utmärkelsen Karriärföretag flera år i rad.
* Del av en europeisk ledare inom digital transformation – Med över 50 000 experter i många länder kan vi både påverka stora projekt och ge dig möjligheter att växa globalt.
* Värderingar som genomsyrar allt vi gör – Vi sätter kundens behov i fokus, värderar respekt, professionalitet, nyfikenhet och en kollektiv förmåga att agera positivt och skapa hållbara resultat tillsammans.


**Ansökan**
 Nu vill vi gärna höra lite om dig! Ansök enkelt genom att antingen ladda upp ditt CV eller länka direkt till ditt LinkedIn-konto via annonsen. Om det fortfarande finns något du funderar över är du välkommen att kontakta rekryterande chef Marie Berg, marie.berg@soprasteria.com eller Talent Acquisition Partner Johan Westman, johan.westman@soprasteria.com
   

  

 Vi ser fram emot att få höra ifrån dig!
   

  

 På Sopra Steria ställer vi höga krav på både kompetens och säkerhetsmedvetenhet hos våra medarbetare. Innan en eventuell anställning kommer du därför att genomgå en bakgrundskontroll, och vid intervju behöver du kunna uppvisa giltig legitimation.

title: Data Architect inom DWH och BI
description:
Vi söker en
 **Data Warehouse / BI / Data Architect** 
 som är lika bekväm med att definiera målarkitektur och informationsmodeller som med att arbeta hands-on med utveckling. Rollen omfattar både
 **on-premises-** 
 och
 **molnmiljöer** 
 och täcker hela datalivscykeln – från extraktion från källsystem och orkestrering, via transformation och modellering, till rapportering och konsumtion.
   

  

 Detta är en kundnära konsultroll, vilket innebär att du ska kunna arbeta direkt med intressenter, översätta verksamhetskrav till robust dataarkitektur och stötta leveransteam tekniskt.
   

  

****Huvudsakliga ansvarsområden****
* Designa och ansvara för end-to-end-arkitektur för Data Warehouse/dataplattformar i både on-premises- och molnmiljöer.
* Definiera informationsmodeller och datastrukturer med balans mellan verksamhetens krav och en skalbar, förvaltningsbar design.
* Delta hands-on i utvecklingen – bygga pipelines, datamodeller och rapporter tillsammans med leveransteamet, inte enbart ta fram design på papper.
* Vägleda team kring val av modelleringsmetod (Data Vault vs. Kimball) samt lämplig lakehouse-/medallion-struktur utifrån användningsområdet.
* Vara teknisk kontaktperson för kunder inom dataarkitektur, plattformsval och moderniseringsplaner.
* Stötta pre-sales och lösningsscoping med arkitekturkompetens och estimat vid behov.


****Teknisk profil****
****On-Premises (MS Stack)****
* Microsoft SQL Server (databasmotor, SSIS/SSAS är meriterande, prestandaoptimering).
* Power BI Report Server (on-premises-rapportering).


****Cloud****
* Microsoft Azure & Fabric: Azure SQL/Synapse, Fabric (Lakehouse, OneLake, Data Warehouse), Power BI Service.
* AWS: hosting och dataplattformstjänster generellt.
* Snowflake: som primär molnbaserad dataplattform på AWS-sidan.


****Språk & datatransformation****
* Goda kunskaper i SQL för frågor, transformation och prestandaoptimering.
* Goda kunskaper i Python för datatransformation och scripting.


****Orkestrering & extraktion****
* Azure Data Factory (ADF) för pipeline-orkestrering.
* Python / Notebooks / Spark för orkestrering, extraktion och storskalig databehandling.


****Datamodellering & arkitekturmönster****
* Data Vault-modellering.
* Kimball-modellering (Fact/Dimension, star schema).
* Data lakehouse-arkitektur.
* Medallion architecture (Bronze/Silver/Gold-lager).


****Ytterligare kompetenser som är relevanta****
 Följande kompetenser ser vi som meriterande:
   

  

* Data governance och katalogisering (t.ex. Microsoft Purview, Unity Catalog) – något som i allt högre grad förväntas i samband med lakehouse-/Fabric-arbete.
* Ramverk för datakvalitet och testning (t.ex. dbt, Great Expectations) för transformationspipelines.
* CI/CD för dataplattformar (Azure DevOps, Git-baserad deployment av pipelines/notebooks).
* Infrastructure as Code (Bicep/ARM/Terraform) för provisionering av resurser till molnbaserade dataplattformar.
* Förståelse för datasäkerhet och compliancefrågor (row-level security, GDPR) i rapporteringslager.
* Delta Lake / Parquet och öppna tabellformat, relevanta för lakehouse-implementationer.
* Erfarenhet av dimensionell/semantisk modellering i Power BI (star schemas, DAX) utöver att enbart bygga rapporter.
* Relevanta certifieringar, exempelvis Microsoft Azure Data Engineer/Architect, Fabric-certifieringar eller SnowPro.
* God kommunikativ förmåga gentemot intressenter samt förmåga att förklara arkitektoniska avvägningar för icke-tekniska målgrupper.


**Övriga krav**
* Har minst 6 års relevant yrkeserfarenhet.
* Har en relevant eftergymnasial utbildning.
* Behärskar svenska och engelska väl i både tal och skrift.


****Egenskaper hos dig****
* Tänker på arkitektnivå och har samtidigt en genuin vilja att fortsätta arbeta hands-on med utveckling.
* Är bekväm med att arbeta både i äldre on-premises-baserade Microsoftmiljöer och i moderna cloud-/lakehouseplattformar.
* Är pragmatisk i valet av modelleringsmetod (Data Vault vs. Kimball) utifrån situationen, snarare än att alltid utgå från en och samma modell.
* Har ett konsultmässigt arbetssätt: är bekväm i kundnära sammanhang och kan anpassa sig till olika kundmiljöer och begränsningar.


**Vi är Nion**
 På Nion kombinerar vi teknisk spetskompetens med ett starkt engagemang för att hjälpa våra kunder nå framgång. Vi är stolta över att vara en flexibel partner på den digitala resan, där vi erbjuder både individuella specialister som förstärker kundens team och kompletta, välkoordinerade team från våra interna utvecklingsteam. Våra lösningar sträcker sig från avancerad affärsautomation och AI till skräddarsydd systemutveckling, stabil drift och support samt dataarkitektur och analys som omvandlar data till insiktsfulla beslut.
   

  

 Med över 200 skickliga konsulter och kontor i Stockholm, Göteborg, Malmö, Oslo, Skopje och Bitola, har vi hjälpt företag världen över att växa genom innovation, samarbete och ett passionerat fokus på resultat. Våra kärnvärden –
 **samarbete** 
 ,
 **engagemang** 
 och
 **innovation** 
 – driver oss att ständigt leverera lösningar som gör skillnad, både för våra kunder och för våra medarbetare.
   

  

**Vårt löfte till dig**
 Våra fantastiska medarbetare är hjärtat i vår framgång. Därför gör vi allt för att skapa en arbetsplats där du känner dig inspirerad, uppskattad och ständigt växer. När du jobbar på Nion får du:
   

  

* Kompetensutveckling – Utbildningar, workshops och individuella utvecklingsplaner för att nå dina mål.
* En stark gemenskap – Teamkänsla, AW:s, gamingkvällar, konferenser och fester.
* Globala möjligheter – Med kunder över hela världen är variation och spännande projekt en självklarhet.
* Livsbalans – Flexibla arbetstider, friskvårdsbidrag och välmåendefokuserade initiativ.
* Generösa förmåner – 30 dagars semester, premiepension, årsbonus, möjlighet till delägarskap och mycket mer.


 Hos oss handlar det om att ha roligt samtidigt som vi tillsammans levererar lösningar som verkligen gör skillnad!

title: Associate DevSecOps Engineer - based in Luxembourg
description:
**This position is based at our Luxembourg headquarters and requires regular office presence. The EIB offers you the opportunity to live and work in a truly international and multi-cultural environment.** 
**We also offer relocation support.**
 The
 **EIB** 
 , the European Union's bank, is seeking to recruit for its Group Information Systems Directorate (GIS), Core Platforms & Resilience Department (CPR), Platform Engineering & Operations Division (PEO), Cloud, DevSecOps & SDLC Enablement Unit (CDSE) at its headquarters in Luxembourg, an
 **Associate DevSecOps Engineer** 
**\*.**
**This is a full-time position at grade 4 for which the EIB offers a permanent contract.**
* internal benchmark Associate Engineer IT Technology & Infrastructure


*Panel interviews are foreseen as from June 2026*
 Purpose
   

  

 The Associate DevSecOps Engineer plays a key role in embedding security into every stage of the software delivery lifecycle. Working closely with experienced DevSecOps engineers as well as development, infrastructure and security teams. This role contributes to building and improving secure, automated and compliant delivery pipelines and platforms.
   

  

 This position offers the opportunity to drive the adoption of DevSecOps practices across teams and support resilient CI/CD pipelines and cloud environments. It also provides hands-on exposure to vulnerability management, security monitoring and modern secure software delivery in a collaborative and evolving technology environment.
   

  

 Operating Network
   

  

 You will report to the Head of Cloud, DevSecOps & SDLC Enablement Unit (CDSE) unit and will cooperate with other platform teams in the same department as well as application teams in other departments Units, transversal teams IN Group Information Systems Directorate (GIS).
   

  

 Accountabilities
   

  

**DevSecOps Platform Support & Operations**
* Contribute to the operation and day‑to‑day support of the DevSecOps toolchain (e.g. CI/CD platforms, code repositories, artefact management, infrastructure‑as‑code tooling), ensuring availability, stability and secure configuration of platform components.
* Assist in the maintenance of secure CI/CD pipeline templates and shared components, applying platform standards and security baselines defined by the unit.


**SDLC Enablement & Governance Support**
* Support the rollout and adoption of the EIB SDLC framework, including the implementation of mandatory quality gates, automated controls, and evidence collection mechanisms across delivery pipelines.
* Help delivery teams understand and apply SDLC requirements by providing practical guidance, examples, and tooling support, under the supervision of senior engineers.


**Security Integration & Automation**
* Assist in embedding security controls into the DevOps lifecycle, including static and dynamic code analysis, dependency and artefact scanning, secrets management, and infrastructure security checks.
* Support the monitoring and remediation of security findings identified through automated scans, working with delivery teams and senior DevSecOps engineers to prioritise and resolve issues.


**Collaboration With Delivery Teams**
* Act as a first‑line technical contact for GIS software delivery teams on DevSecOps and SDLC platform usage, escalating complex issues where appropriate.
* Collaborate with developers, testers, platform engineers and security stakeholders to improve developer experience while maintaining compliance‑by‑design.
* Participate in communication and change management activities as an integrated aspect of IT solutions, infrastructure or processes.


**Continuous Improvement & Knowledge Management**
* Contribute to the continuous improvement of DevSecOps and SDLC practices by documenting lessons learned, updating technical documentation, and proposing incremental enhancements to tooling and processes.
* Recommend tools, technologies, and incremental improvements to overall quality and security of products infrastructure.


**Compliance, Risk & Operational Discipline**
* Apply established security, risk, and compliance requirements (including internal policies and regulatory obligations) when supporting platform components and delivery pipelines.
* Ensure that operational activities are performed in line with change, incident and problem management processes, contributing to audit readiness and traceability.


**Qualifications**
* University degree (minimum an equivalent to a Bachelor) preferably in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering or a related field.
* At least 3 years of relevant professional experience in IT engineering roles related to DevOps, systems administration, cloud operations, software delivery, or security engineering.
* Basic hands‑on experience with software delivery pipelines (CI/CD) and operational environments, ideally supporting development or platform teams.
* Foundational understanding of DevSecOps principles, including “shift‑left” security and automation of controls.
* Introductory experience with cloud or virtualised environments (e.g. Azure, AWS, VMware, container platforms).
* Awareness of infrastructure‑as‑code concepts and automated provisioning, even if mainly assisting or consuming existing modules.
* Familiarity with containerisation concepts (e.g. Docker images, registries), at user level rather than platform design level.
* Basic proficiency in scripting or automation languages (e.g. Python, Bash, PowerShell), sufficient to read, adapt and troubleshoot scripts.
* Excellent knowledge of English and/or French (\*\*\*), with a good command of the other. (Knowledge of other EU languages would be an advantage).


 Competencies
   

  

**Find Out More About EIB Core Behavioural Skills Here**
 To find out more about our eligibility criteria click here
   

  

*(\*\*\*) Unless stated explicitly as a required qualification, a good command of French is not a pre-requisite for hire. As both English and French are however official working languages of the EIB, proficiency in both languages is a pre-requisite for your future career development. Any language clause in your contract must be fulfilled in order for you to be eligible for a promotion (either via the annual appraisal cycle or via an internal selection process). Proficiency is understood to mean the attainment of* 
*level 5 of the Inter Institutional language courses, corresponding to B1.2 of the Common European Framework of Reference for Languages (CEFRL). The Bank offers appropriate training support.*
 We hire and value talent with unique characteristics, creating a work environment where they can be themselves. We believe that Diversity, Equity and Inclusion makes us a performing and innovative organisation. We encourage all suitably qualified and eligible candidates to apply regardless of their gender identity/expression, age, racial, ethnic and cultural background, religion and beliefs, sexual orientation, disability or neurodiversity.
   

  

 If you require reasonable accommodation during the recruitment process due to a disability, neurodivergence, or a chronic health condition, please contact the EIB Recruitment team Jobs@eib.org who will manage your request appropriately.
   

  

 By applying for this position, you acknowledge the importance of maintaining the security and integrity of the Information of the EIB Group. In case of selection for the position you agree to comply with all measures (policies, controls, document classification and management) implemented by the EIB Group to prevent unauthorised disclosure of any information or any damage to the EIB Group reputation.
   

  

*This is an open campaign to consecutively fill open positions. The campaign will remain open until position is filled. Applications will be reviewed in order of receipt.*

title: OT Cybersecurity Specialist
description:
Du som vill göra verklig skillnad för industri och samhälle genom smart cybersäkerhet i OT-miljöer kommer att trivas i den här rollen. Hos HiQ i Stockholm får du vara med där fabriker, energisystem och infrastruktur hålls i gång varje dag.
   

  

 Som OT Cybersecurity Specialist hos HiQ hjälper du kunder att skydda fabriker, energisystem och annan samhällskritisk infrastruktur. Du arbetar praktiskt i OT- och ICS-miljöer och är en viktig länk mellan drift, teknik och säkerhet. Rollen innebär att du både förstår processerna i anläggningen och kan omsätta regelverk och standarder till fungerande lösningar. I vardagen stöttar du både tekniska team och beslutsfattare och gör komplexa säkerhetsfrågor begripliga och hanterbara.
   

  

 Du kommer att:
   

  

* Genomföra risk och gap-analyser i OT- och ICS-miljöer och tydliggöra prioriteringar för kunden
* Designa och stödja implementering av säkerhetsarkitektur och skyddsåtgärder i industriella miljöer
* Arbeta med industriella nätverk, segmentering och säker fjärråtkomst i produktionsnära system
* Bidra till policyer, processer och styrning för OT-säkerhet och följa upp att de fungerar i praktiken
* Stödja kunder i audits, säkerhetsbedömningar och förbättringsprogram och följa upp åtgärder över tid


 Vi tror att du har:
   

  

* Teknisk examen inom till exempel maskin, mekatronik, cybersäkerhet, datateknik eller likvärdigt område
* Cirka sex års erfarenhet av OT- eller ICS-cybersäkerhet och praktiskt arbete i industriella miljöer, till exempel tillverkning, energi eller infrastruktur
* God förståelse för PLC, SCADA och DCS samt erfarenhet av industriella nätverk och protokoll
* Erfarenhet av att arbeta med eller implementera säkerhetsstandarder och regelverk i OT miljöer
* Mycket goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, i tal och skrift, samt svenskt medborgarskap
* Gärna erfarenhet av övervakning och incidenthantering i OT miljöer, brandväggar, IDS och IPS, tillgångsinventering, konsulterfarenhet och certifieringar som GICSP, CISSP eller CISM


 Varför HiQ?
   

  

 Hos HiQ får du jobba nära kunderna i uppdrag där OT säkerhet verkligen gör skillnad för både industri och samhälle. Du omges av kollegor som gärna delar kunskap, vilket gör det enkelt att både fördjupa dig inom OT och bredda dig mot områden som cybersäkerhet, moln och mjukvaruutveckling. Vi satsar på kontinuerligt lärande genom certifieringar, interna forum och uppdrag som utmanar dig på rätt nivå, och du vet att du har teamet i ryggen när du vill prova nya idéer eller ta nästa steg.
   

  

 Sedan 1995 har HiQ varit konsultbolaget som förenklar världen för både kunder och slutanvändare med hjälp av teknik, design och kommunikation. Vi har alltid haft två tydliga fokus: att ha roligt på jobbet och att leverera lösningar som överträffar förväntningarna – det är det som driver oss framåt. Som HiQare är vi stolta över en kultur som präglas av resultat, ansvar, enkelhet och glädje. Vi tror på att arbeta tillsammans för att nå gemensamma mål och vi lägger stor vikt vid att hjälpa varandra att växa och utvecklas. Hos oss får du inte bara möjlighet att bygga din egen kompetens, utan också chansen att lära, leda och inspirera dina kollegor.

title: Technical Product Manager - SDK
description:
**Company Overview**
 Metrea delivers effects-as-a-service to national security partners across five domains and more than a dozen mission areas. These include airborne ISR, electronic warfare, secure communications, aerial refueling, special air missions, aerial firefighting, and advanced simulation. We own the whole stack: designing, building, and operating turnkey capabilities that give our partners decisive, asymmetric advantage against rapidly evolving threats.
   

  

 Our operating model is built around three interlocking pillars. The Support Groups provide a global shared-service – spanning people, finance, platform, operations, legal, and engagement. This frees up our Core Groups, who develop and own mission capabilities end-to-end, to focus entirely on delivery. The Market Groups apply a regional lens, ensuring that our agile and adaptable capabilities remain aligned to the wicked problems that matter most to our partners across the Americas, EMEA, and Asia-Pacific.
   

  

 At the heart of our model is a simple but powerful idea: be a true partner with skin in the game. Our partners need effects, not just equipment. By owning the full stack – from the lab to the field – we are able to drive a continuous cycle of innovation that keeps our partners ahead. It's a fast-moving, intellectually demanding environment where talented people are given real responsibility, work on problems that matter, and contribute to an enterprise that is growing quickly and deliberately.
   

  

 Headquartered in Washington, DC, with facilities across the United States, the United Kingdom, as well as Continental Europe and Asia-Pacific.
   

  

 Group Overview
   

  

 This role sits within the Digital and Synthetic Capability Unit (D&S) which is committed to providing mission-driven information solutions that seamlessly bridge the digital and physical realms. Leveraging cutting-edge technologies and advanced platforms, we empower operational readiness and elevate situational awareness across diverse domains—including air, maritime, and space.
   

  

 Position Summary
   

  

 We are looking for a technically minded product Owner to shape the developer platform, SDKs and tools used by Metrea teams to build advanced real-time simulations.
   

  

 You will have a key role in maximising the value of our SDK platforms that accelerate development teams to build better and faster. You will report to the Product Lead, owning the roadmaps and backlogs that translate the broader strategy and OKRs into actionable features and priorities for the development teams.
   

  

 You can define what good looks like across APIs, documentation, samples and tools. You will balance business goals, customer needs and engineering implications, driving priorities across multiple agile teams.
   

  

 What You'll Do
   

  

* Focus on product strategy, discovery and value delivery rather than project delivery and coordination.
* Able to support the product lead in key decision making by sharing clear product data such as user feedback, technical implications and market awareness.
* You will be accountable for adoption of the developer platform, including its SDK, using feedback and evidence to understand whether it is helping teams build simulation products faster, more reliably and to a higher standard.
* Conduct discovery with developers, simulation specialists, subject-matter experts and relevant customer stakeholders to understand needs, validate problems and shape product direction.
* Translate business strategy into clear product goals for the team through roadmaps and backlog prioritisation.
* Collaborate with developers, artists, designers, and simulation engineers working in game engine environments (e.g. Unreal Engine).
* Ensure product alignment with long term architecture goals, interoperability standards, and Defence compliance needs.


 What You Bring
   

  

* 4+ years’ product experience building developer platforms or SDK products.
* Experience in product strategy and demonstrable value delivery based on your leadership.
* Ability to break down and communicate complex ideas, features and products in a clear and articulated manner to stakeholders and development teams.
* You have a keen product sense on what makes an API intuitive, what is good documentation and what makes a distributed package reliable.
* Experience translating between technical and product discussions with development teams. You will not be expected to write production code.
* Highly organised and proactive with experience owning and prioritising backlogs across multiple technical teams.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills that promote clarity even with complex subjects.
* Understands the challenges working with cross-functional teams of developers, artists, and designers.


**In addition to the above, any of the following would be beneficial:**
* Has a development or technical background and/or a computer science degree.
* Understand the implications of agile processes and methodologies.
* Interest or experience in real-time 3D, simulation, training systems or synthetic environments.
* Interest or experience in defense, aviation, military technology or government environments.
* Familiarity with Unreal Engine or another game engine.


**Additional Eligibility Qualifications**
* Experience working with military or government organisations, products or services
* Willingness to travel, Metrea is an international organisation with offices and stakeholders in the US, UK and Europe


**Benefits**
* Friskvård of 5K annually
* Parental leave Metrea Management Limited.
* Occupational pension (swe. tjänstepension)
* 30 days of leave
* Bonus Scheme
* Personal development opportunities


 Work Authorization / Security Clearance
   

  

 The employee will have the legal right to work in Sweden and will be able to produce right to work documentation.
   

  

 AAP/EEO Statement
   

  

 Metrea Simulations AB is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or other characteristics protected by law.
   

  

 Position Type and Expected Hours of Work
   

  

 This is a full-time non-exempt position with typical working hours of Monday through Friday, 9:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m. Hours and work shifts may change in accordance with department and business needs. Exempt Employees must have the ability to be on-call and available, as business needs require. Non-Exempt employees may be required to work over 40 hours per week with approval from the department manager.
   

  

 Work Location
   

  

 Stockholm
   

  

 Work Environment
   

  

 This job operates in a hybrid setting, 3 days in the office.
   

  

 Travel
   

  

 Occasionally required.
   

  

**Our Firmware**
 At Metrea, our single core value is Rooted in Humility, and our four cornerstone attributes are Entrepreneurial, Systematic, Discerning, and Over-Deliver. These form what we call our Teammate Firmware. Just like technical firmware connects software and hardware, our Firmware is the constant interface between our mission and our people. It defines how we show up, how we work together, and how we solve complex problems.
   

  

 Our team Firmware creates a web-like, hyper-collaborative, dynamically hierarchical way of working that helps us adapt quickly, communicate openly, and distribute decision-making to where expertise actually lives. It enables groups to self-organize around hard problems, shift fluidly as priorities evolve, and operate with the trust, curiosity, and discipline required in a complex mission space. This foundation allows us to deliver elegant, effective solutions and uphold our purpose: protecting our precious inheritance.

title: Product Manager Personal Safety
description:
*Do you want to develop products and services that help protect lone workers, care staff, teachers, pupils and others when personal safety matters most? As Product Manager for Personal Safety, you will turn customer needs, market insight and technology into strong solutions and bring them successfully to market across Europe.*
 AddSecure is strengthening its Personal Safety product team, and we are looking for a
 **Product Manager** 
 in Stockholm who enjoys combining product development, customer insight and commercial thinking with a hands-on understanding of connected technology.
   

  

**AddSecure** 
 is a leading European provider of secure IoT connectivity and end-to-end solutions. We help customers optimise operations, create business value, and secure vital functions. Our solutions are used in buildings, alarms, transport and logistics, personal safety, elderly care, construction, municipalities, schools, rescue services, power grids, retail and more.
   

  

 Within our Personal Safety business, we provide cloud-based solutions for personal and incident alarms, portable alarm devices, alarm handling with video verification, and push-to-talk communication — supporting organisations and their people when it matters most.
   

  

**About The Job**
 As Product Manager, you will own and develop a portfolio at the heart of our Personal Safety business. The portfolio includes our cloud-based incident response platform and solutions for portable personal alarms with positioning and dispatch. On this platform, we have built offerings for verticals with a growing need for personal safety solutions, including schools and businesses with lone workers.
   

  

 You will be responsible for understanding customer and market needs, shaping the roadmap and working closely with R&D to develop solutions that create clear customer value. You will also play an important role in bringing products successfully to market through positioning, packaging, pricing and go-to-market activities.
   

  

 The portfolio is live in five markets — Sweden, Norway, Finland, Germany and the UK — through both direct sales and a growing reseller channel. This means you will own products at different stages at the same time: scaling new market introductions, and taking full responsibility for the existing installed base, its lifecycle and its profitability.
   

  

 This is a hands-on product role. Our services run on the AddSecure IoT platform, and you will work closely with the technology — testing and verifying solutions to understand how they perform in practice, and understanding how a subscription-based, platform-delivered service actually behaves commercially and technically.
   

  

 Our products are used in situations where seconds matter and the user is often under stress. That puts user experience at the centre of the role: how an alarm is raised, how an incident is handled, and how quickly a new customer gets up and running are product decisions, not details.
   

  

 You will report to the Product Director for Safety Solutions and work in an international team of Product Managers, close to Sales, Marketing, R&D, Operations and our country teams.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Own and develop the roadmap for your portfolio, translating customer needs, market insight and technical opportunities into clear priorities.
* Take full ownership of the portfolio end to end — from new offerings and market introductions to the lifecycle, quality and profitability of products already in the field.
* Grow and develop our personal alarm, alarm handling and communication offerings, and identify opportunities for new products, services and markets.
* Own the user experience across the portfolio — apps, alarm handling interfaces and the everyday flows our customers depend on — and work with UX, R&D and real users to make solutions that are fast, clear and reliable when it matters.
* Work closely with R&D throughout the product lifecycle, from concept and requirements to testing, launch and continuous improvement — including writing requirements that are clear enough to be estimated and delivered.
* Lead the market introduction of new products and services together with Sales, Marketing, Operations and country teams, including positioning, packaging, pricing, sales enablement and launch material.
* Support our expansion in the UK and Germany, including regulatory and compliance-driven requirements such as Martyn's Law in the UK.
* Follow revenue, margin, adoption and other relevant product performance indicators, and use the insights to support priorities and business cases — including recurring revenue, hardware margin and total cost of ownership.
* Drive digital initiatives related to the portfolio, including customer-facing tools and the solutions used to install, commission and support products — with the same attention to user experience as for the products themselves.
* Represent AddSecure at relevant trade fairs and industry events, and bring market insight back into the product roadmap.


**About You**
 You are a hands-on Product Manager who enjoys being close to both customers and technology. You are curious about how products work in practice and comfortable moving between technical discussions, customer needs and business priorities.
   

  

 You can create structure in a complex environment, make decisions based on incomplete information and bring different stakeholders together around clear product priorities. You are self-driven: you take ownership of a topic and drive it to a conclusion on your own initiative, and you are comfortable taking products all the way from idea and development to launch, operation and continuous improvement.
   

  

**We believe you have:**
* Drive, pace and a strong sense of ownership — you are the engine in your own portfolio, you keep things moving, and you take responsibility for the outcome.
* At least 3 years of experience in product management, product ownership or a similar role within B2B technology.
* Experience working with technically complex products or services, ideally within personal safety, alarms, security, connected hardware or other safety-critical environments.
* A strong feel for user experience, and the habit of working with design and R&D to make products simple and dependable to use — including for users who are stressed, untrained or on the move.
* Experience with subscription- or platform-based services — understanding how recurring revenue, releases and an installed base shape product decisions — combined with an understanding of connected hardware.
* Experience taking hardware, software or connected services from development to market, and keeping them healthy afterwards.
* Strong product and commercial judgement, with the ability to balance customer value, technical feasibility and business impact.
* The ability to work effectively across R&D, Sales, Marketing, Operations and international teams.
* Technical fluency to work confidently with connected hardware, software and cloud services, together with a willingness to test and understand products hands-on.
* Experience engaging directly with customers and partners and translating their needs into product priorities and requirements.
* A relevant academic background or equivalent professional experience.
* Fluent English, spoken and written.


 It would be valuable if you also have:
   

  

* Professional Swedish or another Nordic language.
* Experience from IoT connectivity, SaaS or telecom.
* Familiarity with European alarm standards or personal safety standards such as EN 50136, BS 8484 or DGUV requirements for lone worker protection.
* Experience working across several European markets, including the UK or Germany.


**We offer**
 Our employees are our greatest asset and for us it is of great importance to build a culture where our employees thrive and want to perform. You will be part of a motivated team in an international company. In addition, we offer:
   

  

* Wellness allowance
* Occupational pension
* Enhanced parental pay
* Health checks
* Parking


 Start: preferably as soon as possible / according to agreement
   

  

**We're all change makers!**
 If you're looking for an organisation where you can be yourself, have fun at work, and contribute to a safer, smarter, and more sustainable world, AddSecure may be the place for you. Join our growing international team, where every day offers an opportunity to make a real difference.
   

  

 Would you like to take part in our journey? Please apply by submitting your CV and answering a few short questions. We look forward to receiving your application.
   

  

 We use a competence-based recruitment process that may include psychometric assessments, interviews, reference checks, and background checks. As part of the process, candidates may complete assessments provided by Alva Labs to support a fair and structured evaluation.
   

  

 We conduct background checks for all our employees, and you must be eligible to work in Sweden.
   

  

 #addsecure #joinaddsecure #forasaferandsmarterworld #smartertogether #ProductManager #PersonalSafety #IoT #ConnectedTechnology #ProductManagement #B2BTech #SafetyTechnology #TechJobs
   

  

 AddSecure is a leading European provider of secure IoT connectivity and end-to-end solutions. We help customers optimise their operations, drive business value, and secure vital functions. By combining connected, data-driven, and sensor-based solutions with best-in-class expertise, we meet our customers’ needs regardless of industry. Our secure IoT solutions are used within the areas of buildings, alarms, transportation and logistics, personal safety and security, elderly care, construction, municipalities, schools, rescue services, power grids, and more.

title: .NET/DevOps-utvecklare
description:
Startdatum: 2026-10-20
   

  

 Slutdatum: 2027-10-19, Option på förlängning
   

  

 Omfattning: 100%
   

  

 Plats: Hybrid, 3-4 Dagar i Stockholm
   

  

 Uppdragsbeskrivning
   

  

 Vi söker en senior och självgående backendutvecklare med tydlig DevOps-profil. Rollen innebär att förstärka ett tvärfunktionellt team som utvecklar och förvaltar digitala lösningar.
   

  

 Du blir en viktig del av teamets fortsatta utveckling och kommer att arbeta nära andra seniora tekniska kompetenser. Uppdraget omfattar hela kedjan från utveckling och teknisk design till automatisering, molndeployment och drift.
   

  

 Exempel på arbetsuppgifter:
   

  

* Utveckla och vidareutveckla backendtjänster i en modern .NET-baserad miljö.
* Designa, implementera och förvalta mikrotjänster och integrationslösningar.
* Bygga och vidareutveckla automatiserade CI/CD-flöden för utveckling och deployment.
* Utveckla och driftsätta lösningar i Microsoft Azure.
* Arbeta med containerisering och orkestrering i exempelvis Docker och Kubernetes.
* Bidra till teknisk kvalitet, stabilitet, säkerhet och effektivitet i befintliga lösningar.


 Skall-krav
   

  

* Minst 8 års dokumenterad yrkeserfarenhet inom backendutveckling.
* Minst 5 års erfarenhet av .NET eller .NET Core under de senaste 10 åren.
* Minst 3 års erfarenhet av utveckling av mikrotjänster.
* Minst 3 års erfarenhet under de senaste 7 åren av automatiserade bygg- och deploymentprocesser.
* Minst 2 års erfarenhet under de senaste 4 åren av utveckling och deployment i Microsoft Azure.
* Minst 3 års erfarenhet av container-orkestrering, exempelvis med Docker, Kubernetes, AWS ECS/EKS, Fargate eller OpenShift.
* Minst 2 års erfarenhet från tvärfunktionella team med produktansvar och ansvar för leverans samt uppföljning mot intern eller extern kund.
* Minst 1 års erfarenhet av Infrastructure as Code, exempelvis Terraform, Bicep eller motsvarande verktyg.


 Meriterande
   

  

* Minst 1 års erfarenhet av att under de senaste 3 åren förbättra prestanda, robusthet eller säkerhet samt effektivisera integrationer mellan system via exempelvis API, meddelandetjänster eller ETL.
* Minst 2 års dokumenterad erfarenhet av backendutveckling med Java.
* Minst 2 års erfarenhet av att utveckla och driftsätta lösningar baserade på exempelvis MQTT, RabbitMQ eller Kafka.

title: Systemförvaltare inom Linux
description:
***Vill du bidra med dina Linuxkunskaper på en myndighet där du gör verklig skillnad för Sveriges säkerhet? Då kan FOI vara din nya arbetsplats! Vi erbjuder ett arbetsliv i balans, en utvecklande arbetsmiljö och ett samhällsviktigt arbete!***
**Om tjänsten**
 Vi Söker Nu En Eller Flera Engagerade Och Erfarna Linuxspecialister Med Placering i Stockholm. Du Blir En Del Av En Dedikerad Linuxgrupp Som Arbetar Tight Tillsammans, Delar Kunskap Och Fattar Beslut Gemensamt. Arbetet Omfattar
   

  

* Drift, vidareutveckling och optimering av vår Linuxmiljö, inklusive backend-komponenter och distribuerade Linux-system
* Support och tekniskt användarstöd
* Automatisering, förbättring av processer och effektivisering av drift
* Medverkan i projekt relaterade till Linuxbaserade system, klusterlösningar, AI, CI/CD, distribuerade filsystem, containrar och infrastrukturtjänster


**Om enheten**
 Tjänsten tillhör IT-enheten inom avdelningen Forskningsstöd. Här samarbetar vi nära våra forskare och verksamheter för att säkerställa robusta, effektiva och långsiktigt hållbara IT-lösningar. Läs mer om vad vi gör här: Forskningsstöd.
   

  

  

**Har du den kompetensprofil vi behöver?**
**Krav**
**Vi Söker Dig Som Har**
* Relevant utbildning eller motsvarande arbetslivserfarenhet
* Djup teknisk kompetens och flerårig erfarenhet av Linux
* God förmåga inom systemadministration, felsökning och script-utveckling
* Förmåga att uttrycka dig väl på svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift


 Som person är du lösningsorienterad, kommunikativ och ansvarstagande. Du arbetar strukturerat, är självgående och bidrar aktivt till gruppens gemensamma arbetssätt och helhetsleverans. Du värdesätter att beslut fattas utifrån teknisk kvalitet och långsiktig hållbarhet. Vi lägger stor vikt vid dina personliga egenskaper.
   

  

  

**Meriterande**
* Erfarenhet av drift av distribuerade Linux-system och klusterlösningar
* Erfarenhet av automation, konfigurationshantering och infrastrukturoptimering
* Arbetat med Linux-baserade backend-miljöer och skalbara driftsplattformar
* Kunskap om verktyg och ekosystem relevanta för effektiv Linux-drift (ex. konfigurationshantering, containerteknik, CI/CD-flöden, övervakning)
* Kompetens inom närliggande teknikområden som FOI bedömer relevanta
* Erfarenhet från försvars- eller säkerhetssektorn


**Vad erbjuder vi dig?**
 Totalförsvarets forskningsinstitut (FOI) är en statlig myndighet som bedriver världsledande forskning inom försvar och säkerhet till stöd för Sveriges militära och civila försvar. Vi erbjuder en unik arbetsplats där du får möjlighet att arbeta med det som är viktigt för totalförsvaret och hela samhället. Forskningen tillämpas både inom försvarsmyndigheter och hos civila aktörer och spelar en avgörande roll i att bygga en relevant och effektiv försvarsförmåga.
   

  

 Vi arbetar medvetet för en god arbetsmiljö med en bra balans mellan arbete och privatliv. Utöver detta erbjuder vi en rad förmåner. Läs mer om hur det är att jobba hos oss: https://www.foi.se/jobba-hos-oss.html
   

  

 Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning som kan komma att inledas med sex månaders provanställning.
   

  

  

**Vill du vara med och söka svaren för en säkrare värld?**
 Välkommen med din ansökan i form av CV via ansökningsknappen senast den 30:e september!
   

  

 För mer information om tjänsten är du välkommen att kontakta Lovisa Borch. Fackliga företrädare är David Sundell (Saco-S) och Jonas Svefors (OFR/S – ST) Samtliga nås på 08-555 030 00.
   

  

 Då anställningen är placerad i säkerhetsklass krävs svenskt medborgarskap. Säkerhetsprövning med registerkontroll kommer att genomföras före anställning enligt säkerhetsskyddslagen (2018:585). Inför säkerhetsprövning efterfrågas vidimerade kopior på de utbildningar och tjänstgöringsintyg som är relevanta för tjänsten.
   

  

 FOI är en myndighet varmed inlämnade ansökningshandlingar blir allmän handling som på begäran kan lämnas ut till utomstående enligt offentlighets- och sekretesslagen.
   

  

 Erbjudanden från rekryteringsföretag undanbedes.

title: Delivery Excellence Lead
description:
At Aceve, we back the builders of society. Founded in the Nordics and growing across Europe, we build digital tools for the people who construct and maintain our physical world - giving electricians, plumbers, and contractors back their time, clarity, and confidence. With over 900 employees across 8 countries, leading brands in 7 customer markets, and more than €100M in revenue, we're on an ambitious growth journey, and we're just getting started. We're an AI-first company, and we work with grit, openness, and a good dose of joy.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As Delivery Excellence Lead, you own and continuously improve Aceve’s end-to-end Professional Services process framework — our Core Process Architecture. You drive consistency and quality across Pre-Delivery, Delivery, and Governance, making sure every market works from the same playbook without losing the flexibility to move fast. You also act as global owner of our PSA platform, driving its adoption, governance, and continuous improvement across all markets, including leading continued global rollout. Beyond PS, you work closely and coordinate with Customer Success and Support to keep the broader customer journey consistent end to end. We measure your success by how consistently, predictably, and profitably Aceve delivers value to customers — everywhere we operate.
   

  

**What Will You Do**
 You will own the design and enforcement of our global PS process framework, and act as global owner of our PSA platform, working closely with country and market leaders, functional leads, and platform teams to keep standards consistent and continuously improving.
   

  

* Own the Core Process Architecture end to end — define, maintain, and enforce global standards


 across Professional Services.
   

  

* Act as global owner for our PSA platform — own adoption, workflow governance, and continuous


 improvement across all markets.
   

  

* Define the human-governed process framework within which AI tooling operates, ensuring our AI-


 empowered delivery model stays consistent, controlled, and scalable.
   

  

* Lead continued global rollout of the PSA platform, from planning through adoption.
* Ensure time registration, utilisation tracking, and project financials are consistently and accurately maintained across all markets.
* Liase closely across the CX functions — Professional Services, Customer Success, and Support — to drive consistency, improve efficiency, and elevate the end-to-end customer experience.
* Partner with country and market leaders and functional heads to translate global standards into local practice, and feed field learnings back into the framework.


**We believe you have**
* A background as a senior Professional Services or consulting professional, with experience in process


 framework design, delivery governance, and change management across multi-market organisations.
   

  

* Strong project management, stakeholder management, and coaching capability, comfortable running multi-market initiatives and aligning senior leaders across countries and functions.
* Understanding of how Professional Services, Customer Success, and Support work together in B2B SaaS, with a track record of driving collaboration across them.
* The judgement to define where and how AI tooling fits into a human-governed delivery model, without losing sight of quality and control.
* A structured, standards-driven mindset, paired with the agility and pragmatism to adapt global frameworks to local market realities and thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
* Familiarity with Salesforce and PSA platforms is an advantage.


**Bonus Points For**
* Hands-on experience owning or governing Certinia/Salesforce or a comparable PSA platform as a global or regional product owner.
* Experience leading multi-market platform rollouts (PSA, ERP, or CRM) across the Nordics or Benelux.


**Not ticking every box?** 
 No worries! We value potential and drive, so apply anyway or connect with us- you might be just what we're looking for in our growing organisation! Join Aceve and take your expertise to the next level, together we are redefining what’s possible in craft and construction solutions!
   

  

*Aceve is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Our selection process is conducted continuously and without discrimination, ensuring an equal opportunity for all candidates.*

title: Network & Engineering Manager - Europe
description:
**Job function** 





 Can be based anywhere in Europe
 




 As Network & Engineering Manager - Europe, you will report directly to the Global Chief Technology Officer (CTO) and lead cross-functional engagement across Operations, Finance, Customers and Suppliers.
 



  





 You will identify and champion opportunities for profitable growth, while ensuring programmes and projects are delivered on time, within budget and to the required quality standards, maximising the successful realisation of expected business benefits.
 



  





**Specific responsibilities** 




*The following outlines the primary areas of responsibility.* 




*Additional responsibilities or functions may be required as necessary to support the business.* 




  




* Serve as the key local point of contact for customers, agreed third-party suppliers and OEMs/vendors, ensuring strong commercial and operational relationships throughout the bid and delivery lifecycle.
* Working closely with in-country and central Solutions & Services sales teams and Global Network & Engineering (N&E) to provide commercial support, including cost-base development, supplier pricing and participation in key commercial meetings.
* Collaborate with Global Account Directors and the Global N&E leadership team to define and manage the regional portfolio pipeline, ensuring appropriate resource, financial, technical capability and supplier requirements are identified and planned.
* Support the development of business cases, workforce plans and regional budgets in line with the programme pipeline, Solutions & Services opportunities and managed service awards.
* Work closely with the Global N&E team to ensure all programmes and projects within the regional portfolio are delivered to agreed time, cost and quality standards, while maximising the realisation of agreed business benefits and maintaining ownership of the local programme P&L.
* Ensure regional programmes operate within established governance frameworks, processes and procedures, supporting effective change, escalation, risk and issue management through the organisation’s existing PMO tools and systems.
* Apply established programme and delivery frameworks consistently across existing and new customers, ensuring a standardised, scalable and commercially effective approach to portfolio delivery.
* Partner with the Global N&E function to onboard and manage internal and external suppliers responsible for programme and project delivery, including the production and review of supplier performance reports and associated improvement actions.
* Collaborate with Global N&E Portfolio Managers and Service Management teams to align regional reporting with established commercial performance metrics, forecasting processes and governance requirements.
* Work closely with Regional Finance and Programme/Portfolio stakeholders to ensure accurate financial reporting, forecasting, cost control and visibility of commercial performance.
* Partner closely with Global N&E Operations to balance delivery, commercial performance, risk and profitability, ensuring customer commitments are achieved while protecting regional margins and business value.



  





**About you** 



* Relevant degree or equivalent professional qualification in Business Administration, Finance, Economics, Engineering, Project/Programme Management or a related discipline.
* Extensive experience managing large, complex transformation portfolios and programmes across multiple sectors, ideally within a fast-paced, operationally complex environment.
* Proven experience working within a growth-focused business, with experience in the telecommunications sector highly desirable.
* Extensive financial management experience, including business planning, forecasting, financial reporting and P&L ownership.
* Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, with the ability to analyse complex data, identify key insights and translate findings into clear actions and business decisions.
* Professional qualification or practical experience in recognised project, programme or service management methodologies, such as MSP, PRINCE2, APM, PMI or ITIL Foundation.
* Strong commercial acumen, with the ability to review commercial agreements and contracts, identify risks and opportunities, and ensure appropriate commercial governance.
* Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to build effective working relationships and influence stakeholders at all levels across a geographically dispersed organisation.
* Highly organised and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple priorities, complex programmes and competing stakeholder requirements while maintaining a strong focus on delivery.
* Fluent English is essential. Fluency in German, French, and/or another European language is highly desirable, with additional European languages considered an advantage.
* Willingness and ability to work collaboratively across multiple European markets, including the Nordics, Germany, France and other European locations.



  





**Organisational Positioning & Cross-functional Collaboration** 




 The role operates within a global matrix organisation with reporting relationship to the Managing Director Europe (regional) and the Group CTO (functional). The role acts as an important connection point between the regional business and the functional organisation, ensuring effective collaboration and alignment between both dimensions. The incumbent is expected to effectively balance global functional objectives with regional business priorities and contribute to enterprise-wide success through collaboration, influence, and shared accountability.
 



  





 The position forms an integral part of the company's global matrix structure.
 



  






 Regional Accountability – Europe
 



* Support of regional growth and profitability targets in line with global 20x20 growth objective
* Collaborating with regional Finance and Accounting
* Supporting planning, budgeting and cross-functional initiatives
* Effective execution within local regulatory and compliance frameworks
* Responsiveness to customer and market requirements
* Alignment with regional business priorities



  






 Functional Accountability - Network & Engineering
 



* Support the Delivery of Business Unit objectives for region and the wider Global portfolio where required
* Alignment with global strategy and priorities
* Adherence to Global process, procedures, standards and governance
* Professional development and capability building
* The role holder is expected to proactively manage competing priorities, facilitate alignment among stakeholders, and contribute to overall enterprise success rather than optimising individual organisational dimensions.



  





**Rewards** 



* A competitive base salary and comprehensive company benefits package.
* A permanent, full-time position within a highly motivated and collaborative team, supported by flat organisational structures, an inclusive culture and regular team events.
* A varied and exciting opportunity within a modern, dynamic and innovation-driven industry, with a strong focus on sustainability, circular economy principles and environmentally responsible business models.
* Flexible hybrid working based in Solingen, Germany, or from another European location, depending on the successful candidate.
* A modern and flexible approach to work, including flexible working hours, e-bike leasing, job ticket, company laptop and mobile phone, alongside other employee benefits.



  





**About us** 




 At TXO, we are transforming technology for a more sustainable future. Our people enable organisations worldwide to optimise and transform technology across its entire lifecycle, helping customers unlock value while reducing environmental impact through circular economy solutions.
 



  





 Working at TXO means contributing to real-world change. Our global teams support critical infrastructure for customers in more than 140 countries, extending the life of technology, reducing waste and helping organisations operate more sustainably. From engineering and operations to sales, finance, supply chain and corporate functions, every role plays a part in delivering meaningful impact.
 



  





 We combine global reach with local expertise, creating opportunities to work on complex challenges across technology, commercial, operational and business disciplines. Our culture is built on collaboration, innovation and technical excellence, empowering our people to deliver practical solutions that make a measurable difference.
 



  





 As we continue to grow globally, backed by TowerBrook Capital Partners’ impact strategy, we are committed to building an inclusive environment where our people can develop, thrive and help shape the future of sustainable technology.

title: Account Executive
description:
Grow with us
   

  

 Upsales was founded in 2003, grew without a single outside investor, and has been profitable ever since. No VC pressure. No compromises. Just a product customers keep paying for.
   

  

 We build the leading CRM and AI platform for B2B sales, and we're now in our highest growth phase in years, one of the very few SaaS companies growing profitably while staying genuinely ahead on AI.
   

  

 If you want real autonomy, colleagues who push you, and work that moves the needle from day one, you'll fit right in.
   

  

 Account Executive
   

  

 We’re looking for a world-class Account Executive to join our high-performance sales team, the spearhead of our growth engine. This is a chance to be part of one of the most effective AI software sales teams in the Nordics, a team built around high ownership, high ambition, and a shared belief that we’re building something truly category-defining.
   

  

 This isn’t a customer success role. And it’s not just about closing deals. This is
 **strategic, consultative selling at the highest level,** 
 working closely with C-level stakeholders as a trusted advisor, a growth partner, and a commercial leader.
   

  

 You’ll be supported by a high-performing team of solution engineers and go-to-market colleagues, but you own the outcome. Success in this role requires more than hitting quota, it requires curiosity, strategic thinking, and the ability to connect the dots between a company’s problems and the potential of Upsales AI.
   

  

 This is a role for someone who wants to sell at the highest level, who thrives in fast-paced, high-performance teams, and who’s motivated by the chance to help reshape how companies grow.
   

  

**AI first mindset**
 We’re not looking for someone who simply uses AI. We want someone who weaponizes it. You treat tools like Claude, ChatGPT, and other AI copilots as force multipliers, allowing you to deliver at a level and speed others can’t match. For you, AI isn’t an add-on, it’s the default operating system for how you think, work, and lead. You’re relentlessly curious about new capabilities, and you push the limits of what’s possible, turning AI into a competitive advantage for yourself, Upsales, and our customers. This is a role for someone with real ambition: someone who wants to set a new standard for efficiency, precision, and impact in the age of AI.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Drive end-to-end new business. From prospecting to negotiation and close.
* Create and execute strategic outbound campaigns toward key verticals and segments.
* Engage with CEOs, CROs, and other revenue leaders to identify growth opportunities.
* Position Upsales AI as a must-have platform for data-driven sales and marketing teams.
* Collaborate with product, marketing, and solution engineers to craft winning proposals.
* Build a strong, predictable pipeline, and consistently exceed your targets.


**Who We're Looking For**
 This isn’t an entry-level role, we’re looking for someone who has already
 **proven they can win at the highest level** 
 .
   

  

* At least 5 years of proven experience in complex SaaS B2B sales
* A degree from a respected academic institution, preferably in the technical or economic field
* A strong track record of meeting and exceeding targets
* Experience building long-term relationships with fast-growing mid-sized companies
* A proactive, ambitious mindset with full ownership of the sales process
* Excellent communication skills in both English and Swedish
* Driven by growth, responsibility, and the ambition to build something meaningful


 Personality-wise? You’re
 **obsessed with winning** 
 , but never at the expense of the team. You take pride in delivering results, but you’re also the kind of person who jumps in to help a teammate close a deal or solve a tough problem. You raise the bar, and bring others with you.
   

  

 Read our Culture Playbook
   

  

 Upsales was founded in 2003, grew without a single outside investor, and has been profitable ever since. No VC pressure. No compromises. Just a product customers keep paying for.
   

  

 We're now in our highest growth phase in years, one of the very few SaaS companies growing profitably while staying genuinely ahead on AI.
   

  

 If you want real autonomy, colleagues who push you, and work that moves the needle from day one, you'll fit right in.

title: Senior Search & Discoverability Lead
description:
Mentimeter is an engagement tool with a clear goal in mind. To turn presentations into conversations. Through real-time interactivity and clear visualizations, we get people to participate, engage and become more productive. Transforming all those passive meetings, airless classrooms and drawn out trainings into valuable and memorable moments.
   

  

 We truly believe that you achieve the best results by doing things together. And that successful leaders need to adopt a curious and collaborative mindset in order to get there. So with you at Mentimeter, you'll be a big part of the ambition to help over 1 billion people listen, learn and work better together.
   

  

**Help build the future of discoverability**
 Search is changing faster than ever.
   

  

 People no longer discover products only through Google. They ask ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude and Perplexity. They watch YouTube, browse Reddit, visit review sites and learn through communities.
   

  

 At Mentimeter, we believe the companies that win will combine world-class SEO fundamentals with AI-native systems, automation and modern workflows to become discoverable wherever customers search, ask, learn and buy.
   

  

 That's why we're looking for a
 **Senior Search & Discoverability Lead** 
 .
   

  

 This is not a traditional SEO role.
   

  

 It's an opportunity to build Mentimeter's discoverability capability for the AI era.
   

  

**Your mission**
**Make Mentimeter the obvious answer wherever people search, ask and learn.**
 You'll own discoverability across traditional search, AI search and emerging discovery channels.
   

  

 Success won't be measured by rankings or traffic.
   

  

 It will be measured by qualified acquisition, activation and business impact.
   

  

**What you'll do**
**Build world-class SEO foundations**
 Build and continuously improve Mentimeter's technical SEO, content strategy, search intent, information architecture, international SEO, structured data, Core Web Vitals and user experience.
   

  

**Own search & discoverability**
 Own Mentimeter's discoverability strategy across:
   

  

* Organic Search
* Paid Search
* AI Search & LLM visibility
* Google AI Overviews
* YouTube
* Reddit
* Review sites
* Communities
* Emerging discovery channels


 Treat search as one integrated ecosystem rather than separate channels.
   

  

**Build the Discoverability Operating System**
 This is a builder role.
   

  

* Design and build the AI-native operating system that powers discoverability at Mentimeter.


 Create scalable systems that continuously:
   

  

* Research competitors
* Discover customer questions
* Identify opportunities
* Generate content briefs
* Enable content production
* Optimize existing content
* Publish improvements
* Measure performance
* Learn from results
* Recommend the next best actions


 The goal is a living system that continuously improves through AI, automation and human expertise.
   

  

**Build AI-native workflows**
* Design agentic workflows by connecting AI models, APIs, MCPs, analytics platforms, CMS workflows and internal data.


**Measure, experiment and evolve**
* Define success metrics.
* Build dashboards.
* Run experiments.
* Measure business impact.
* Continuously evolve how Mentimeter approaches discoverability.


**Enable the organization**
 Build systems, workflows and guidance that enable Product Marketing, Brand, Customer Marketing, Customer Success, Enterprise Marketing and Product teams to create better, more discoverable content.
   

  

**Who you are**
 You're deeply experienced in SEO fundamentals but excited about where search is heading.
   

  

 You understand that AI doesn't replace SEO. It amplifies it.
   

  

 You're a builder who enjoys creating systems, not just executing tasks.
   

  

 You think from first principles, move comfortably between strategy and execution, and naturally experiment with new AI tools and workflows.
   

  

**Qualifications**
**What you'll need**
* 8+ years of SEO experience, preferably in-house.
* Deep expertise in technical SEO, content strategy and search intent.
* Experience growing large, international websites.
* Experience with localization at scale.
* Working knowledge of Google Ads and paid search.
* Experience with AI search and LLM visibility.
* Hands-on experience building AI workflows, automations or agentic systems.
* Super user of modern AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT and Gemini.
* Strong understanding of APIs and MCPs.
* Strong commercial mindset with experience using experimentation and analytics to drive business outcomes.
* Exceptional writing and communication skills.
* Experience collaborating closely with engineering teams.


**Nice to have**
* Experience from a product-led SaaS company.
* Experience managing SEO or SEM agencies.
* Active contributor to the SEO or AI community through writing, speaking or community engagement.
* Familiarity with Python, JavaScript or SQL.


**Success in this role**
 After your first year:
   

  

* Organic registrations have grown significantly.
* Organic contributes substantially more ARR.
* AI search has become a meaningful acquisition channel.
* Mentimeter's visibility across ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude and Perplexity has increased significantly.
* Share of Voice has increased across our highest-value topics, entities and use cases.
* Mentimeter consistently appears for the most important searches across both Google and AI search.
* Technical SEO, Core Web Vitals and site performance have improved significantly.
* Content production has become dramatically faster through AI-native workflows.
* Time from idea to published, localized content has been significantly reduced.
* Paid and organic search operate as one integrated discoverability system.
* Discoverability has become a strategic growth capability that drives measurable business impact.


 📍
 **Location:** 
 This is a hybrid role at Mentimeter HQ in
 **Stockholm** 
 . Our guideline is at least
 **3** 
**days** 
**a** 
**week** 
 at the office.
   

  

* Please note that we do not offer relocation sponsorship for the position.


**💡Our recruitment process:**
* Screening interview
* Hiring Manager Interview
* Business Case + Competence Interview
* Culture interview (incl. conducting a personality & logical ability test)
* References & Offer


**Not sure you tick every box?** 
 Apply anyway—great matches often come in surprising shapes.
   

  

 At Mentimeter where we currently boast over 50+ different nationalities, you'll be part of a culture that values creativity, innovation, and inclusivity. We believe in supporting our team members' growth and offering them the platform to excel. If you're eager to contribute to our mission and make a significant impact, we'd love to hear from you.
   

  

**Compensation:**
 At Mentimeter, we believe in fair and transparent compensation that grows with you.
   

  

 The full salary range for this role is SEK 60,000–SEK 86,000 per month. It's intentionally broad to reflect the different stages of growth within the role: from early development to deep expertise and meaningful impact. Where an individual is placed within the range depends on factors such as relevant experience, demonstrated skills, and alignment with the role's requirements.
   

  

 We're committed to supporting your growth. You'll have ongoing development conversations with your manager, and your salary will evolve as you build skills and contribute to our mission.
   

  

 In addition to your monthly salary, we offer a comprehensive benefits package—learn more about it here: https://www.mentimeter.com/benefits/stockholm.
   

  

**What Mentimeter Can Offer**
 At Mentimeter we can offer a diverse and inclusive work environment supported by smart and driven colleagues. We believe in continuous professional development for all of our colleagues and therefore offer access to a leadership program (including external personal coach) and relevant education to ensure that we continue to be state-of-the-art when it comes to innovating and building Mentimeter. Your place will be in a growing company with lots of career opportunities, working on a beloved product used by more than 300 million people. It's not all about work though, we also offer a very healthy view on work-life balance.
   

  

 All of this comes attached with a competitive compensation and benefits package, including pension contributions. Learn more about our benefits by visiting our Benefits & Perks page
   

  

**AI and Hiring at Mentimeter**
 At Mentimeter, we believe AI helps us work smarter - but it never replaces the human assessment, curiosity, and personal connection that define our culture and our hiring. We use AI as a sparring partner: to bounce ideas, bring new perspectives, support structure, and make our work more efficient. But the meaning, decisions, and interactions always come from people.
   

  

* AI does not screen or decide on candidates.
* There is no automated filtering, ranking, or decision-making in our recruitment process. Every application is reviewed by a person.
* Hiring teams may use AI to support their work - for example, to structure notes, prepare interview questions, or organize their thinking.


 AI strengthens our work, but it does not define it. At Mentimeter, we're not building an AI-driven hiring process - we're building a people-first culture, where technology helps us listen, learn, and grow together.
   

  

**Culture at Mentimeter**
 At Mentimeter we believe in giving everyone a voice - regardless of who you are. So we build a platform that does just that. Our platform is not only our product but also our organization. A platform where people feel safe, where differences are embraced, a place where you can have fun. We strongly encourage applicants who are people of color, LGBTQ+, women, people with disabilities, and/or formerly incarcerated people, and a college degree is not strictly required. In order to give everyone a voice, we need to be as diverse as our users.
   

  

 Learn more about our culture by visiting our Culture page.
   

  

 Review our Privacy Policy for more information.

title: Delivery Lead – GenAI Business Solutions
description:
**Last date to apply:**
 03 October 2026
   

  

 Generative AI is creating entirely new possibilities for how we work — and we are still only at the beginning.
   

  

 At Husqvarna Group, we are looking for a Delivery Lead – GenAI Business Solutions who wants to help turn those possibilities into real impact. You will be at the center of how we explore, prioritize and scale GenAI across a global organization — connecting emerging technology with business needs, people and measurable value.
   

  

 A key part of this journey will be working with our software development community to unlock the potential of AI-powered development tools and new ways of working.
   

  

**About The Team**
 You will join Enterprise AI & Automation, part of GIS – Digital Business Transformation, where we work to enable and scale the use of AI and automation across Husqvarna Group.
   

  

 Our work spans both internally developed AI solutions and third-party Generative AI technologies. Our GenAI ecosystem includes solutions such as Microsoft Copilot, GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT Enterprise, Claude Enterprise, Claude Code and Synthesia.
   

  

 As the use of Generative AI grows across Husqvarna Group, our focus is on ensuring that these technologies are adopted responsibly, managed effectively and create real business value across the organization.
   

  

 You will work closely with the other GenAI Delivery Lead, as well as stakeholders across business, technology, security and transformation.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As Delivery Lead – GenAI Business Solutions, you will take the business-facing lead for Husqvarna Group’s portfolio of third-party Generative AI tools.
   

  

 You will engage with teams and leaders across Husqvarna Group to understand their needs and identify where GenAI can improve productivity, collaboration, content creation and software development. Software development will be an important part of your scope, and you will work closely with developer teams to understand their needs and help enable the effective use of GenAI tools such as GitHub Copilot and Claude Code.
   

  

 A central part of the role is adoption and enablement. Together with Learning & Development and other stakeholders, you will drive workshops, training, communication and other initiatives that help employees understand and make effective use of GenAI.
   

  

 You will also own strategic relationships with GenAI technology partners such as Microsoft, OpenAI, Anthropic and Synthesia. Together with Procurement and Finance, you will work with licensing, commercial discussions, renewals and optimization to ensure our technology investments deliver the expected value.
   

  

 As the GenAI landscape continues to evolve, you will evaluate new capabilities and market offerings and help determine which opportunities are relevant for Husqvarna Group. Together with the Delivery Lead – GenAI Platforms & Governance, you will align business demand with licensing strategy, service design, governance and the future platform roadmap.
   

  

**About You**
 You are a curious and business-oriented leader who understands how technology can create value for people and organizations.
   

  

 You combine a solid understanding of the GenAI landscape with strong stakeholder and relationship-building skills. You are comfortable discussing technology and use cases without needing to be an AI engineer yourself.
   

  

 You are comfortable working with software development organizations and understand the language, needs and ways of working of developer teams. You don't need to be a hands-on developer today.
   

  

 You know how to create engagement around new technology, influence without formal authority and turn ideas into practical action. You are equally comfortable engaging senior leaders, facilitating workshops and working with vendors.
   

  

 Your Skills And Background
   

  

* 8+ years of professional experience within IT, digital transformation, technology delivery or related environments.
* Strong understanding of the Generative AI ecosystem and hands-on familiarity with tools such as Microsoft Copilot, GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude or similar solutions.
* Experience from software development environments or working closely with developer teams, with the ability to understand their requirements, language and ways of working.
* Experience driving technology adoption, digital transformation, software rollouts or technology-enabled change.
* Strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to engage both business and technical stakeholders across functions and levels.
* Experience identifying business needs and translating them into technology opportunities, priorities and initiatives.
* Experience driving adoption and enablement through workshops, training and communication.
* Experience working with technology vendors and external partners, ideally including licensing, commercial discussions, procurement or contract-related activities.
* Ability to evaluate technology investments from a business value and value-realization perspective.
* Strong communication and facilitation skills, with the ability to make complex technology understandable and relevant to different audiences.
* Fluency in English, both written and spoken.


 Experience working directly with enterprise GenAI tools or large-scale AI adoption is highly valued, but experience leading the adoption of other emerging technologies combined with strong GenAI knowledge is also relevant.
   

  

 Location
   

  

 This position will be based at one of our sites in Sweden: Huskvarna, Stockholm, or Jonsered.
   

  

 How We Work
   

  

 We believe the best ideas happen when we're connected. We spend most of our time together in the office, creating space for collaboration, creativity, and fast decision-making. This is consistent across all our global offices and helps us maintain a strong culture, support learning and development, and ensure everyone has access to the people and resources they need to thrive.
   

  

 Your application
   

  

 We look forward to receiving your application! Selection is ongoing, and the position may be filled before the final application date 20 September.
   

  

 For questions specifically related to the recruitment process, please contact Recruitment Partner Victoria Kjellgren at victoria.kjellgren@husqvarnagroup.com.
   

  

 Note: We do not accept applications via email due to GDPR compliance.
