title: Forskare inom tillämpad AI för tillverkningsindustrin
description:
**Vill du omsätta AI och maskininlärning till konkreta lösningar för tillverkningsindustrin? Trivs du i gränslandet mellan data, material, processer och industriella behov? Då kan detta vara rollen för dig!**
**Om oss**
 RISE Research Institutes of Sweden är Sveriges forskningsinstitut och innovationspartner. Vi erbjuder tillämpad forskning, kvalificerade industriuppdrag, provning och kompetensutveckling för att stärka industrins konkurrenskraft och omställningsförmåga.
   

  

 Enheten Komponentgjutning och Additiv tillverkning består av grupperna Komponentgjutning och Additiv tillverkning och samlar kompetens inom metalliska material, gjutprocesser, additiv tillverkning, materialkarakterisering, simulering och datadriven processutveckling. Verksamheten bedrivs i nära samverkan med industri och akademi.
   

  

**Om rollen**
 Som forskare kommer du att arbeta med tillämpad AI för tillverkningsindustrin. Rollen handlar framför allt om att använda, anpassa och implementera AI-baserade metoder för att skapa industriell nytta. Fokus ligger på att kombinera data, processförståelse och domänkunskap för att stödja industrin inom kvalitet, produktivitet, resurseffektivitet, processoptimering och beslutsstöd.
   

  

 Du deltar i forskningsprojekt och industriella uppdrag i nära samverkan med företag, akademi och andra delar av RISE. Arbetet kan exempelvis omfatta tillämpningar inom gjutning, additiv tillverkning, materialanalys, bildanalys, processdata, kvalitetsuppföljning och industriella beslutsstöd.
   

  

**I rollen kommer du bland annat att:**
* tillämpa AI- och maskininlärningsmetoder på industriella tillverkningsproblem.
* analysera processdata, bilddata, materialdata och kvalitetsdata.
* utveckla och utvärdera AI-baserade beslutsstöd tillsammans med industripartner.
* kombinera AI-verktyg med processförståelse, simulering och materialkunskap.
* delta i forskningsprojekt, industriuppdrag och ansökningar till forskningsfinansiärer.
* bidra till kunddialoger och vidareutveckla RISE:s erbjudande inom tillämpad AI för tillverkningsindustrin


**Vem är du?**
 Vi söker dig som är disputerad inom ett relevant område, exempelvis maskinteknik, materialvetenskap, produktionsteknik, datavetenskap, teknisk fysik, beräkningsvetenskap eller motsvarande. Du har erfarenhet av AI, maskininlärning, dataanalys eller datadrivna metoder och vill använda dessa i praktiska industriella tillämpningar.
   

  

**För att lyckas i rollen har du:**
* god förståelse för hur AI och datadrivna metoder kan användas i tillverkningsindustrin.
* förmåga att omsätta befintliga AI-metoder till robusta, begripliga och värdeskapande lösningar i industriella miljöer.
* ett analytiskt arbetssätt och god problemlösningsförmåga.
* förmåga att arbeta självständigt, ta ansvar och driva arbetet framåt i samverkan med andra.
* god kommunikativ förmåga på svenska och engelska, både muntligt och skriftligt.


**Det är meriterande om du har:**
* erfarenhet från tillverkningsindustri, produktionsteknik eller maskinteknik.
* kunskap om gjutning, additiv tillverkning eller andra tillverkningsprocesser.
* erfarenhet av industriell dataanalys, bildanalys, processövervakning eller kvalitetsuppföljning.
* erfarenhet av programmering och dataanalys i exempelvis Python.
* arbetat med maskininlärningsbibliotek som scikit-learn, TensorFlow eller PyTorch.
* erfarenhet av simulering, processmodellering eller kombinationer av fysikbaserade och datadrivna metoder.


 Som person är du nyfiken, lösningsorienterad och samarbetsinriktad. Du trivs i gränsytan mellan data, teknik och industriella behov och har förmåga att skapa förtroende i dialog med industripartner.
   

  

**Är vi rätt för varandra?**
 Hos RISE får du möjlighet att arbeta nära svensk tillverkningsindustri och bidra till att omsätta AI från koncept till praktisk industriell nytta. Du kombinerar forskning, teknik och industrisamverkan tillsammans med engagerade kollegor med kompletterande kompetenser.
   

  

 Vi lovar dig inget enkelt jobb – men vi lovar dig ett meningsfullt sådant, med stor möjlighet att påverka hur AI används i framtidens tillverkningsprocesser.
   

  

**Välkommen med din ansökan!**
 Vill du veta mer om tjänsten är du välkommen att kontakta: Alexander Leicht, enhetschef, 010-228 49 09. Tjänsten är placerad i Jönköping, Lund, Mölndal eller Stockholm. Startdatum är enligt överenskommelse.
   

  

 Sista ansökningsdag 2026-09-30. Urval och intervjuer kommer att ske löpande under ansökningstiden.
   

  

 Våra fackliga representanter är Ingemar Petermann, Saco, 010-22 841 22, respektive Linda Ikatti, Unionen, +46 10 516 51 61.

title: Systemförvaltare/Specialist lönesystem Securitas Sverige AB
description:
Securitas har en viktig roll i samhället och förvaltar ett av Sveriges viktigaste uppdrag - att skydda och hjälpa människor att känna sig trygga. Nu har du chansen att bli en del av Sveriges största säkerhetsföretag.
   

  

 Som landets största arbetsgivare i vår bransch kan vi erbjuda dig utvecklingsmöjligheter och variation som få andra företag kan. Vi strävar efter ett enhetligt ledarskap med balans mellan förväntningar och förutsättningar.
   

  

*Securitas Sverige krigsplacerar sin personal. Detta innebär i korthet att du som anställd kommer, i händelse av krig, ha kvar din anställning och arbetsledas av Securitas.*
 Du tar hand om människors säkerhet – Securitas tar hand om dig.
   

  

**Jobbeskrivning**
 Har du ett intresse för HR-processer och system? Då kan den här tjänsten vara rätt för dig! Vi söker nu efter en systemförvaltare till ett
 **vikariat** 
 på cirka ett och ett halvt år.
   

  

 Som Systemförvaltare kommer du att ingå i en grupp om 17 kollegor som utgör Securitas HR Operations & Payroll. HR Operations & Payroll i sin tur tillhör HR-avdelningen centralt belägen på Lindhagensplan på Kungsholmen. Som en del av gruppen kommer du arbeta tillsammans med kollegor i roller som lönespecialist, HR-support, samt systemförvaltare – och självklart ha tillgång till kontorets gym i källaren.
   

  

 Som systemförvaltare kommer du att ha en central roll i utvecklingen, förvaltningen och optimeringen av våra system för lön, personaladministration, rekrytering och utbildning och tillsammans med tre andra kollegor kommer du att driva tekniska förbättringar för att våra system ska fungera effektivt för verksamheten. Vi försöker hela tiden att hitta automatisering i de system vi använder och vill gärna gå använda AI där det är möjligt.
   

  

 Exempel på arbetsuppgifter inom det här området kan vara:
   

  

* Deltaga i framtagande av årlig förvaltningsplan för lönesystemet.
* Systemutveckling kopplat till automatisering i våra system.
* Deltaga i kundmöten med systemleverantör
* Utbildning i lönesystem för användare (vid behov) & kollegorna inom avdelningen
* Planera och genomföra testa nya releaser från systemleverantör
* Informera och koordinera med systemförvaltning för kringliggande system och övriga kollegor inom avdelningen.
* Koordinera integrationer till andra system och bistå i utveckling, felsökning av dessa
* Utföra dataanalys och skapa rapporter för både interna och externa behov, med ett fokus på att utnyttja systemens fulla potential.


 Du kommer även delta i- och projektleda företagsövergripande systemprojekt som påverkar våra HR-system.
   

  

 I rollen som Systemförvaltare kommer du även vara delaktig i löneprocessen vid lönekörning och ansvara för att alla delar av i lönesystemet är uppsatta i enlighet med Securitas kollektivavtal, policy och andra regelverk.
   

  

 Tjänsten passar dig som drivs av att få saker och ting gjorda och som trivs i en roll med nära samarbete med olika delar av verksamheten. Hos oss arbetar vi med att få människor att känna sig trygga varje dag och varje natt – i denna roll erbjuds du möjligheten att skapa denna trygghet såväl internt som externt. I tjänsten finns även utrymme för dig som är intresserad av AI att försätta utvecklas inom AI-området.
   

  

 Vi är trygghet. Vi är Securitas.
   

  

**Kvalifikationer**
 Vi söker dig som har dokumenterad erfarenhet av systemförvaltning och arbetat med löne- och HR processer. Vi ser också att du har utbildning inom lön och/eller IT eller systemförvaltning.
   

  

 Det är starkt meriterande om du har arbetat i
 **systemet HRplus (Visma)** 
 . Det är också meriterande om du har tidigare erfarenhet av projektledning, agila verktyg som JIRA service management samt har goda Excel kunskaper. Har du tidigare erfarenhet av ärendehanteringssystemet Servicenow är det också meriterande. Har du tidigare erfarenhet av automatiseringsprojekt och/eller intresse för AI-adoption är det ett stort plus.
   

  

 Vi söker dig som har en vilja att utveckla och förnya system och processer och delar gärna med dig av dina kunskaper och tidigare erfarenheter till andra. Du är bra på att planera, strukturera och prioritera. Du är van att ta ansvar och att få med andra kollegor i den gemensamma arbetsuppgiften, likväl som du också kan arbeta självständigt. Du har ett professionellt förhållningssätt och har erfarenhet av att ge support i systemrelaterade frågor till medarbetare och chefer.
   

  

**Ytterligare information**
 Vi tar endast emot ansökningar via vårt rekryteringsverktyg. Vi jobbar med löpande urval, så om du är intresserad av tjänsten – skicka din ansökan redan idag!
   

  

 Har du frågor kring rollen är du välkommen att höra av dig till kontaktperson: ann-kristine.palmqvist@securitas.se
   

  

* Tjänsten är på heltid med tillträde enligt överenskommelse. Tjänsten är ett vikariat på cirka ett och ett halvt år
* Vi arbetar med urvalstester
* Vi kommunicerar i första hand via mejl
* Sista ansökningsdag är 28/9 2026


 För anställning inom Securitas Sverige AB krävs det att du har godkända betyg från första året i gymnasiet i svenska samt blir godkänd av Länsstyrelsen för anställning i auktoriserat bevakningsföretag enligt Lag (1974:191) om bevakningsföretag (den ansökan görs av Securitas). Beroende på befattning kan även säkerhetsprövning enligt Säkerhetsskyddslag (2018:585) bli aktuell. För att utreda och bedöma om du uppfyller kraven för att bli godkänd enligt respektive författning sker en bakgrundskontroll. Bedömningen avser laglydnad, lämplighet, pålitlighet, lojalitet samt eventuella sårbarheter. Uppgifter som inhämtas kan ex. komma från dig själv, öppna källor eller myndigheter. Vi tillämpar en helhetsbedömning vid prövning av lämplighet för respektive befattning.
   

  

 Lön och anställningsförhållanden baseras på kollektivavtal mellan arbetsgivarorganisationen Säkerhetsföretagen och Unionen samt Ledarna.

title: Delivery Lead – GenAI Business Solutions
description:
**Last date to apply:**


03 October 2026
Generative AI is creating entirely new possibilities for how we work — and we are still only at the beginning.


At Husqvarna Group, we are looking for a Delivery Lead – GenAI Business Solutions who wants to help turn those possibilities into real impact. You will be at the center of how we explore, prioritize and scale GenAI across a global organization — connecting emerging technology with business needs, people and measurable value.


A key part of this journey will be working with our software development community to unlock the potential of AI-powered development tools and new ways of working.

**About The Team**
------------------


You will join Enterprise AI & Automation, part of GIS – Digital Business Transformation, where we work to enable and scale the use of AI and automation across Husqvarna Group.


Our work spans both internally developed AI solutions and third-party Generative AI technologies. Our GenAI ecosystem includes solutions such as Microsoft Copilot, GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT Enterprise, Claude Enterprise, Claude Code and Synthesia.


As the use of Generative AI grows across Husqvarna Group, our focus is on ensuring that these technologies are adopted responsibly, managed effectively and create real business value across the organization.


You will work closely with the other GenAI Delivery Lead, as well as stakeholders across business, technology, security and transformation.

**About The Role**
------------------


As Delivery Lead – GenAI Business Solutions, you will take the business-facing lead for Husqvarna Group’s portfolio of third-party Generative AI tools.


You will engage with teams and leaders across Husqvarna Group to understand their needs and identify where GenAI can improve productivity, collaboration, content creation and software development. Software development will be an important part of your scope, and you will work closely with developer teams to understand their needs and help enable the effective use of GenAI tools such as GitHub Copilot and Claude Code.


A central part of the role is adoption and enablement. Together with Learning & Development and other stakeholders, you will drive workshops, training, communication and other initiatives that help employees understand and make effective use of GenAI.


You will also own strategic relationships with GenAI technology partners such as Microsoft, OpenAI, Anthropic and Synthesia. Together with Procurement and Finance, you will work with licensing, commercial discussions, renewals and optimization to ensure our technology investments deliver the expected value.


As the GenAI landscape continues to evolve, you will evaluate new capabilities and market offerings and help determine which opportunities are relevant for Husqvarna Group. Together with the Delivery Lead – GenAI Platforms & Governance, you will align business demand with licensing strategy, service design, governance and the future platform roadmap.

**About You**
-------------


You are a curious and business-oriented leader who understands how technology can create value for people and organizations.


You combine a solid understanding of the GenAI landscape with strong stakeholder and relationship-building skills. You are comfortable discussing technology and use cases without needing to be an AI engineer yourself.


You are comfortable working with software development organizations and understand the language, needs and ways of working of developer teams. You don't need to be a hands-on developer today.


You know how to create engagement around new technology, influence without formal authority and turn ideas into practical action. You are equally comfortable engaging senior leaders, facilitating workshops and working with vendors.

**Your Skills And Background**
------------------------------

* 8+ years of professional experience within IT, digital transformation, technology delivery or related environments.
* Strong understanding of the Generative AI ecosystem and hands-on familiarity with tools such as Microsoft Copilot, GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude or similar solutions.
* Experience from software development environments or working closely with developer teams, with the ability to understand their requirements, language and ways of working.
* Experience driving technology adoption, digital transformation, software rollouts or technology-enabled change.
* Strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to engage both business and technical stakeholders across functions and levels.
* Experience identifying business needs and translating them into technology opportunities, priorities and initiatives.
* Experience driving adoption and enablement through workshops, training and communication.
* Experience working with technology vendors and external partners, ideally including licensing, commercial discussions, procurement or contract-related activities.
* Ability to evaluate technology investments from a business value and value-realization perspective.
* Strong communication and facilitation skills, with the ability to make complex technology understandable and relevant to different audiences.
* Fluency in English, both written and spoken.


Experience working directly with enterprise GenAI tools or large-scale AI adoption is highly valued, but experience leading the adoption of other emerging technologies combined with strong GenAI knowledge is also relevant.

**Location**
------------


This position will be based at one of our sites in Sweden: Huskvarna, Stockholm, or Jonsered.

**How We Work**
---------------


We believe the best ideas happen when we're connected. We spend most of our time together in the office, creating space for collaboration, creativity, and fast decision-making. This is consistent across all our global offices and helps us maintain a strong culture, support learning and development, and ensure everyone has access to the people and resources they need to thrive.

**Your application**
--------------------


We look forward to receiving your application! Selection is ongoing, and the position may be filled before the final application date 20 September.


For questions specifically related to the recruitment process, please contact Recruitment Partner Victoria Kjellgren at victoria.kjellgren@husqvarnagroup.com.


Note: We do not accept applications via email due to GDPR compliance.

title: Research Engineer with expertise in image processing, visualization and GUI development
description:
Lund University was founded in 1666 and is repeatedly ranked among the world’s top universities. The University has around 46 000 students and 8 500 staff based in Lund, Helsingborg and Malmö. We are united in our efforts to understand, explain and improve our world and the human condition.

**Description of the Workplace**
--------------------------------


InfraVis is Sweden’s national infrastructure for visualization of scientific data. Currently, InfraVis employs over 50 experts across nine universities. CIPA is Lund University’s local infrastructure for image processing and analysis. CIPA is also the coordinating unit for Lund University's InfraVis node, consisting of around 10 people with complementary expertise.


InfraVis and CIPA provide all employees with professional development opportunities and strive to meet each individual’s development and well-being goals as much as possible. As a research engineer with expertise in the field of image processing, visualization and development of user-friendly Graphical User Interfaces (GUI:s) within InfraVis/CIPA, you will have access to both local and national colleagues for stimulating exchanges, discussions, and joint efforts to solve complex challenges, develop new methods, and support research in a wide range of scientific domains nationwide through visualization expertise.

**We offer**
------------


Lund University is a government agency, which means you receive special benefits, generous vacation, and a favourable occupational pension. We also have a flexible working hours agreement that provides good conditions for work-life balance. Read more on the university’s website about being an employee at Lunds University, Work for us | Lund University.

**Work duties and areas of responsibility**
-------------------------------------------


The primary task is to contribute as an expert in various research projects supported by CIPA/InfraVis. Regular and active participation in joint activities, including meetings, is required to promote knowledge transfer and infrastructure development. The position includes opportunities for career and skill development.


The work will focus on image processing and visualization of images or volumes, and may involve the following areas:

* Image processing and image analysis of tomographic data, e.g., synchrotron X-ray microtomography or lab-based X-ray microtomography.
* Development of scientific visualizations.
* Development of user-friendly Graphical User Interfaces (GUI:s) capable of performing image processing, image analysis and visualization.

**Qualifications**
------------------


We seek an experienced and driven individual who collaborates well and thrives in a complex research environment.

### **Requirements for the position include:**

* Ph.D. or equivalent experience in a relevant subject.
* Excellent oral and written English skills.
* Experience in image processing and image analysis of images or volumes, e.g., in ImageJ, or Python.
* Experience in visualization software, e.g., Blender, DragonFly.
* Knowledgeable in programming, e.g., Python.
* Experience in developing user-friendly Graphical User Interfaces (GUI:s)
* High motivation, ability to quickly learn new techniques, and strong time management skills.
* Strong collaboration and communication skills.

### **Meritorious for the position:**

* Proven ability to collaborate with researchers from different disciplines.


Consideration will also be given to how the applicant's experience and expertise complement and strengthen the ongoing activities within the infrastructure and how they can contribute to its future development.

**Further information**
-----------------------


The position is a fixed-temporary position for 3 months at 100%. Desired start date is 2026-10-01 or as agreed.

**How to Apply**
----------------


Apply through the university’s recruitment system. The application should include a cover letter explaining your motivation and how the position aligns with your qualifications, a CV. Degree certificates or equivalent. Contact details for at least two references. Any other supporting documents (e.g., reference letters).

**More information about the Faculty of Medicine**
--------------------------------------------------


The Faculty of Medicine is a part of Lund University, and is responsible for education and research within medicine and healthcare. Our academic programs are closely linked with the healthcare system and are firmly anchored in the faculty’s strong research tradition. Our research spans a broad field within experimental preclinical research, near-patient clinical research and health sciences research. The Faculty of Medicine, with its 1,800 employees and 2,700 students in Lund and Malmö, is a knowledge-intensive meeting place for students, teachers and researchers from all over the world.

title: Short-Term Mine Planning Engineer
description:
Do you enjoy combining fieldwork with planning? Join our Mine Planning team and help turn operational insights into safe, efficient and achievable mining plans.


Ort: Kiruna
Anställningsform: Tillsvidareanställning
Ansök senast: 2026-10-01  


**The sustainable transformation starts with us**
-------------------------------------------------


We are facing our greatest challenge yet – ensuring that Sweden and Europe have what it takes to transition to a sustainable future. So that we can live the lives we want, now and in the future. Just as we strive to improve the future, we are committed to developing everyone who joins us on this journey, both personally and professionally. Do you want to help lay the foundation for the world we live in?



**Your role**
-------------


As a Mine planner with focus on field work and short term planning, you will act as a link between mine planning and daily operations. A significant part of your time will be spent underground, working closely with production teams to ensure plans are practical, achievable and aligned with operational needs. You will also contribute to medium and long-term planning by providing valuable operational insights.



You will:



* Support and develop short-term mine plans in close collaboration with operations.
* Conduct regular underground field visits to verify conditions and identify constraints.
* Monitor mining progress and provide planning recommendations.
* Coordinate with production teams to support safe and efficient mining activities.
* Analyze operational data and contribute to planning across different time horizons.
* Prepare planning documentation, reports and presentations.


You will be part of a collaborative planning team where your understanding of both field conditions and planning processes has a direct impact on operational performance.



**What you bring**
------------------


You are curious, structured and eager to learn. You enjoy working closely with others, take initiative and communicate effectively across different functions. With a solution-oriented mindset and strong collaboration skills, you turn operational observations into practical improvements.



**Requirements**



* Bachelor’s degree in Mining Engineering or another relevant discipline.
* Strong interest in underground mining and mine planning.
* Understanding of mining operations and production processes.
* Ability to work both independently and as part of a multidisciplinary team.
* Good communication skills in Swedish and English.
* Manual Category B driver’s license required.


**Meritorious**



* Experience from underground mining operations.
* Experience with mine planning software such as Deswik, Datamine, Vulcan or similar.
* Experience with production follow-up and data analysis.
* Knowledge of rock mechanics, mine production or operational planning.

**Welcome with your application!**
----------------------------------


We strive for a fair and objective recruitment process. Therefore, we normally do not ask for cover letters. Instead, we ask you to answer questions related to the specific position you are applying for. Your responses help us understand your competence and experience, so please take the time to answer as clearly and thoroughly as possible.



Applications are reviewed continuously, so don’t wait to submit your application.



Start: According to agreement.



Place: Kiruna.



Scope: Full-time, daytime.



Contact:


For more information about the role, please contact the recruiting manager Theofanis Apeslidis, theofanis.apeslidis@lkab.com

title: Senior Specialist, Master Data Management
description:
This is a chance for you to collaborate with business data owners, data stewards, and the Hydropower Business MDM Lead to implement and maintain agreed data standards and ownership models. The role offers a strong opportunity to make an impact by establishing long-term data foundations that support digital development, analytics, and business operations.  

**About the role**
We are looking to strengthen our Master Data Management (MDM) capability by bringing in a senior profile to take a leading role in this area.  

You will be part of a team working at the intersection of business and IT, shaping how master data is structured, governed, and used across systems and processes.  

In this role, you will define and drive the MDM technical direction, while also contributing hands-on where needed. A key focus will be to build a scalable and sustainable MDM setup, strengthen internal capabilities, and reduce dependency on external support. You will play a key role in maintaining and evolving Hydro's master data structures, including data models, business rules, and tag mappings, ensuring consistent and high-quality data across business processes and systems.  

Key responsibilities will include but not be limited to:
* Contribute to Hydro's MDM technical direction and implementation standards
* Develop and enhance MDM solutions in Semarchy (or similar tools)
* Maintain and improve tag mappings, data models, and business rules to ensure consistent and high-quality master data
* Support integrations and data alignment across internal systems and platforms
* Collaborate with business stakeholders to understand requirements and support data ownership
* Support incident resolution, platform upgrades, and continuous improvement activities related to MDM solutions

  

**About you**
* 5+ years of experience in data management.
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Engineering, Software Engineering, or a related field.
* Hands-on experience with Semarchy xDM or similar MDM tools.
* Manage and continuously improve tag mappings, data mappings, and business rules to ensure data consistency, traceability, and quality across systems.
* Strong skills in data modelling and SQL.
* Proven experience working in a senior role (technical lead or senior engineer).
* Strong understanding of MDM architecture, integrations, and data flows.
* Experience with data governance and data quality concepts.
* Integration experience (APIs, ETL tools).
* Ability to lead workshops and advise stakeholders.
* Structured, pragmatic, and solution-oriented mindset.
* Experience in the energy industry is an advantage.
* Good language skills, being able to express yourself verbally in English is a must, other Nordic language is considered a great asset.

  

We offer a hybrid work model to support your productivity; you are expected to be at the office two to three times a week.  

The position can be located in our offices in Solna, Stockholm or Espoo, Helsinki.  

**We offer you**
At Fortum, we believe in a better future and want to be involved in shaping it. Our workplace is a safe place, both physically and mentally. You will grow with professional colleagues, being trusted and free to challenge yourself. We offer comprehensive benefits, flexible working hours, and hybrid work model to support your productivity, development and wellbeing. We are committed to build diverse teams where everyone feels included and is treated equally.  

More information about our culture and benefits can be found here.  

Espoo office is a smoke-free workplace.

Contact details to union representatives can be found on the bottom of this page.

**We are Fortum**
Fortum is a Nordic energy company. We generate and deliver reliable energy to our customers and the Nordic energy system while at the same time helping industries decarbonise their processes and grow. Our core operations comprise efficient and best-in-class low-carbon power generation, customer services, and heating and cooling. We are facing our greatest challenge yet – ensuring that Sweden and Europe have what it takes to transition to a sustainable future. So that we can live the lives we want, now and in the future. title: Radar Engineer
description:
Do you want to help develop radar technology in a start-up innovative environment that can play a central role in future autonomous vehicles?
  
Radar Reticence is looking for a system-oriented radar engineer who can contribute with both technical depth and a broad system perspective. In this role, you will work with radar principles, system architecture, signal processing, modelling, testing and technical design trade-offs. You do not need to be the deepest specialist in every area, but you need to understand how antennas, transmitters, receivers, signal processing, software and system requirements affect each other.
  
What you will work with
  
System architecture and technical design trade-offs for radar systems.
  
Breaking down operational needs into technical requirements.
  
Analysis of radar performance, interference, noise and signal integrity.
  
Modelling and simulation of radar systems.
  
Testing, verification and validation in lab and real-world environments.
  
Interpretation of measurement data from lab tests, vehicle tests and simulations.
  
Technical documentation, requirements management and structured engineering work.
  
Collaboration with experts in signal processing, firmware, RF and software.
  
  

We believe you have
  
Strong system understanding of complex technical systems.
  
Knowledge of radar principles, electromagnetics and wave propagation.
  
Understanding of the radar equation, target detection, Doppler processing and tracking.
  
Knowledge of signal processing, filtering and spectral analysis.
  
Experience with MATLAB, Simulink or Python.
  
Ability to work methodically with complex technical problems.
  
Good communication skills in cross-functional engineering teams.
  
  

It is a plus if you have experience with
  
Automotive radar.
  
ADAS or autonomous systems.
  
Sensor fusion.
  
Systems Engineering.
  
Requirements management, verification and validation.
  
Python, C/C++, Git and Linux.
  
Testing in lab environments or vehicles.
  
  

Required
  
Fluent in English, both spoken and written.
  
Able to make yourself understood in Swedish, both spoken and written.
  
Able to work from one of our offices in Linköping or Halmstad at least a few days per week.
  
  

Who you are
  
You are analytical, system-oriented and technically curious. You can move between detail and big-picture thinking, and you enjoy turning advanced technology and research into practical system solutions.
  
About Radar Reticence
  
Radar Reticence develops next-generation radar technology for safer and more autonomous vehicles. Built on deep Swedish radar expertise and research from Halmstad University, our patented software-based solution makes automotive radar more robust against interference – one of the fastest-growing challenges in advanced driver assistance and autonomous mobility.
  
**We are now entering an exciting growth phase:** moving from advanced research and validated testing toward chip integration, customer proof-of-concepts and commercial deployment with leading actors in the mobility and radar ecosystem. In 2026, Radar Reticence secured long-term financing through a new investment round and was awarded EIC Accelerator funding from the European Union.
  
We are building the team that will take our technology from lab and prototype to the radar systems of future vehicles. Learn more about us at Next Generation Radar - Radar Reticence

title: Research Engineer
description:
**The Department of Immunology, Genetics and Pathology** at Uppsala University has a broad research profile with strong research groups focusing on cancer, genetic and autoimmune diseases. A fundamental idea at the department is to stimulate translational research and thereby promote closer interactions between medical research and health care. Research is presently organized in six research programs: Cancer Precision Medicine, Cancer Immunotherapy, Genomics and Neurobiology, Molecular Tools and Functional Genomics, Neuro-Oncology and Neurodegeneration and Vascular Biology. Departmental activities are also integrated with the units for Oncology, Clinical Genetics, Clinical Immunology, Clinical Pathology, and Hospital Physics at Uppsala University Hospital. The department has teaching assignments in several education programs, including Master Programs, at the Faculty of Medicine. The department has a yearly turnover of around SEK 550 million, out of which about two thirds derive from external funding. IGP has approximately 400 employees, out of which 100 are PhD-students, and there are in total more than 850 affiliated staff members. More information about the department's activities can be found here: www.uu.se/en/staff/department/immunology-genetics-and-pathology

**Duties**  

Our team investigates cardiovascular mechanosensation during development and develops genetic tools to investigate gene function. The position focuses on managing a research team using zebrafish as a model organism. The research engineer will also carry out hands-on experimental work within our ongoing projects and take responsibility for establishing and running standard experiments in the group. Key responsibilities include:  

* Organize and maintain the laboratory, including managing inventories, ordering reagents and consumables using inventory and order management software, and ensuring a clean and functional workspace.
* Perform support experiments such as genotyping PCR, molecular cloning, and zebrafish line maintenance.
* Assist with zebrafish breeding and care in accordance with institutional and ethical guidelines.
* Contribute to the research projects of the group on cardiovascular mechanosensation, including experimental design and data analysis, with co-authorship on the resulting publications.
* Generate and characterize new zebrafish lines, including CRISPR-Cas9 knock-ins and transgenesis by microinjection.
* Acquire and quantify confocal imaging data from zebrafish embryos.
* Collaborate closely with the group leader to ensure smooth operation of laboratory activities.
* Develop and drive an independent side project in agreement with the group leader.
**Requirements**  

* Master’s degree in biology, molecular biology, biomedicine, or equivalent laboratory experience.
* Proven organizational skills and ability to manage laboratory operations efficiently.
* Ability to work independently while maintaining a collaborative and supportive attitude.
* Strong sense of responsibility and attention to detail.
* Documented hands-on experimental research experience, for example from a Master’s thesis project or a previous research position.
* Ability to plan and troubleshoot experiments independently, and to interpret and present the resulting data.
* Good communication skills and fluency in English, spoken and written.
**Additional qualifications**  

* Experience with zebrafish, including line maintenance, microinjection, and CRISPR genome engineering.
* Familiarity with molecular biology techniques such as PCR, cloning, and genotyping.
* Previous training in Swedish Legislation & Ethics, Animal Welfare, and the 3Rs, as well as Laboratory Animal Science for zebrafish.
* Experience with laboratory ordering and inventory systems.
* Experience with fluorescence microscopy of live embryos and with quantitative image analysis in Fiji/ImageJ.
* Experience in supervising or training students at the bench.
* Positive and dynamic personality, with a willingness to contribute to a collaborative team environment.
**About the employment**  

The employment is a permanent position, probationary period may be applied. Scope of employment 100 %. Starting date as agreed. Placement: Uppsala

The ultimate goal is to conduct education and research of the highest quality and relevance to make a difference in society. Our most important asset is all of our 7,500 employees and 53,000 students who, with curiosity and commitment, make Uppsala University one of Sweden’s most exciting workplaces. Join our multidisciplinary research team and gain practical experience developing software for robotic platforms, supporting user studies, and contributing to innovative projects that explore the future of human-centred technology.

The Department of Computer Science and Engineering, a joint department of Chalmers and the University of Gothenburg, spans the breadth of computing disciplines. Our internationally visible research, strong industry links and diverse environment create a collaborative setting where ideas grow into real impact.

You will have regular contact with the researchers and you will participate in group meetings, allowing you to gain a wider knowledge about the research topics within the groups.
